observations.title: sdd/perfil-ciudad/proposal
observations.content:
# Proposal: Optional `ciudad` (city) field on user profiles

## Intent
Profiles expose academic identity via `institucion`/`carrera` but no geographic context. Add an optional, free-text `ciudad` field so users can state their city. Additive, low-risk, no new privacy surface: city is public academic metadata, same tier as institution/career.

## Scope

### In Scope
- DB: additive nullable column `alter table public.usuario add column ciudad text;` (applied later via Supabase MCP, only after explicit user approval).
- Type `Usuario` gains `ciudad?: string`; `PerfilPublico = Omit<Usuario,'email'|'rol'>` inherits it automatically.
- Edit form `components/perfil/PerfilEditForm.tsx`: new `ciudad` `Field` (maxLength 50) beside `institucion`/`carrera`; extend the `Pick<...>` props and PATCH body.
- `app/api/perfil/route.ts` PATCH: add `ciudad` to the `undefined`-guarded `length > 50` validation, to the partial `updates` object, and to the explicit `.select(...)` allowlist.
- Display reads: `lib/data/perfil.ts` select (own + public profile view); `app/api/auth/me/route.ts` select (DTO consistency).
- Doc sync (same change): `promts/Vitrina_BD_Conexion_Backend.md` (column), `promts/Vitrina_Especificaciones_APIs.md` (PATCH payload + `Usuario` DTO), `promts/Vitrina_Pantallas_Componentes.md` (edit-form field).

### Out of Scope
- Card-level reads `lib/data/mensajes.ts`, `lib/data/seguidores.ts`, `app/api/likes/route.ts` — `UsuarioCardData` stays minimal; no `ciudad`.
- No privacy toggle, city catalog/validation, geocoding, or filter/search by city.
- No RLS/RPC/policy/view change.

## Assumptions (surface decision — automatic mode, flag if wrong)
- `ciudad` is displayed on own edit form, own profile view, and the PUBLIC profile view (via `PerfilPublico`), matching how `institucion`/`carrera` are already public. It is NOT shown on compact user cards (messages/followers/likes).

## Capabilities
### New Capabilities
- None.
### Modified Capabilities
- None (additive field; no spec-level requirement change).

## Approach
Mirror the existing `institucion`/`carrera` pattern end-to-end: same nullable-text column, same `undefined`-guarded PATCH validation, same explicit-column-allowlist select, same shared `Field` component. Owner scope stays `auth.uid()` (no owner id from body). Uniform `{ data }` / `{ error }` envelope unchanged. Zero `service_role`.

## Affected Areas
| Area | Impact | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `public.usuario` (DB) | Modified | +nullable `ciudad text` |
| `lib/types/database.ts` | Modified | `Usuario.ciudad?` |
| `components/perfil/PerfilEditForm.tsx` | Modified | new city field |
| `app/api/perfil/route.ts` | Modified | validate + persist + select `ciudad` |
| `lib/data/perfil.ts` | Modified | select `ciudad` |
| `app/api/auth/me/route.ts` | Modified | select `ciudad` |
| `promts/*.md` (3 docs) | Modified | doc sync |

## Risks
| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|------------|------------|
| Schema change without approval | Low | Migration gated on explicit user auth + CLAUDE.md additive-exception bullet |
| Missed select allowlist site | Low | Exact select sites enumerated above |
| Doc desync | Low | 3 `promts/` docs listed as mandatory same-change edits |

## Rollback Plan
Code: revert the PR (pure additive edits). DB: `alter table public.usuario drop column ciudad;` via Supabase MCP — safe, no dependents (nullable, absent from RLS/RPC/views).

## Dependencies
- Explicit user authorization for the schema change before `apply`.
- CLAUDE.md §Arquitectura gains a "Documented schema exception (additive)" bullet in the format of the existing `recomendacion-publicacion` / `admin-elimina-publicacion` exceptions.

## Success Criteria
- [ ] User can set/clear `ciudad` in `/perfil/ajustes`; it persists and re-displays.
- [ ] `ciudad` visible on profile view; when null, no empty artifact renders.
- [ ] No RLS/RPC/policy change; 3 `promts/` docs + CLAUDE.md updated in the same change.

observations.title: sdd/perfil-ciudad/spec
observations.content:
# Delta for perfil (user profile)

## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Ciudad column, additive and RLS-neutral
The system MUST persist an optional city per user via an additive nullable `ciudad text` column on `public.usuario`, applied only through the Supabase MCP after explicit user authorization, with no change to RLS policies, RPCs, or views.

#### Scenario: Column added without touching security surface
- GIVEN `public.usuario` has RLS enabled
- WHEN `ciudad text` is added via `alter table public.usuario add column ciudad text`
- THEN no RLS policy, RPC, or view definition changes
- AND existing rows have `ciudad = null`

#### Scenario: Migration gated on approval
- GIVEN the migration is drafted
- WHEN it is ready to run
- THEN it MUST NOT execute without explicit user authorization
- AND it MUST run via Supabase MCP, never blind SQL or `service_role`

### Requirement: Usuario DTO exposes ciudad
The system MUST extend `Usuario` with `ciudad?: string`, inherited by `PerfilPublico = Omit<Usuario,'email'|'rol'>`.

#### Scenario: Public profile type includes city
- GIVEN a `PerfilPublico` derived from `Usuario`
- WHEN `ciudad` is set on `Usuario`
- THEN `PerfilPublico.ciudad` reflects the same value
- AND `email`/`rol` stay excluded

### Requirement: PATCH /api/perfil validates and persists ciudad
The system MUST accept optional `ciudad` in the `PATCH /api/perfil` body, validate it like `institucion`/`carrera`, scope writes to `auth.uid()` (never an id from the body), and return it via the uniform `{ data }` envelope.

#### Scenario: Valid update
- GIVEN an authenticated user PATCHes `{ ciudad: "Querétaro" }`
- WHEN processed
- THEN the row for `auth.uid()` is updated
- AND the response is `{ data: { ..., ciudad: "Querétaro" } }`

#### Scenario: Ciudad omitted
- GIVEN a PATCH body without `ciudad`
- WHEN processed
- THEN the existing value is unchanged and no validation error occurs

#### Scenario: Ciudad too long or wrong type
- GIVEN `ciudad` is a string over 50 chars, or not a string/undefined
- WHEN processed
- THEN the response is `{ error: { code: "validation_error", message } }` at 400

### Requirement: Explicit select allowlists include ciudad
The system MUST add `ciudad` to every explicit column allowlist used for profile display reads: `app/api/perfil/route.ts` (PATCH select), `lib/data/perfil.ts` (own + public reads), `app/api/auth/me/route.ts`. `select('*')` MUST NOT be used.

#### Scenario: Public profile read includes city
- GIVEN a visitor loads a public profile via `lib/data/perfil.ts`
- WHEN the row is selected
- THEN the explicit column list includes `ciudad`

### Requirement: Ciudad field on profile edit form
The system MUST render an optional city input in `components/perfil/PerfilEditForm.tsx` using the existing `Field` pattern and `maxLength=50`, matching `institucion`/`carrera`.

#### Scenario: User sets or clears city
- GIVEN the user is on `/perfil/ajustes`
- WHEN they enter or clear a city and submit
- THEN the PATCH body carries the new `ciudad`
- AND the saved value re-displays after reload, consistent with how `institucion`/`carrera` clearing works today

### Requirement: Ciudad shown conditionally on profile views, absent from cards
The system MUST display `ciudad` on the own profile view (`/perfil`) and the public profile view only when non-empty, rendering nothing when null/empty. Compact card reads (`UsuarioCardData` in messages/followers/likes) MUST NOT fetch or display `ciudad`.

#### Scenario: City shown when set
- GIVEN a profile has `ciudad = "Puebla"`
- WHEN the profile view renders
- THEN "Puebla" displays alongside `institucion`/`carrera`

#### Scenario: City hidden when null
- GIVEN `ciudad = null`
- WHEN the profile view renders
- THEN no city element renders

#### Scenario: Compact cards unaffected
- GIVEN a message/follower/like list renders `UsuarioCardData`
- WHEN a card renders
- THEN `ciudad` is neither fetched nor displayed

### Requirement: Documentation stays in sync
The system MUST update `promts/Vitrina_BD_Conexion_Backend.md`, `promts/Vitrina_Especificaciones_APIs.md`, `promts/Vitrina_Pantallas_Componentes.md`, and add a CLAUDE.md §Arquitectura additive-exception bullet (matching the `recomendacion-publicacion`/`admin-elimina-publicacion` format), in the same change that introduces `ciudad`.

#### Scenario: Doc sync completed
- GIVEN the column, API payload, and form field are implemented
- WHEN the change is finalized
- THEN all three `promts/*.md` docs describe `ciudad`
- AND CLAUDE.md documents the additive schema exception

observations.title: sdd/perfil-ciudad/design
observations.content:
# Design: Optional `ciudad` (city) field on user profiles ## Technical Approach Additive, pattern-mirroring change. `ciudad` is a nullable public-tier profile field that clones the existing `institucion`/`carrera` path end-to-end: same nullable-text column, same `undefined`-guarded PATCH validation, same explicit-column-allowlist `.select`, same shared `Field` component, same falsy conditional render. No new table, RLS, RPC, route, or privacy surface. Owner scope stays `auth.uid()`. Uniform `{ data }` / `{ error }` envelope unchanged. Zero `service_role`. ## Architecture Decisions ### Decision: Empty string persists as-is (no empty→null coercion) | Option | Tradeoff | Decision | |---|---|---| | Persist `''` as-is | Mirrors sibling fields exactly; falsy render already hides it | CHOSEN | | Coerce `''`→`null` | Cleaner DB, but asymmetric vs `institucion`/`carrera`; extra logic | Rejected | **Rationale**: The edit form always sends `{ nombre, institucion, carrera }` (empty strings included), and the handler stores them as-is. `PerfilView` uses `{perfil.campo && ...}`, so `''` and `null` are both falsy → no empty artifact renders either way. Coercion would diverge from the established pattern for zero user-visible gain. ### Decision: Types are hand-maintained (no `gen types`) | Option | Tradeoff | Decision | |---|---|---| | Hand-edit `Usuario` DTO | Matches project convention (`lib/types/database.ts` is authored DTOs+enums) | CHOSEN | | Run `supabase gen types` | Project does not generate DB types; would introduce a new artifact | Rejected | **Rationale**: Add `ciudad?: string` manually; `PerfilPublico = Omit` inherits it automatically. No regeneration step. ### Decision: Field is public-tier, not on compact cards **Choice**: Show on own edit form, own profile view, public profile view; exclude message/follower/like cards. **Rationale**: `ciudad` is public academic metadata (same tier as institution/career); `UsuarioCardData` stays minimal — adding it there would bloat unrelated reads. ## Data Flow EditForm (state:ciudad) ──PATCH /api/perfil {ciudad}──→ handler (validate ≤50, updates, select allowlist) │ │ └── router.refresh() ← RSC re-read (perfil.ts / auth me) ─┘ ──→ PerfilView {perfil.ciudad &&

} ## File Changes (ordered edit list) | # | File | Action | Change | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | `public.usuario` (DB, Supabase MCP) | Migrate | `alter table public.usuario add column ciudad text;` — only after explicit approval | | 2 | `lib/types/database.ts` | Modify | `Usuario` gains `ciudad?: string` (public tier inherits) | | 3 | `app/api/perfil/route.ts` | Modify | destructure `ciudad`; add `ciudad !== undefined && ciudad.length > 50` guard; `updates.ciudad`; append `ciudad` to `.select('id, nombre, rol, institucion, carrera, creado_en')` | | 4 | `lib/data/perfil.ts:13` | Modify | add `ciudad` to select (own + public view) | | 4 | `app/api/auth/me/route.ts:15` | Modify | add `ciudad` to select (DTO consistency) | | 5 | `components/perfil/PerfilEditForm.tsx` | Modify | extend `Pick<...>` props with `ciudad`; `useState(perfil.ciudad ?? '')`; add `ciudad` to PATCH body; new `Field` (label `Ciudad`, `maxLength={50}`) | | 5 | `components/perfil/PerfilView.tsx:25-35` | Modify | conditional `{perfil.ciudad &&

...}` mirroring siblings | | 6 | `promts/Vitrina_BD_Conexion_Backend.md` | Modify | document `ciudad` column | | 6 | `promts/Vitrina_Especificaciones_APIs.md` | Modify | PATCH payload + `Usuario` DTO | | 6 | `promts/Vitrina_Pantallas_Componentes.md` | Modify | edit-form field | | 6 | `CLAUDE.md` | Modify | add "Documented schema exception (additive) — perfil-ciudad" bullet, format of existing `recomendacion-publicacion` exceptions | **Do NOT touch** (out of scope): `lib/data/mensajes.ts`, `lib/data/seguidores.ts`, `app/api/likes/route.ts` — compact-card reads stay minimal. ## Validation Contract - Length: `ciudad !== undefined && ciudad.length > 50` → `validationError('La ciudad no puede superar 50 caracteres.')`. Client `Field maxLength={50}` mirrors. - Empty/trim: no coercion — persist as sent (see ADR). No trim; siblings don't trim. - Owner: `.eq('id', user.id)` from session; `ciudad` never sourced as an owner id. ## Migration / Rollout 1. Propose exact SQL to user. 2. Get EXPLICIT approval (project invariant — never blind SQL, never `service_role`). 3. Apply via Supabase MCP `apply_migration`. 4. No type regeneration (hand-authored DTOs) — edit `Usuario` manually. Rollback: `alter table public.usuario drop column ciudad;` (nullable, no dependents). ## Testing Strategy No test runner in project. Verify via `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` + `pnpm lint`, then manual/webapp-testing of the edit flow: set city in `/perfil/ajustes` → persists → re-displays on own + public profile; clear it → no empty artifact renders; card views unaffected. ## Open Questions - None blocking. Migration awaits explicit user approval at apply time.

observations.title: sdd/colecciones/explore
observations.content:
## Exploration: Colecciones (user-owned publication collections)

### Current State

**CRUD skeleton template — `guardado` (bookmark), confirmed as the right template:**
- `app/api/guardados/route.ts` (POST): `createClient()` → `supabase.auth.getUser()` → `unauthorized()` if no user → parse body → `validationError()` if missing field → `.from('guardado').insert({ publicacion_id, usuario_id: user.id })` → `handleError(error)` on failure → `jsonOk(null, 201)`.
- `app/api/guardados/[id]/route.ts` (DELETE): `ctx.params` is `Promise<{id}>`, awaited; `.delete().eq(...).eq('usuario_id', user.id).select('id').maybeSingle()`; explicit 404 (`NextResponse.json({error:{code:'not_found',...}}, {status:404})`) when `!deleted` — handleError alone doesn't produce 404 for "no rows affected".
- **Note**: `guardado` has NO GET/list route handler. The "list my guardados" read (`getMisGuardados`) lives only in `lib/data/guardados.ts`, called directly from the SSR page `app/(main)/perfil/guardados/page.tsx`. `colecciones` needs a GET-list surface too, but the 6 endpoints in prompt1.md don't include a "list mine" endpoint — see Risks.
- **Even closer template for the 2-level nested route** (coleccion → publicaciones join row) is `app/api/publicaciones/[id]/tags/route.ts`: POST inserts into join table `publicacion_tag`, DELETE takes second key via `?tag_id=` query param (not a `[tagId]` path segment). This matters: prompt1.md's spec has `DELETE /api/colecciones/[id]/publicaciones/[pubId]` as a **path segment**, which is a different (also valid, and arguably more RESTful) convention than the existing `tags` precedent's query-param style. Flag this inconsistency for sdd-propose to pick one deliberately.

**Helpers (exact import paths):**
- `apiClient<T>(url, options?)` — `lib/api/client.ts`. Generic fetch wrapper, throws `ApiError(code, message, status)` on `!res.ok` or `{error}` body, unwraps `{data}` on success. "ONLY for use in Client Components... Never call from Server Components or lib/data/*" (per its own doc comment).
- `createClient()` (server) — `lib/supabase/server.ts`, uses `createServerClient` from `@supabase/ssr` + `await cookies()`, async function.
- `handleError(error: unknown): NextResponse` — `lib/supabase/handleError.ts`. Maps `__isAuthError`, `PGRST301`→401, `23505`→409, `42501`→403, `P0001`→400 (preserves message), `23514`→400 validation_error, default→500 (logs only `{code,status,message}`, never raw error — security rule from 2026-07-04 audit).
- `jsonOk<T>(data, status=200)`, `unauthorized()` (401), `forbidden()` (403, admin-only message), `validationError(message)` (400, code `validation_error`) — all in `lib/supabase/handleError.ts`.

**RLS precedents — no exact prior match for the `visibilidad='publica' OR usuario_id=auth.uid()` shape; two partial precedents:**
1. `guardado` (§3.11 of BD doc): fully PRIVATE, no public branch at all — `authenticated`-only SELECT `usuario_id = auth.uid()`, no `anon` policy, no `using(true)`. This is NOT the public-OR-owner shape; it's pure owner-only, closer to what `coleccion` WRITE policies should look like, not SELECT.
2. `seguidor` (§3.8): fully PUBLIC — `seguidor_lectura using(true)` for `anon`+`authenticated`, no conditional at all. Also not the shape needed.
3. **Closest real precedent for the actual public-OR-owner conditional**: `publicacion_oculta_bloqueadas`, a RESTRICTIVE policy on `publicacion`: `using (bloqueada = false or public.es_admin() or autor_id = auth.uid())` (BD doc lines 326-336). Same boolean shape (`condition OR owner`), though it's RESTRICTIVE (ANDed against a separate `using(true)` PERMISSIVE base) because `publicacion` already had unconditional public read to restrict. `coleccion` has no such pre-existing base policy, so it should be a single PERMISSIVE SELECT policy: `using (visibilidad = 'publica' OR usuario_id = auth.uid())` — simpler than `publicacion`'s two-policy split, but same logical shape.
4. **Closest precedent for `coleccion_publicacion` inheriting parent visibility via join** (join table has no visibilidad column of its own): `publicacion_chunk`'s `chunk_select` policy (BD doc lines 682-687): `publicacion.bloqueada = false OR autor_id = auth.uid() OR es_admin()` — a subquery/join against the parent table, doc-summarized (not raw SQL quoted in the doc). `coleccion_publicacion` should mirror this shape: `EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM coleccion c WHERE c.id = coleccion_publicacion.coleccion_id AND (c.visibilidad='publica' OR c.usuario_id=auth.uid()))` for SELECT, and owner-only (`c.usuario_id = auth.uid()`) for INSERT/DELETE — same shape as `chunk_insert`'s `WITH CHECK publicacion.autor_id = auth.uid()`.
- **Correction to prompt1.md**: its RLS table claims to follow "el mismo patrón que seguidor/publicacion" — that's not accurate; `seguidor` is unconditional-public and doesn't have the visibilidad branch at all. The real template is the `publicacion`/`publicacion_chunk` bloqueada-OR-owner pattern, not `seguidor`.

**Publication card UI — correction to task framing:**
- `GuardarButton` (bookmark) is NOT rendered on the feed card component (`components/feed/PublicacionCard.tsx`, used by `components/feed/FeedList.tsx`) — that card is a plain, non-interactive `Link`-wrapped `Card` with no action buttons at all.
- `GuardarButton` is wired ONLY on the publication **detail** page, `app/(main)/publicacion/[id]/page.tsx` lines 16, 277-281, alongside `LikeButton`, `CompartirButton`, `ReportarButton`. Visibility state is resolved server-side via `getIsGuardado(id, user?.id)` from `lib/data/guardados.ts` and passed as `initialSaved` prop — same SSR-then-client-optimistic-toggle pattern `GuardarButton` itself uses (`components/publicacion/GuardarButton.tsx`): local `useState`, optimistic update, `apiClient` POST/DELETE, `router.refresh()` on success, revert state on error.
- Practical implication: "Agregar a colección" naturally belongs next to `GuardarButton` on the detail page (same file/line region), NOT on the feed card — unless this feature intentionally expands scope to add action buttons to feed cards too (bigger change, not currently in scope per prompt1.md).

**`/perfil` page structure — correction to task framing:**
- `app/(main)/perfil/page.tsx` does NOT have separate "Publicaciones" and "En revistas" sections side by side. It has: profile header (`PerfilView` + `PerfilStats`), a collapsed `<details>` "Mis postulaciones", and ONE card-grid section "Mis publicaciones" (via `FeedList`). "En revistas" is only a `Badge` stat inside `PerfilStats.tsx` (`totalEnRevistas > 0 && <Badge tone="success">`), not a section with its own list.
- "Guardados" is NOT an inline section either — it's a **separate sub-page** `app/(main)/perfil/guardados/page.tsx` linked via a small header button (`<Link href="/perfil/guardados">Guardados</Link>`, next to "Ajustes").
- **Implication for design**: "Colecciones" should most naturally follow the "Guardados" pattern — a `/perfil/colecciones` sub-page (or a `/perfil` section, since collections are more central to identity than bookmarks) — not literally "next to Publicaciones and En revistas" as prompt1.md's UI bullet implies. Recommend deciding in sdd-propose: sub-page (mirrors Guardados, minimal /perfil diff) vs. inline section (more visible, larger /perfil diff).

**Public detail page precedent for `/coleccion/[id]`:**
- `app/(main)/usuario/[id]/page.tsx`: SSR-only, no `generateMetadata`. Fetches via `getPerfil(id)` from `lib/data/perfil.ts` (uses `.single()`, not `.maybeSingle()` — throws PGRST116 on 0 rows), calls `notFound()` when `!perfil`. RLS on the underlying table is what actually enforces visibility; the page code doesn't special-case "private". This is the exact pattern `/coleccion/[id]/page.tsx` should mirror for SSR fetch + `notFound()` on RLS-filtered-out rows (private collection + non-owner viewer → 0 rows → `.single()` errors → treat as not-found, or switch to `.maybeSingle()` for a cleaner check — worth deciding in design).
- `app/(main)/area/[slug]/page.tsx` (lines 23-37) is the best `generateMetadata` precedent in the codebase (there is currently NO `generateMetadata` on `/publicacion/[id]` itself) — canonical `alternates.canonical` pattern using `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL` env var, `notFound()`-safe early return `{}` when the slug/id doesn't resolve.
- `lib/data/perfil.ts::getPerfil` is the exact "server-only single row read, explicit column allowlist, no `select('*')`" shape to copy for a `getColeccion(id)` data-layer function.

**DTO/type placement and naming convention (`lib/types/database.ts`):**
- Base table DTOs are flat, PascalCase singular: `Guardado` (line 119), `Revista` (126), `Seguidor` (217) — new `Coleccion` type goes in this style, in a new section near line 124 (after `Guardado`) or as its own `// Coleccion DTOs` block, mirroring the `// Reporte DTOs` (232) / `// RAG DTOs (rag-publicacion)` (270) section-comment convention.
- Join-table-with-`orden` DTOs mirror `RevistaArticulo` (135-142): flat FK pair + `orden: number` + an optional embedded relation (`publicacion?: Pick<Publicacion,...> & {usuario?: ...}`). `ColeccionPublicacion` should follow this exact shape: `{ coleccion_id, publicacion_id, orden, agregado_en, publicacion?: Pick<Publicacion,'id'|'titulo'|'resumen'|'tipo'> & {usuario?: Pick<Usuario,'id'|'nombre'>} }`.
- Composed/detail types use either `X & { ... }` with a `Detalle` suffix (`RevistaDetalle = Revista & { revista_articulo?: RevistaArticulo[] }`, line 211) or a `ConDetalle` suffix for embedded-parent joins (`SolicitudConDetalle`, `ReporteConDetalle`). `ColeccionDetalle = Coleccion & { coleccion_publicacion?: ColeccionPublicacion[] }` matches `RevistaDetalle` exactly.
- Card-grid DTOs use a `CardData` suffix (`PublicacionCardData` line 173, `UsuarioCardData` line 183) — if a `/perfil/colecciones` list needs its own lightweight shape (title, count, visibility, cover?) distinct from full `Coleccion`, name it `ColeccionCardData`.

### Affected Areas
- `app/api/colecciones/route.ts` (new) — POST create, mirrors `app/api/guardados/route.ts`.
- `app/api/colecciones/[id]/route.ts` (new) — GET/PATCH/DELETE, mirrors `app/api/guardados/[id]/route.ts` + `app/api/publicaciones/[id]/tags/route.ts` for the owner-check DELETE pattern; GET needs the `.maybeSingle()`-vs-`.single()` decision for visibility-filtered 404.
- `app/api/colecciones/[id]/publicaciones/route.ts` (new) — POST add, mirrors `tags/route.ts` POST.
- `app/api/colecciones/[id]/publicaciones/[pubId]/route.ts` (new) — DELETE remove; prompt1.md wants a path-segment `[pubId]`, existing `tags` precedent uses a query param instead — pick one deliberately in propose.
- `lib/data/colecciones.ts` (new) — `getColeccion(id)`, `getMisColecciones(usuarioId)` (mirrors `lib/data/guardados.ts::getMisGuardados`), possibly `getColeccionDetalle(id)` for the public page (join to `coleccion_publicacion` + `publicacion`).
- `lib/types/database.ts` — add `Coleccion`, `ColeccionPublicacion`, `ColeccionDetalle`, `ColeccionCardData`, `VisibilidadColeccion = 'publica' | 'privada'` union type (mirrors `EstadoRevista`, `MotivoReporte` unions at top of file).
- `components/publicacion/AgregarAColeccionButton.tsx` (new, no existing analog to copy wholesale) — trigger button + `Modal` (reuses `components/ui/Modal.tsx`), listing user's collections with add/remove toggle + inline "crear nueva" mini-form. Closest partial analogs: `ReportarButton.tsx` (button+Modal+form+apiClient shape) and `ArticulosList.tsx` (list-of-items-with-per-item-action-and-loading-state shape) — neither covers the "list + create-inline" combination, this is net-new UI logic.
- `app/(main)/publicacion/[id]/page.tsx` — add the new button near line 277 (next to `GuardarButton`), needs `getMisColecciones(user.id)` (or an "is this pub in any of my collections" check) added to the existing `Promise.all` SSR fetch block (lines 62-74).
- `components/perfil/ColeccionCard.tsx` + a colecciones list/section (new) — either `app/(main)/perfil/colecciones/page.tsx` (mirrors `perfil/guardados/page.tsx` exactly) or an inline section in `app/(main)/perfil/page.tsx` (mirrors the existing "Mis publicaciones" `FeedList` block, lines 116-130) — decide in propose.
- `app/(main)/coleccion/[id]/page.tsx` + `generateMetadata` (new) — mirrors `usuario/[id]/page.tsx` (SSR fetch + `notFound()`) and `area/[slug]/page.tsx` (metadata shape).
- Reorder UI for `coleccion_publicacion.orden` (owner-only, on the collection's own management view) — reuse the up/down-arrow pattern from `components/admin/revistas/ArticulosList.tsx` (lines 148-169) rather than building drag-and-drop.
- `promts/Vitrina_BD_Conexion_Backend.md`, `Vitrina_Especificaciones_APIs.md`, `Vitrina_Pantallas_Componentes.md` — mandatory doc sync per CLAUDE.md for the new tables/RLS, endpoints, and screens.

### Approaches
1. **Follow prompt1.md's spec as-is (6 endpoints, path-segment `[pubId]`, `/perfil` inline sections)** 
   - Pros: matches the pre-agreed spec; RESTful path-segment DELETE is arguably cleaner than the `tags` query-param precedent.
   - Cons: has an unaddressed gap (no "list my collections" endpoint for the client-side modal — see Risks); the `/perfil` "next to Publicaciones and En revistas" framing doesn't match the real page structure and needs re-scoping.
   - Effort: Medium-High.

2. **Same schema/endpoints, but resolve the two open gaps explicitly before propose**: add a `GET /api/colecciones?mine=true` (or a query param on existing `GET /api/colecciones/[id]`... no, need a collection-less list route) as a 7th endpoint, and put "Colecciones" as a `/perfil/colecciones` sub-page (mirroring Guardados) rather than an inline section.
   - Pros: closes the real gap found during exploration (client Modal needs a fetchable list); keeps `/perfil` diff small and consistent with the existing Guardados precedent; every route has a codebase precedent to copy.
   - Cons: 7 endpoints instead of 6 (slightly more surface); slight scope re-negotiation vs. prompt1.md's literal wording.
   - Effort: Medium-High (same ballpark as #1, better de-risked).

### Recommendation
Approach 2. The extra list endpoint is small (mirrors `getMisGuardados` shape, ~20-30 lines) and removes a real blocker (the "Agregar a colección" modal is a Client Component and cannot call `lib/data/*` directly — per `apiClient`'s own doc comment — so it needs *some* fetchable list; SSR-prop-passing only works on the one page that already resolves the viewer, i.e. the publication detail page, and doesn't generalize). Use `/perfil/colecciones` as a sub-page, matching the Guardados precedent exactly, to keep `/perfil` page.tsx's diff minimal and consistent.

### Risks
- **Gap**: prompt1.md's 6-endpoint list has no "list my collections" GET. The `AgregarAColeccionButton` modal is `'use client'` and per `lib/api/client.ts`'s own doc comment must never call `lib/data/*` directly — it needs a fetchable endpoint. Must be resolved in sdd-propose (either add a 7th endpoint or restructure `GET /api/colecciones/[id]` semantics — do not silently drop this).
- **Convention inconsistency**: prompt1.md specs `DELETE .../publicaciones/[pubId]` (path segment) while the only existing 2-level-join-table precedent (`publicaciones/[id]/tags`) uses a query param (`?tag_id=`). Pick one and document why, so future join-table endpoints (if any) stay consistent.
- **`.single()` vs `.maybeSingle()` on RLS-filtered public reads**: `getPerfil` (the closest SSR-detail precedent) uses `.single()`, which throws PGRST116 (not a clean null) when RLS filters out all rows — relevant for `/coleccion/[id]` when a private collection is hit by a non-owner (0 rows returned, not an "error" semantically). `usuario/[id]/page.tsx` doesn't cleanly distinguish this from a real DB error today. Recommend `.maybeSingle()` for `getColeccion` to avoid inheriting that ambiguity.
- **Effort estimate risk**: "medio" in prompt1.md likely undercounts the net-new UI work (collection-picker-with-inline-create modal, reorder UI, public detail page + metadata) — see Effort re-estimate below. If underestimated, this could land as one oversized PR violating the 400-line review budget.
- No test runner is configured in this repo (per CLAUDE.md, use `testsprite` MCP) — collections' RLS (public-OR-owner + join-inherits-visibility) is exactly the kind of policy that benefits from explicit positive/negative RLS test cases (owner reads own private collection; anon/other-user cannot; public collection readable by anon); flag for sdd-design/sdd-tasks to include explicit RLS verification steps, not just endpoint happy-path tests.

### Effort re-estimate
prompt1.md rates this "medio" (medium). Based on concrete precedents found:
- DB migration (2 tables, ~4-5 RLS policies with a join-inherits-visibility subquery): ~60-90 lines SQL, applied via Supabase MCP (not part of the app-code PR diff, but real work + doc sync).
- `lib/types/database.ts` additions: ~30-40 lines.
- `lib/data/colecciones.ts`: ~80-120 lines (3-4 functions: list mine, get by id/detail, possibly an "is-in-collection" helper).
- 4 route files, 6-7 handlers total (mirroring `guardados` + `tags` shapes): ~180-240 lines.
- `AgregarAColeccionButton` + modal (net-new: list + per-item toggle + inline create, no single existing component covers this combo): ~180-240 lines.
- `/perfil/colecciones` sub-page + `ColeccionCard` + edit/delete affordances (mirrors `EliminarPublicacionButton`/`EliminarRevistaButton` + `RevistaPatchForm` patterns): ~150-200 lines.
- `/coleccion/[id]/page.tsx` + `generateMetadata` + owner-only reorder UI (adapted from `ArticulosList`'s up/down pattern): ~200-260 lines.
- Docs sync (BD/APIs/Pantallas, mandatory per CLAUDE.md): not code lines, but real reviewer/author time.

**Rough total: ~900-1,200 changed lines across ~13-15 new files** (well above the 400-line single-PR review budget in `sdd-phase-common.md` §E). This is **medium-high**, not medium — driven mainly by the collection-picker modal and the reorder UI having no direct copy-paste precedent (unlike simple CRUD forms elsewhere in the app). Recommend PR-splitting for sdd-tasks:
1. Schema + RLS + types + all endpoints + `lib/data` (backend-only, testable via API, ~300-400 lines).
2. `AgregarAColeccionButton` on the publication detail page (~200-250 lines).
3. `/perfil/colecciones` page + collection management (edit/delete metadata) (~150-200 lines).
4. Public `/coleccion/[id]` page + metadata + owner reorder UI (~200-260 lines).

### Ready for Proposal
Yes, with two decisions flagged for sdd-propose to resolve explicitly (not silently default): (1) how the client-side "list my collections" read is served (7th endpoint recommended), and (2) `/perfil/colecciones` sub-page vs. inline `/perfil` section. Both are small scope clarifications, not blockers.

observations.title: sdd/colecciones/proposal
observations.content:
# Proposal: Colecciones (user-owned publication collections)

## Intent
Let any `usuario` group publications into named, ordered, personal collections that are either public or private. Today the only "save" primitive is `guardado` (a flat, always-private bookmark list) — there is no way to curate, title, describe, order, or publicly share a themed set. Collections give creators a lightweight, self-curated alternative to admin-only `revista`, improving discovery and personal identity.

## Scope
### In Scope
- 2 new tables (additive): `coleccion` (id, `usuario_id`, `titulo`, `descripcion?`, `visibilidad`, timestamps) + join `coleccion_publicacion` (`coleccion_id`, `publicacion_id`, `orden`, `agregado_en`).
- RLS: public-OR-owner read + owner-only write (corrected design below).
- 7 endpoints (prompt1.md had 6 — the list-mine GET is added).
- DTOs in `lib/types/database.ts`: `Coleccion`, `ColeccionPublicacion`, `ColeccionDetalle`, `ColeccionCardData`, `VisibilidadColeccion = 'publica'|'privada'`.
- `lib/data/colecciones.ts` (SSR reads).
- 3 UI surfaces: add-to-collection modal on publication detail page; `/perfil/colecciones` management sub-page; public `/coleccion/[id]` page + `generateMetadata`.
- Mandatory doc sync (BD, APIs, Pantallas).

### Out of Scope
- Action buttons on feed cards (card is non-interactive — no scope creep).
- Collaborative/shared collections, follow-a-collection, nested collections.
- Drag-and-drop reorder (use up/down arrows if reorder is in MVP).
- `revista` changes; any change to existing tables/policies.

## Capabilities
### New Capabilities
- `colecciones`: user-owned publication collections — schema, RLS, endpoints, and UI surfaces.
### Modified Capabilities
- None (purely additive; no existing spec-level behavior changes).

## Approach
Copy the verified `guardado` CRUD skeleton (`createClient()`→`auth.getUser()`→`unauthorized()`→validate→insert/delete→`handleError`→`jsonOk`, explicit 404 on zero-row DELETE) and the `publicaciones/[id]/tags` nested-join shape. `usuario_id` always from `auth.uid()`, never body. Uniform envelope + `handleError` mapping. Zero `service_role`.

**Corrected RLS (prompt1.md wrongly cited `seguidor`/`publicacion`):**
- `coleccion` SELECT: `visibilidad='publica' OR usuario_id=auth.uid()` (single PERMISSIVE policy; logical shape from `publicacion_oculta_bloqueadas`, not `seguidor`'s `using(true)`).
- `coleccion` INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE: `usuario_id=auth.uid()`.
- `coleccion_publicacion` SELECT/INSERT/DELETE: subquery against parent `coleccion` (mirrors `publicacion_chunk.chunk_select`/`chunk_insert`) — SELECT inherits parent visibility, INSERT/DELETE require parent ownership.

**7 endpoints:**
1. `POST /api/colecciones` — create.
2. `GET /api/colecciones` — list mine (NEW; the modal is a Client Component, cannot call `lib/data/*`, needs a fetchable list).
3. `GET /api/colecciones/[id]` — read one (`.maybeSingle()` → clean 404 on RLS-filtered private).
4. `PATCH /api/colecciones/[id]` — update metadata (owner).
5. `DELETE /api/colecciones/[id]` — delete (owner).
6. `POST /api/colecciones/[id]/publicaciones` — add publication.
7. `DELETE /api/colecciones/[id]/publicaciones/[pubId]` — remove.

**DELETE convention decision:** use the path segment `[pubId]` (per prompt1.md) over the existing `tags` `?tag_id=` query-param style. Both valid; path segment is cleaner REST and this is net-new surface, so no existing convention is broken. Documented deliberately.

**Reads:** SSR pages call `lib/data/colecciones.ts` (`getMisColecciones`, `getColeccion`, `getColeccionDetalle`); client modal calls endpoint #2 via `apiClient`. `/perfil/colecciones` mirrors `perfil/guardados` sub-page exactly (minimal `/perfil` diff). `/coleccion/[id]` mirrors `usuario/[id]` (SSR + `notFound()`) + `area/[slug]` metadata.

## Affected Areas
| Area | Impact | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| Supabase schema (MCP) | New | 2 tables + RLS policies (GATED — see Checkpoints) |
| `app/api/colecciones/**` | New | 4 route files, 7 handlers |
| `lib/data/colecciones.ts` | New | SSR reads |
| `lib/types/database.ts` | Modified | +5 types/unions |
| `components/publicacion/AgregarAColeccionButton.tsx` | New | modal: list + toggle + inline create (net-new UI) |
| `app/(main)/publicacion/[id]/page.tsx` | Modified | mount button near `GuardarButton` (~L277) |
| `app/(main)/perfil/colecciones/page.tsx` + `ColeccionCard` | New | management sub-page |
| `app/(main)/coleccion/[id]/page.tsx` | New | public page + `generateMetadata` |
| `promts/*.md` (BD/APIs/Pantallas) | Modified | mandatory doc sync |

## PR-Slice Plan (~900–1,200 LOC total — EXCEEDS 400-line budget → 4 slices)
1. **Backend**: schema+RLS (MCP, gated) + DTOs + 7 endpoints + `lib/data` — ~300–400 LOC. Testable via API.
2. **Add-to-collection widget**: modal + list-GET consumer on detail page — ~200–250 LOC.
3. **`/perfil/colecciones`**: management sub-page + edit/delete — ~150–200 LOC.
4. **Public page**: `/coleccion/[id]` + metadata + owner reorder UI — ~200–260 LOC.

## Risks
| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|------------|------------|
| Schema change without authorization | Med | GATED checkpoint — propose DDL only; apply after explicit user OK via Supabase MCP |
| Oversized single PR (>400 lines) | High | 4-slice plan above |
| `.single()` PGRST116 on private read | Med | Use `.maybeSingle()` in `getColeccion` |
| RLS gaps (public/private leak) | Med | Explicit positive/negative RLS tests (testsprite; no local runner) |
| Doc drift | Med | Doc-sync checkpoint in same change |

## Checkpoints (gates)
- **Schema authorization**: 2 new tables + new RLS policies = schema change. Propose DDL now; apply ONLY after explicit user authorization via Supabase MCP (no blind SQL, no `service_role`). Add a "Documented schema exception (additive)" note to CLAUDE.md §Arquitectura + `Vitrina_BD_Conexion_Backend.md`.
- **Doc sync (same change)**: BD (tables+RLS+patterns), APIs (7 endpoints+payloads+DTOs+status), Pantallas (modal, sub-page, public page).

## Rollback Plan
Per slice: revert the app-code PR (isolated files). Backend slice: `DROP TABLE coleccion_publicacion; DROP TABLE coleccion;` via MCP (cascade drops policies/join) — no existing table/policy touched, so rollback is clean and self-contained.

## Success Criteria
- [ ] Owner can create/edit/delete a collection and add/remove/reorder publications.
- [ ] Public collection readable by anon; private returns 404 to non-owner (RLS-enforced).
- [ ] Modal lists my collections and toggles membership from the publication detail page.
- [ ] `/coleccion/[id]` renders public collections with correct metadata; private → notFound for non-owner.
- [ ] Docs (BD/APIs/Pantallas) updated in the same change.

## Proposal question round (needs user input before spec/design lock)
1. **Reorder UI in MVP or deferred?** `coleccion_publicacion.orden` exists in schema either way; UI (up/down arrows, slice 4) is the cost. Recommend: keep column, defer reorder UI if trimming scope.
2. **`titulo` constraints:** max length (recommend 100, matching existing `CHECK char_length` precedents) and **uniqueness per user** — should a user be blocked from two collections with the same title? Recommend NOT unique (simpler; no 23505 path needed).
3. **`descripcion` max length?** Recommend nullable, `CHECK char_length <= 500`.
4. **`visibilidad` default:** `'privada'` (safe default) vs `'publica'`? Recommend `'privada'`.
5. **`/perfil/colecciones` sub-page (recommended, mirrors Guardados) vs inline `/perfil` section?** Recommend sub-page (minimal diff, consistent).
Assumptions if unanswered: reorder deferred; `titulo` ≤100 non-unique; `descripcion` ≤500 nullable; default `privada`; sub-page.

observations.title: sdd/colecciones/spec
observations.content:
# Colecciones Specification

## Purpose
User-owned, named, orderable, public-or-private groupings of publications — a self-curated alternative to admin-only `revista`.

## Requirements

### Requirement: Schema
The system MUST provide `coleccion` (id, usuario_id, titulo ≤100, descripcion? ≤500, visibilidad ∈ {publica,privada} default `privada`, creado_en) and `coleccion_publicacion` (coleccion_id, publicacion_id, orden default 0, agregado_en, composite PK), additive to the existing schema.

#### Scenario: New collection defaults to private
- GIVEN a usuario creates a coleccion without specifying visibilidad
- WHEN the row is inserted
- THEN visibilidad defaults to 'privada'

### Requirement: RLS — coleccion read
SELECT on `coleccion` MUST be allowed (anon + authenticated) when `visibilidad='publica' OR usuario_id=auth.uid()`.

#### Scenario: Owner reads own private collection
- GIVEN a private coleccion owned by user A
- WHEN user A queries it
- THEN the row is returned

#### Scenario: Non-owner cannot read private collection
- GIVEN a private coleccion owned by user A
- WHEN user B (authenticated, not owner) queries it
- THEN zero rows are returned

#### Scenario: Anon reads public collection
- GIVEN a public coleccion
- WHEN an unauthenticated client queries it
- THEN the row is returned

### Requirement: RLS — coleccion write
INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on `coleccion` MUST be restricted to `usuario_id=auth.uid()` (using + with check).

#### Scenario: Non-owner update denied
- GIVEN a coleccion owned by user A (public or private)
- WHEN user B attempts UPDATE or DELETE
- THEN RLS denies the write (zero rows affected)

### Requirement: RLS — coleccion_publicacion
SELECT MUST inherit the parent coleccion's visibility via subquery; INSERT/DELETE MUST require `coleccion.usuario_id=auth.uid()`.

#### Scenario: Non-owner cannot list members of a private collection
- GIVEN a private coleccion owned by user A with 2 publicaciones
- WHEN user B queries coleccion_publicacion for that coleccion_id
- THEN zero rows are returned

#### Scenario: Non-owner cannot insert into another user's collection
- GIVEN a coleccion owned by user A
- WHEN user B attempts to INSERT a coleccion_publicacion row for that coleccion_id
- THEN RLS denies the write

### Requirement: Owner identity from session
All writes MUST derive usuario_id / ownership from `supabase.auth.getUser()`, never from the request body.

#### Scenario: Body-supplied usuario_id ignored
- GIVEN an authenticated user POSTs /api/colecciones with a usuario_id in the body pointing to another user
- WHEN the collection is created
- THEN the row's usuario_id is the session user's id

### Requirement: Response envelope and error mapping
All 7 endpoints MUST use `{data}`/`{error:{code,message}}` and map per handleError: no JWT→401, RLS denial→403, unique violation→409, own validation→400 (`validation_error`), P0001→400 preserving message, uncaught→500.

#### Scenario: Unauthenticated write rejected
- GIVEN no session cookie
- WHEN any POST/PATCH/DELETE colecciones endpoint is called
- THEN response is 401 with error envelope

#### Scenario: Validation failure on create
- GIVEN titulo exceeds 100 chars
- WHEN POST /api/colecciones is called
- THEN response is 400, code `validation_error`

### Requirement: Explicit 404 on zero-row mutations
PATCH/DELETE `coleccion` and DELETE `coleccion_publicacion` MUST return an explicit 404 envelope when the mutation affects zero rows (RLS-denied or missing) — handleError alone does not produce 404 for an empty-but-successful Postgrest response.

#### Scenario: DELETE join row on non-owned/nonexistent target returns 404
- GIVEN a coleccion_id/pubId pair that is missing or not owned by the caller
- WHEN DELETE /api/colecciones/[id]/publicaciones/[pubId] is called
- THEN response is 404, not a silent 200

### Requirement: Collection CRUD endpoints
`POST /api/colecciones`, `GET /api/colecciones` (list mine), `GET /api/colecciones/[id]`, `PATCH /api/colecciones/[id]`, `DELETE /api/colecciones/[id]` MUST behave per owner/visibility rules above.

#### Scenario: Create succeeds
- GIVEN a valid titulo
- WHEN POST /api/colecciones is called
- THEN response is 201 with the created coleccion

#### Scenario: List returns only mine
- GIVEN user A has 2 collections and user B has 1
- WHEN user A calls GET /api/colecciones
- THEN data contains exactly user A's 2 collections

#### Scenario: Read one — non-owner requests private
- GIVEN a private coleccion owned by user A
- WHEN user B calls GET /api/colecciones/[id]
- THEN response is 404

#### Scenario: Owner updates and deletes
- GIVEN a coleccion owned by user A
- WHEN user A PATCHes visibilidad then DELETEs it
- THEN both return 200 and the row (and its members) no longer exist

### Requirement: Collection membership endpoints
`POST /api/colecciones/[id]/publicaciones` and `DELETE /api/colecciones/[id]/publicaciones/[pubId]` MUST be owner-only.

#### Scenario: Owner adds a publication
- GIVEN a valid publicacion_id
- WHEN the owner calls POST .../publicaciones
- THEN response is 201 and a coleccion_publicacion row exists

#### Scenario: Duplicate add rejected
- GIVEN publicacion_id already in the collection
- WHEN the same POST is repeated
- THEN response is 409

### Requirement: Add-to-collection UI on publication detail
The publication detail page MUST let an authenticated viewer add/remove the current publication to/from their own collections, with inline creation of a new one.

#### Scenario: User toggles membership
- GIVEN an authenticated viewer on a publication detail page
- WHEN they select one of their collections in the control
- THEN the publication is added and the control reflects the new state

### Requirement: Collections management sub-page
`/perfil/colecciones` MUST list the session user's own collections (any visibilidad) with edit/delete affordances.

#### Scenario: Owner deletes from management page
- GIVEN the user is on /perfil/colecciones
- WHEN they delete one of their collections
- THEN it is removed from the list

### Requirement: Public collection page
`/coleccion/[id]` MUST render SSR when public or owner-viewed, and call `notFound()` otherwise; MUST expose `generateMetadata`.

#### Scenario: Non-owner requests private collection page
- GIVEN a private coleccion
- WHEN a different or anonymous visitor requests /coleccion/[id]
- THEN Next.js notFound() renders

### Requirement: Documentation sync
The change MUST update `Vitrina_BD_Conexion_Backend.md`, `Vitrina_Especificaciones_APIs.md`, `Vitrina_Pantallas_Componentes.md`, and add a "Documented schema exception (additive)" bullet to CLAUDE.md's Arquitectura section, in the same change.

#### Scenario: Docs updated alongside schema
- GIVEN coleccion/coleccion_publicacion are applied via Supabase MCP
- WHEN the change is completed
- THEN the docs above reflect the new tables, policies, endpoints, and UI

observations.title: sdd/colecciones/design
observations.content:
# Design: Colecciones (user-owned publication collections)

## Technical Approach
Two additive Postgres tables (`coleccion`, `coleccion_publicacion`) protected by RLS mirroring the `publicacion`/`publicacion_chunk` public-OR-owner shape (not `seguidor`'s unconditional-public, not `guardado`'s owner-only). App layer copies the verified `guardado` CRUD skeleton (`createClient → auth.getUser → unauthorized → validate → insert/delete → handleError → jsonOk`) plus the `tags` nested-join precedent, using `.maybeSingle()` instead of `.single()` to turn RLS-filtered rows into a clean `notFound()` rather than a PGRST116 throw. Delivered as 4 dependent PR slices (backend → widget → management page → public page) to stay under the 400-line review budget. Reorder (`orden` column) ships in schema now, UI deferred.

## Architecture Decisions

| Decision | Choice | Rejected alternative | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| RLS read shape | Single PERMISSIVE `coleccion_select`: `visibilidad='publica' OR usuario_id=auth.uid()` | `seguidor`'s `using(true)` (no visibility branch); `publicacion`'s dual RESTRICTIVE+PERMISSIVE split | `coleccion` has no pre-existing unconditional-read policy to restrict against, so one PERMISSIVE policy is sufficient and simpler than `publicacion`'s two-policy split |
| Join-table visibility | `coleccion_publicacion` SELECT via `EXISTS` subquery against parent `coleccion` | Duplicating `visibilidad` on the join row | Join table has no visibility of its own; mirrors `publicacion_chunk.chunk_select`'s parent-join pattern exactly, avoids denormalization |
| Join-table write policy | One `FOR ALL` owner-only policy (`coleccion_publicacion_write`) covering insert/update/delete, OR'd with the separate SELECT policy | Three separate INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policies | Postgres has no "FOR INSERT,DELETE" combo; `FOR ALL` collapses to 1 statement, is forward-compatible with a future reorder PATCH, and permissive-OR with the SELECT policy still yields correct (looser) SELECT semantics |
| List-mine endpoint | Add `GET /api/colecciones` as a 7th endpoint | Rely only on `lib/data` (as `guardado` does) | The add-to-collection modal is a Client Component; `apiClient`'s own doc comment forbids it calling `lib/data/*` directly, so it needs a fetchable list route |
| Private-read 404 | `.maybeSingle()` in `getColeccion(id)` | `.single()` (used by `getPerfil`) | `.single()` throws PGRST116 on 0 rows (RLS-filtered private collection), which is not a real error — `.maybeSingle()` yields `null` → clean `notFound()` |
| Join-row DELETE convention | Path segment `[pubId]` | Query param `?tag_id=` (existing `tags` precedent) | Net-new surface, no existing convention broken; path segment is the more RESTful shape and was the pre-agreed spec |
| `/perfil` placement | Separate `/perfil/colecciones` sub-page | Inline section in `/perfil/page.tsx` | Mirrors the `Guardados` precedent exactly; keeps `/perfil` diff minimal |
| Reorder UI | Deferred (schema keeps `orden`) | Ship up/down-arrow UI in slice 4 now | No direct precedent to adapt cheaply (`ArticulosList`'s pattern still needs porting); trims slice 4 scope without blocking future PATCH-reorder work (RLS already permits it via `FOR ALL`) |

## Data Flow

    [Publicacion detail page, SSR]
      auth.getUser() ─┐
                       ├─→ AgregarAColeccionButton (Client)
      GuardarButton ───┘         │
                                  ▼
                    GET /api/colecciones (list mine)
                                  │
                     user picks / inline-creates
                                  │
                                  ▼
              POST /api/colecciones/[id]/publicaciones
                                  │
                                  ▼
                   RLS: coleccion_publicacion_write
                    (EXISTS coleccion WHERE owner)
                                  │
                                  ▼
                      coleccion_publicacion row

    [SSR reads]
    /perfil/colecciones ──→ getMisColecciones(usuarioId) ──→ RLS (owner rows)
    /coleccion/[id]      ──→ getColeccion(id) [.maybeSingle()] ──→ RLS (public OR owner) ──→ notFound() if null

## Migration + Authorization SQL (GATED — apply via Supabase MCP only after explicit user approval; never blind SQL, never `service_role`)

```sql
-- Tables (additive)
create table public.coleccion (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  usuario_id uuid not null references public.usuario(id) on delete cascade,
  titulo text not null check (char_length(titulo) <= 100),
  descripcion text check (char_length(descripcion) <= 500),
  visibilidad text not null default 'privada' check (visibilidad in ('publica', 'privada')),
  creado_en timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table public.coleccion_publicacion (
  coleccion_id uuid not null references public.coleccion(id) on delete cascade,
  publicacion_id uuid not null references public.publicacion(id) on delete cascade,
  orden int not null default 0,
  agregado_en timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (coleccion_id, publicacion_id)
);

alter table public.coleccion enable row level security;
alter table public.coleccion_publicacion enable row level security;

-- coleccion: 4 policies
create policy coleccion_select on public.coleccion
  for select to anon, authenticated
  using (visibilidad = 'publica' or usuario_id = auth.uid());

create policy coleccion_insert on public.coleccion
  for insert to authenticated
  with check (usuario_id = auth.uid());

create policy coleccion_update on public.coleccion
  for update to authenticated
  using (usuario_id = auth.uid())
  with check (usuario_id = auth.uid());

create policy coleccion_delete on public.coleccion
  for delete to authenticated
  using (usuario_id = auth.uid());

-- coleccion_publicacion: 2 policies (parent-visibility subquery, mirrors publicacion_chunk.chunk_select/chunk_insert)
create policy coleccion_publicacion_select on public.coleccion_publicacion
  for select to anon, authenticated
  using (
    exists (
      select 1 from public.coleccion c
      where c.id = coleccion_publicacion.coleccion_id
        and (c.visibilidad = 'publica' or c.usuario_id = auth.uid())
    )
  );

create policy coleccion_publicacion_write on public.coleccion_publicacion
  for all to authenticated
  using (
    exists (
      select 1 from public.coleccion c
      where c.id = coleccion_publicacion.coleccion_id
        and c.usuario_id = auth.uid()
    )
  )
  with check (
    exists (
      select 1 from public.coleccion c
      where c.id = coleccion_publicacion.coleccion_id
        and c.usuario_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );
```

Non-blocking note (out of gated scope, do not add without separate authorization): consider `create index` on `coleccion(usuario_id)` and `coleccion_publicacion(publicacion_id)` later if query plans show scans — not part of this change's DDL.

## 4-Slice PR Breakdown

| Slice | Scope | Files (new unless noted) | Est. LOC | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S1 — Backend | Schema+RLS (MCP, gated) + DTOs + 7 endpoints + `lib/data` | `lib/types/database.ts` (modify, +~35), `lib/data/colecciones.ts`, `app/api/colecciones/route.ts`, `app/api/colecciones/[id]/route.ts`, `app/api/colecciones/[id]/publicaciones/route.ts`, `app/api/colecciones/[id]/publicaciones/[pubId]/route.ts` | 300-400 | — |
| S2 — Add-to-collection widget | Modal picker on publication detail | `components/publicacion/AgregarAColeccionButton.tsx`, `app/(main)/publicacion/[id]/page.tsx` (modify, ~L277) | 200-250 | S1 |
| S3 — Management sub-page | `/perfil/colecciones` list + edit/delete | `app/(main)/perfil/colecciones/page.tsx`, `components/perfil/ColeccionCard.tsx`, `app/(main)/perfil/page.tsx` (modify, +1 link) | 150-200 | S1 |
| S4 — Public page | `/coleccion/[id]` + metadata | `app/(main)/coleccion/[id]/page.tsx` (incl. `generateMetadata`) | 150-200 | S1 |

## New Component Design — `AgregarAColeccionButton`

Wraps `components/ui/Modal.tsx`, structurally close to `ReportarButton.tsx` (button+modal+form+`apiClient`) but with a list+toggle body like `ArticulosList.tsx`. States:

| State | Trigger | Render |
|---|---|---|
| `loading` | modal opens, `GET /api/colecciones` in flight | spinner |
| `empty` | 0 collections returned | "No collections yet" + inline create form |
| `list` | N collections returned | each row: name, visibility badge, add/remove toggle (already-member pre-checked via `coleccion_publicacion` membership check passed as prop or derived client-side) |
| `creating` | inline "new collection" submitted | optimistic row prepend, `POST /api/colecciones` then auto-`POST .../publicaciones` |
| `error` | any `ApiError` | inline message, row reverts (same optimistic-revert pattern as `GuardarButton`) |

Data flow: open → `apiClient<Coleccion[]>('/api/colecciones')` → toggle row → `apiClient(POST/DELETE '/api/colecciones/[id]/publicaciones[/[pubId]]')` → local state update (no full `router.refresh()` needed unless membership must reflect elsewhere).

## `lib/data/colecciones.ts`

```ts
export async function getMisColecciones(usuarioId: string): Promise<Coleccion[]>
// select explicit columns, .eq('usuario_id', usuarioId), .order('creado_en', {ascending:false})

export async function getColeccion(id: string): Promise<ColeccionDetalle | null>
// select with nested coleccion_publicacion(*, publicacion(id,titulo,resumen,tipo,usuario(id,nombre)))
// .eq('id', id).maybeSingle() — RLS filters private rows to null, caller does notFound()
```

DTOs (`lib/types/database.ts`, new `// Coleccion DTOs` section near line 124, mirrors `Guardado`/`RevistaArticulo`/`RevistaDetalle`):

```ts
export type VisibilidadColeccion = 'publica' | 'privada';

export interface Coleccion {
  id: string; usuario_id: string; titulo: string;
  descripcion: string | null; visibilidad: VisibilidadColeccion; creado_en: string;
}

export interface ColeccionPublicacion {
  coleccion_id: string; publicacion_id: string; orden: number; agregado_en: string;
  publicacion?: Pick<Publicacion, 'id' | 'titulo' | 'resumen' | 'tipo'> & { usuario?: Pick<Usuario, 'id' | 'nombre'> };
}

export type ColeccionDetalle = Coleccion & { coleccion_publicacion?: ColeccionPublicacion[] };

export interface ColeccionCardData {
  id: string; titulo: string; visibilidad: VisibilidadColeccion; total_publicaciones: number;
}
```

## Per-Endpoint Validation Contract

| Endpoint | Auth | Validation (400 `validation_error`) | Owner source | Success | Notable errors |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/colecciones` | required | `titulo` required, ≤100; `descripcion` ≤500 optional; `visibilidad` optional enum (default `privada`) | `usuario_id` = session | 201 `{data:Coleccion}` | 401 |
| `GET /api/colecciones` | required | — | filtered `usuario_id`=session | 200 `{data:Coleccion[]}` | 401 |
| `GET /api/colecciones/[id]` | optional | uuid `id` | RLS | 200 `{data:ColeccionDetalle}` / 404 (null from `.maybeSingle()`) | — |
| `PATCH /api/colecciones/[id]` | required | same field rules as POST, all optional | `.eq('usuario_id', session)` + RLS | 200 `{data:Coleccion}` | 401, 404 (0 rows) |
| `DELETE /api/colecciones/[id]` | required | uuid `id` | RLS | 200 `{data:null}` | 401, 404 (0 rows, explicit check) |
| `POST /api/colecciones/[id]/publicaciones` | required | `publicacion_id` required uuid | RLS (parent ownership) | 201 `{data:null}` | 401, 403 (RLS deny), 409 (dup PK) |
| `DELETE /api/colecciones/[id]/publicaciones/[pubId]` | required | uuid params | RLS | 200 `{data:null}` | 401, 404 (0 rows, explicit check per `guardado`/`tags` pattern) |

## Doc-Sync Targets

- `promts/Vitrina_BD_Conexion_Backend.md`: new §"coleccion / coleccion_publicacion" — tables, 6 policies, join-inherits-visibility pattern note.
- `promts/Vitrina_Especificaciones_APIs.md`: 7 endpoints, payloads, DTOs, status/error mapping table.
- `promts/Vitrina_Pantallas_Componentes.md`: `AgregarAColeccionButton` modal, `/perfil/colecciones`, `/coleccion/[id]`.
- `CLAUDE.md` §Arquitectura, new exception bullet (Spanish, matches existing bullet style):
  > **Excepción documentada (colecciones)**: el esquema se extendió de forma ADITIVA — tablas nuevas `coleccion` y `coleccion_publicacion` con RLS (lectura pública-u-propietario, escritura solo propietario, mismo patrón que `publicacion`/`publicacion_chunk`). Sin cambios en tablas, RLS o RPC existentes. `usuario_id` sigue viniendo de sesión. Aprobada explícitamente y aplicada vía Supabase MCP.

## Testing Strategy

| Layer | What to test | Approach |
|---|---|---|
| Type/lint | Each slice compiles cleanly | `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` + `pnpm lint` per slice before merge |
| RLS (negative, critical) | Non-owner reads private `coleccion`/`coleccion_publicacion` → 0 rows; cross-owner INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on `coleccion` or join → denied; anon reads public `coleccion` → visible; anon/other-user reads public collection's members → visible | Supabase MCP SQL as different roles, or `testsprite`/`webapp-testing` end-to-end against seeded users (María/Carlos/Laura) |
| API (positive) | Create/list/read/patch/delete lifecycle; add/remove membership; duplicate add → 409; DELETE non-owned join row → 404 | `testsprite` |
| UI | Modal states (loading/empty/list/create/error); sub-page edit/delete; public page `notFound()` on private+non-owner | `webapp-testing` (Playwright) manual smoke |

## Migration / Rollout

Gated: propose DDL above, apply only after explicit approval via Supabase MCP (`apply_migration`), then re-check with `get_advisors` for RLS gaps before S1 code lands. Rollback (self-contained, touches no existing table/policy): `drop table public.coleccion_publicacion; drop table public.coleccion;` (cascade drops the 6 policies). App-code rollback is per-slice file revert.

## Open Questions
None — all decisions locked by user; reorder-UI timing and index tuning are explicitly deferred, not blocking.

## Verification Report

**Change**: colecciones
**Mode**: Standard (Strict TDD OFF — no local test runner)

### Build & Type Check
`pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` → exit 0, zero output (PASS)
`pnpm lint` → exit 0, zero output (PASS)

### Security / RLS Static Review (highest priority)
- Owner ID always from `supabase.auth.getUser()`: confirmed in all 4 route files (POST/GET colecciones, PATCH/DELETE [id], POST publicaciones, DELETE [pubId]). Body never supplies `usuario_id`.
- No `service_role`/admin client anywhere in `app/api/colecciones/**` or `lib/data/colecciones.ts` (grep clean).
- Uniform envelope (`{data}` / `{error:{code,message}}`) via `jsonOk`/`handleError`/`unauthorized`/`validationError` throughout — matches `lib/supabase/handleError.ts` contract (23505→409, 42501→403, P0001→400 message preserved, no-JWT→401, own validation→400 `validation_error`).
- Explicit 404 on zero-row PATCH/DELETE `coleccion` and DELETE `coleccion_publicacion`: all three use `.maybeSingle()` + explicit `if (!data) return 404` — identical pattern to the pre-existing `app/api/guardados/[id]/route.ts` precedent (byte-for-byte structural match).
- No app-layer ownership duplication where RLS already enforces it: `POST /api/colecciones/[id]/publicaciones` inserts without an app-side owner check, relying on `coleccion_publicacion_write` RLS to deny non-owner inserts (documented inline: "Owner check is enforced by RLS... not duplicated here"). Matches project invariant (RLS+RPC is the security layer).
- `getColeccion` (`lib/data/colecciones.ts`) uses `.maybeSingle()`, not `.single()` — confirmed. `app/(main)/coleccion/[id]/page.tsx` calls `notFound()` when `data` is null — confirmed.
- `.order('orden', { referencedTable: 'coleccion_publicacion' })` — confirmed valid, matches pre-existing `lib/data/revistas.ts` identical usage.

### Spec Compliance Matrix (static evidence; DB-dependent scenarios marked UNVERIFIED-LIVE)
| Requirement | Scenario | Evidence | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Schema | New collection defaults to private | `coleccion_insert` sets `visibilidad ?? 'privada'`; DB default also `'privada'` (design SQL + BD doc §3.19) | ✅ COMPLIANT (static) |
| RLS — coleccion read | Owner reads own private | `coleccion_select` policy: `visibilidad='publica' OR usuario_id=auth.uid()` (confirmed in BD doc + design SQL) | ⚠️ UNVERIFIED-LIVE |
| RLS — coleccion read | Non-owner cannot read private | same policy | ⚠️ UNVERIFIED-LIVE |
| RLS — coleccion read | Anon reads public | same policy, `to anon, authenticated` | ⚠️ UNVERIFIED-LIVE |
| RLS — coleccion write | Non-owner update/delete denied | `coleccion_update`/`coleccion_delete` `usuario_id=auth.uid()` using+with check | ⚠️ UNVERIFIED-LIVE |
| RLS — coleccion_publicacion | Non-owner cannot list private members | `coleccion_publicacion_select` EXISTS subquery | ⚠️ UNVERIFIED-LIVE |
| RLS — coleccion_publicacion | Non-owner cannot insert into another's collection | `coleccion_publicacion_write` FOR ALL EXISTS subquery; app POST relies on this, no app-side check | ⚠️ UNVERIFIED-LIVE |
| Owner identity from session | Body-supplied usuario_id ignored | POST handler destructures body without usuario_id, always uses `user.id` | ✅ COMPLIANT (static) |
| Response envelope | Unauthenticated write → 401 | `unauthorized()` called first in every write handler before body parse | ✅ COMPLIANT (static) |
| Response envelope | Validation failure → 400 validation_error | titulo>100 check present in POST/PATCH | ✅ COMPLIANT (static) |
| Explicit 404 | DELETE join row non-owned/nonexistent → 404 | `.maybeSingle()` + explicit 404 block in `[pubId]/route.ts` | ✅ COMPLIANT (static) |
| Collection CRUD | Create succeeds → 201 | `jsonOk<Coleccion>(data, 201)` | ✅ COMPLIANT (static) |
| Collection CRUD | List returns only mine | `.eq('usuario_id', user.id)` in GET | ✅ COMPLIANT (static) |
| Collection CRUD | Read one, non-owner private → 404 | `getColeccion` `.maybeSingle()` → route returns `coleccionNotFound()` | ✅ COMPLIANT (static; RLS-dependent for correctness) |
| Collection CRUD | Owner update/delete → 200 | PATCH/DELETE `.eq('usuario_id', user.id)` + `.maybeSingle()` | ✅ COMPLIANT (static) |
| Membership | Owner adds publication → 201 | POST publicaciones route returns `jsonOk(null, 201)` | ✅ COMPLIANT (static) |
| Membership | Duplicate add → 409 | relies on composite PK unique violation → `handleError` 23505→409 | ✅ COMPLIANT (static) |
| Add-to-collection UI | User toggles membership | `AgregarAColeccionButton.tsx`: modal, list, add button, 409-as-success handling | ✅ COMPLIANT (static; no live browser smoke) |
| Management sub-page | Owner deletes from `/perfil/colecciones` | `ColeccionCard.tsx` DELETE + `router.refresh()` + optimistic hide | ✅ COMPLIANT (static; no live smoke) |
| Public collection page | Non-owner requests private → notFound() | `coleccion/[id]/page.tsx`: `if (!coleccion) notFound()` | ✅ COMPLIANT (static; no live smoke) |
| Public collection page | generateMetadata present | confirmed, mirrors `area/[slug]`, safe fallback for null case (no titulo leak) | ✅ COMPLIANT (static) |
| Documentation sync | Docs updated alongside schema | BD doc §3.19, APIs doc §19-20, Pantallas doc "Feature — Colecciones" (3 subsections), CLAUDE.md exception bullet — all confirmed present via grep | ✅ COMPLIANT |

**Compliance summary**: 15/21 scenarios statically COMPLIANT; 6/21 RLS negative/positive scenarios UNVERIFIED-LIVE (require DB-level testing, not source-inspectable).

### Correctness (Static Evidence)
| Requirement | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| DTOs (`lib/types/database.ts`) | ✅ Implemented | `VisibilidadColeccion`, `Coleccion`, `ColeccionPublicacion`, `ColeccionDetalle`, `ColeccionCardData` all present, match design shape exactly |
| `lib/data/colecciones.ts` | ✅ Implemented | `getMisColecciones`, `getColeccion` (`.maybeSingle()`) match design signatures |
| 7 endpoints | ✅ Implemented | All present, correct verbs/paths, correct status codes |
| 3 UI surfaces | ✅ Implemented | Widget, `/perfil/colecciones`, `/coleccion/[id]` all present and wired |
| `ColeccionCardData` type | ⚠️ Defined but unused | Declared in DTOs (design artifact) but no code references `total_publicaciones`/member-count badge — matches documented deviation (member-count badge omitted) |

### Coherence (Design)
| Decision | Followed? | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Single PERMISSIVE `coleccion_select` policy | ✅ Yes | Confirmed in BD doc §3.19, matches design SQL |
| `coleccion_publicacion` SELECT via EXISTS subquery | ✅ Yes | Confirmed |
| `coleccion_publicacion_write` single FOR ALL policy | ✅ Yes | Confirmed |
| `GET /api/colecciones` as 7th endpoint (list-mine) | ✅ Yes | Present, used by widget via `apiClient` |
| `.maybeSingle()` for private-read 404 | ✅ Yes | Confirmed in `getColeccion` |
| `[pubId]` path segment for join-row DELETE | ✅ Yes | Confirmed |
| `/perfil/colecciones` separate sub-page | ✅ Yes | Confirmed, mirrors `/perfil/guardados` |
| Reorder UI deferred | ✅ Yes | No reorder controls in `ColeccionCard`/public page; `orden` column present and used only for read-order |
| 4-slice PR breakdown | ✅ Yes | Apply-progress confirms all 4 slices independently completed and verified (tsc+lint each pass) |

### Deviations Reported by apply-progress (accepted as documented, non-blocking)
1. No `CompartirButton`/share affordance on public page — scoped exclusion per task literal instruction, trivial follow-up.
2. No custom empty-state for zero-member collection — reuses `FeedList`'s existing default empty state (pre-existing UX quirk, not introduced by this change).
3. Owner name via second `getPerfil(usuario_id)` call rather than embedding in `ColeccionDetalle` — correct, since it can't be parallelized with `getColeccion` (depends on its result) and avoids re-touching verified Slice 1 code. `getPerfil` uses `.single()` but this is safe: `coleccion.usuario_id` is FK-constrained to always exist in `usuario`, and profile SELECT is public (not owner-gated), so no PGRST116 risk.
4. `ColeccionCardData` DTO (member-count badge) defined in design but not consumed anywhere in code — dead type, harmless, matches accepted "add-only widget" scope reduction.

All 4 deviations are ACCEPTABLE: none break a spec requirement, all are explicitly reasoned in apply-progress, and none introduce a security or correctness gap.

### Issues Found
**CRITICAL**: None.

**WARNING**:
- 6 RLS scenarios (owner/non-owner/anon read on `coleccion` and `coleccion_publicacion`, cross-owner write denial) are UNVERIFIED-LIVE. Static review confirms the policy SQL is correctly shaped and matches proven precedents (`publicacion`/`publicacion_chunk`, `revista_articulo`), and `get_advisors` (security) already ran clean post-migration per the trusted context — but no query was run as a non-owner/anon session in this verify pass (no DB/browser tool access in this agent's toolset). This is the single most important residual risk for an authorization-centric feature and should be closed before archive if a Supabase-MCP or webapp-testing pass is available to the orchestrator.
- No live browser/Playwright smoke test was run for any of the 3 UI surfaces (modal states, management CRUD lifecycle, public page notFound/render branches). tsc/lint prove the code compiles and lints, not that it renders/behaves correctly at runtime.
- `ColeccionCardData` type is defined but dead code (unused) — cosmetic, not a defect.

**SUGGESTION**:
- Consider removing the unused `ColeccionCardData` type or wiring the member-count badge it was designed for, to avoid DTO/implementation drift.
- Consider adding `CompartirButton` to `/coleccion/[id]` for consistency with `/publicacion/[id]` and `/usuario/[id]` (both public-facing pages that support sharing).

### Verdict
**PASS WITH WARNINGS** — all 20/20 tasks complete, tsc/lint clean, full static security/spec review shows no code-level authorization gap (owner-from-session, no service_role, no app-layer ownership duplication, correct explicit-404 pattern, uniform envelope). The two WARNINGs are entirely about missing LIVE runtime evidence (RLS negative-path testing and UI smoke testing) rather than any defect found in the implementation — this is expected for a change developed without dev-server/DB-query access in the apply/verify agents' toolset, and was explicitly deferred to this phase in apply-progress. Recommend one live-RLS pass (Supabase MCP as different seeded users, or `testsprite`) before archive to convert those 6 UNVERIFIED-LIVE scenarios to COMPLIANT.

### Still-Unverified Live RLS Cases (explicit list for orchestrator follow-up)
1. Owner (María) reads her own private `coleccion` → row returned.
2. Non-owner (Carlos) reads María's private `coleccion` → 0 rows / app 404.
3. Anon (no session) reads a public `coleccion` → row returned.
4. Non-owner (Carlos) attempts UPDATE/DELETE on María's `coleccion` → denied, 0 rows affected → app 404/403.
5. Non-owner (Carlos) queries `coleccion_publicacion` for María's private collection → 0 rows.
6. Non-owner (Carlos) POSTs `/api/colecciones/[maria's id]/publicaciones` → RLS denies insert → app returns 403 via `handleError('42501')`.

Suggested method: Supabase MCP `execute_sql` impersonating different JWTs, or `webapp-testing`/`testsprite` end-to-end against seeded users (María `m.garcia@uaq.mx`, Carlos `c.romo@unam.mx`, both pass `Archicom123!`).
