observations.title: sdd/compartir-og/explore
observations.content:
## Exploration: compartir-og (Open Graph sharing cards, "nivel básico")

### CRITICAL library verdict (source: node_modules/next@16.2.9 bundled docs + compiled source, cross-checked with web search — context7 MCP tool was not exposed in this session)

- **`@vercel/og` as a new dependency is WRONG and unnecessary.** `next/og` is built into the `next` package itself: `node_modules/next/og.js` → `module.exports = require('./dist/server/og/image-response')`. package.json has no `@vercel/og` entry — confirmed not a dependency, don't add one.
- `next/dist/server/og/image-response.js` shows `ImageResponse` internally does `import(process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME === 'edge' ? '.../@vercel/og/index.edge.js' : '.../@vercel/og/index.node.js')` — Next vendors a compiled copy of `@vercel/og` and auto-picks the edge or node build based on runtime. **No forced runtime.** Default (nodejs) route runtime works fine; you MAY opt into `export const runtime = 'edge'` per-route but it's optional. This is independent of `proxy.ts` (which must stay nodejs per project invariant) — route-level runtime config doesn't touch proxy.ts.
- **Font**: no font file is required for the "nivel básico" scope. Satori/`@vercel/og` falls back to a bundled default font (Noto Sans family) when no `fonts` option is passed to `ImageResponse`. Noto Sans covers Latin-1 supplement, so Spanish accents (á é í ó ú) and ñ render correctly out of the box. Confirmed via web search (npm/@vercel/og docs + satori issues), not just training data.
- **File shape — two options, both work, recommend the file convention:**
  1. **`app/(main)/publicacion/[id]/opengraph-image.tsx`** (Next file convention, RECOMMENDED). Default-exports an async `Image({ params })` function returning `new ImageResponse(...)`; exports `alt`, `size = {width:1200, height:630}`, `contentType = 'image/png'`. Next auto-injects `og:image*` meta tags — no manual wiring into `generateMetadata`. `params` is `Promise<{ id: string }>` in Next 16 (breaking change vs 15: params is now always a promise here too). Statically optimized (generated at build/cached) unless it reads request-time APIs. Colocating inside the `(main)` route group works fine — route groups don't affect file-convention resolution (docs example uses `app/blog/[slug]/opengraph-image.tsx`, same dynamic-segment shape as `app/(main)/publicacion/[id]/`).
  2. **Manual `app/api/og/[id]/route.tsx`** (prompt1.md's proposed shape) returning `new ImageResponse(...)` from a plain Route Handler, then manually setting `openGraph.images: [absoluteUrl]` in `generateMetadata`. Works, but requires manually building an ABSOLUTE url (relative paths in `openGraph.images` need `metadataBase` set on root layout, which is currently UNSET — see below) and duplicates wiring that option 1 gets for free.
  - **Caveat on option 1**: file-convention `opengraph-image.tsx` only feeds `openGraph.images`, NOT `twitter.images` automatically — Twitter/X card image needs either a sibling `twitter-image.tsx` (can reuse the same generation logic) or an explicit `twitter: { card: 'summary_large_image', images: [...] }` block in `generateMetadata`. Flag this as a propose-phase decision: reuse the same image function for both conventions, or hand-roll the twitter metadata block pointing at the same URL.

### Current State

- `app/(main)/publicacion/[id]/page.tsx` (352 lines) has **NO `generateMetadata`** today — confirmed by full read, only a default async Server Component. It fetches via `getPublicacion(id)` from `lib/data/publicaciones.ts:37-49`:
  ```ts
  supabase.from('publicacion')
    .select('*, usuario(id, nombre), comentario(*, usuario(id, nombre)), publicacion_tag(*, tag(*))')
    .eq('id', id).single()
  ```
  Returns `PublicacionDetalle` with `titulo`, `resumen`, `tipo`, `usuario.nombre` (author), `publicacion_tag[].tag` (includes `tag.area`, `tag.nombre`). This is exactly the data both the OG image and `generateMetadata` need — no new query shape required, can reuse/duplicate this call (React `cache()` memoization pattern is documented in Next 16 docs as the way to dedupe calls between `generateMetadata` and the page/opengraph-image, but `getPublicacion` is not currently wrapped in `cache()`).
  There is already a `<CompartirButton path={...} label="Compartir" />` (line 287) — this is an UNRELATED existing feature (clipboard-copy the URL, `components/ui/CompartirButton.tsx`), not an OG/link-preview mechanism. compartir-og complements it, doesn't replace it.

- `app/(main)/area/[slug]/page.tsx:23-37` — exact `generateMetadata` precedent:
  ```ts
  export async function generateMetadata({ params }: AreaPageProps): Promise<Metadata> {
    const { slug } = await params
    const area = SLUG_TO_AREA[slug]
    if (!area) return {}
    const siteUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL ?? 'https://vitrina.vercel.app'
    return {
      title: `${area} — Vitrina`,
      description: `Explora publicaciones académicas de ${area} creadas por la comunidad en Vitrina.`,
      alternates: { canonical: `${siteUrl}/area/${slug}` },
    }
  }
  ```
  Same pattern repeated in `app/(main)/coleccion/[id]/page.tsx:19-40`. **Neither page emits `openGraph` or `twitter` fields today** — only `title`/`description`/`alternates.canonical`. So compartir-og is NOT purely mirroring an existing openGraph shape; it sets a NEW precedent for `openGraph`/`twitter` metadata in this codebase, while reusing the exact `siteUrl` fallback pattern.

- **`NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL`**: referenced in 6 places — `app/sitemap.ts:7`, `app/robots.ts:3`, `app/(main)/coleccion/[id]/page.tsx:30`, `app/(main)/area/[slug]/page.tsx:28` (all with fallback `?? 'https://vitrina.vercel.app'`), plus `app/api/auth/signup/route.ts:28` and `app/api/auth/resend/route.ts:21` (no fallback, used raw for `emailRedirectTo`). **No `.env.local.example` file exists in the repo** (glob returned nothing) despite CLAUDE.md's "Estructura objetivo" listing it — minor pre-existing doc/reality drift, not caused by this change, worth a one-line mention if convenient but not blocking.

- **Type badge / colors**: `lib/constants/publicaciones.ts:22-45` — `TIPO_META: Record<TipoPublicacion, {label, tone, categoria}>`, e.g. `articulo: {label:'Artículo', tone:'success', categoria:'texto'}`. `tone` is a `BadgeTone` (`'neutral'|'info'|'success'|'warning'|'danger'|'accent'`) consumed by `components/ui/Badge.tsx:11-18` as Tailwind classes (`bg-info-bg text-info`, etc.) — **these Tailwind classes will NOT work inside `ImageResponse`/Satori** (Satori only understands inline `style` objects / a CSS subset, no Tailwind/className resolution, no `display:grid`). The OG image must reimplement the tone→color mapping as literal hex values. Exact hex source: `app/globals.css:28-41` `@theme` tokens, e.g. `--color-info:#1d6fa4 / --color-info-bg:#e8f3fa`, `--color-success:#1a6b3a / #e6f4ec`, `--color-warning:#92610a / #fdf3df`, `--color-danger:#c0392b / #fdecea`, `--color-neutral:#5a5652 / #f0ede9`, `--color-accent:#6b4d9a / #f0ebfa`. A small `TONE_HEX: Record<BadgeTone, {fg,bg}>` inline constant (new, small) is the cleanest way to bridge this without duplicating logic per-tipo.
  - **No per-area color map exists.** `lib/constants/areas.ts` only has `AREA_TO_SLUG`/`SLUG_TO_AREA` (6 curated areas → slugs), no colors. prompt1.md's "fondo con el color del área/tag" has no existing data source — the OG image background color must derive from `tipo`'s `tone` (already mapped) rather than `area`, or a new area→color map must be invented in propose. Flag as an open decision for sdd-propose.

- **Root layout / existing OG**: `app/layout.tsx:27-33` has only `metadata: Metadata = { title: {default,template}, description }` — **no `metadataBase`, no `opengraph-image` file anywhere in `app/`** (glob for `**/opengraph-image*` only matched the vendored Next.js docs file, not project code). No prior OG image infra to be consistent with/avoid duplicating — this is a greenfield addition. **Recommend setting `metadataBase` in `app/layout.tsx`** (e.g. `new URL(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL ?? 'https://vitrina.vercel.app')`) regardless of which route-shape option is chosen, to avoid Next's "metadata.metadataBase is not set" build warning and to make any relative OG/twitter image URLs resolve correctly.

### Effort check

Confirms prompt1.md's "bajo" (low) effort: 2 files (1 new `opengraph-image.tsx` ~70-100 lines, 1 edit to `page.tsx` adding `generateMetadata` ~20-30 lines), optionally +1 line `metadataBase` in `app/layout.tsx`, zero schema/RLS/RPC changes. Well under the 400-line PR review budget. Per CLAUDE.md's mandatory doc-sync rule, `promts/Vitrina_Pantallas_Componentes.md` and/or `Vitrina_Especificaciones_APIs.md` should get a short note describing the new metadata/OG behavior in the same change.

### Recommendation

Use `app/(main)/publicacion/[id]/opengraph-image.tsx` (Next file convention) over the manual `app/api/og/[id]/route.tsx` from prompt1.md — same `next/og` API either way, but the file convention auto-wires `og:image*` tags with zero manual URL construction, is per-publication dynamic via `params`, and is statically optimizable. Add `generateMetadata` to `page.tsx` mirroring `area/[slug]`'s exact `siteUrl`/`title`/`alternates.canonical` shape, extended with `description` from `resumen` and (new precedent) `twitter: { card: 'summary_large_image' }`. Reimplement `TIPO_META` tone→color as literal hex (from `globals.css` tokens) inside the image function — do not attempt to reuse `TipoBadge`/`Badge` components directly (Tailwind classes don't render under Satori). No new npm dependency.

### Risks

- Twitter/X card image needs explicit `twitter-image.tsx` or `twitter` metadata block — file convention alone only covers `openGraph`, easy to forget and ship an OG card that works on WhatsApp/Facebook but not X.
- No area→color data source exists; if prompt1.md's "color del área" is taken literally, propose must either invent an area color map (scope creep beyond "bajo") or fall back to tipo `tone` (recommended, no new data needed).
- `metadataBase` is unset repo-wide; if propose picks the manual-route path with a relative image URL, this will emit a build-time warning and can misresolve outside Vercel's `VERCEL_URL` inference.
- `getPublicacion` is not `cache()`-wrapped, so `generateMetadata` + `opengraph-image.tsx` + the page component will independently issue the same Supabase query per request unless deliberately deduped — acceptable for low effort but worth a one-line mention in propose.

### Ready for Proposal

Yes. No blockers, no schema/RLS involvement, library question fully resolved (no new dependency, `next/og` built-in, no font file needed, nodejs runtime default is fine).

observations.title: sdd/compartir-og/proposal
observations.content:
# Proposal: compartir-og — Open Graph social cards for publication detail

## Intent
Pasted publication links (WhatsApp, X, Facebook, Slack) render today as bare URLs — no title, image, or context — so shared works look untrustworthy and earn fewer clicks. Add per-`publicacion` rich link previews (dynamic OG image + social metadata) on the detail page so sharing looks credible. Lowest-effort, most isolated of prompt1.md's 4 changes: NO schema, RLS, RPC, or new npm dependency.

## Scope
### In Scope
- Dynamic per-`publicacion` OG image via Next file convention `app/(main)/publicacion/[id]/opengraph-image.tsx` (`next/og` `ImageResponse`, built into next@16.2.9).
- `generateMetadata` on the detail page: title, description (from `resumen`), `openGraph` (type/title/description), `alternates.canonical` — reusing the `area/[slug]` `siteUrl` fallback pattern.
- Twitter/X coverage via sibling `twitter-image.tsx` re-exporting the same image (auto-wires `twitter:image` + `summary_large_image`).
- Root `metadataBase` in `app/layout.tsx` (relative image URL resolution, kills build warning).
- Wrap `getPublicacion` in React `cache()` to dedupe the 3 identical queries (page + metadata + image).

### Out of Scope
- OG for other routes (`/coleccion`, `/area`, `/usuario`) — deferred.
- Downloadable "story"/share image (prompt1.md "nivel avanzado") — deferred.
- Per-area color map / custom font file — unnecessary at this scope.

## Capabilities
### New
- `og-social-cards`: per-publication link-preview image + social metadata on the detail page.
### Modified
- None.

## Approach
File convention over manual `api/og/[id]/route.tsx` (auto-wires `og:image*`, no manual absolute URL, statically optimizable). Satori ignores Tailwind → reimplement `TIPO_META.tone` → literal hex (from `globals.css` `@theme` tokens) as a small inline `TONE_HEX` map; accent/background derive from `tipo` tone (no area color source exists). Default `nodejs` runtime; Noto Sans fallback covers ñ/accents — no font file, no `@vercel/og`.

## Affected Areas
| Area | Impact | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `app/(main)/publicacion/[id]/opengraph-image.tsx` | New | Dynamic 1200x630 image |
| `app/(main)/publicacion/[id]/twitter-image.tsx` | New | Re-export for X card |
| `app/(main)/publicacion/[id]/page.tsx` | Modified | Add `generateMetadata` |
| `app/layout.tsx` | Modified | Add `metadataBase` |
| `lib/data/publicaciones.ts` | Modified | `cache()`-wrap `getPublicacion` |
| `promts/Vitrina_Pantallas_Componentes.md` | Modified | Doc-sync (new OG/metadata behavior). No API-doc entry — file convention adds no endpoint. |

## Risks
| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| Ship OG working on WhatsApp/FB but not X | Low | `twitter-image.tsx` sibling in scope |
| Crawler has no session → RLS anon; blocked/non-public pubs won't render a card | Low | Expected; serve Next fallback, verify with a public seed pub |
| Long `titulo` / empty `resumen` overflow image | Low | Clamp lines + truncate description in spec |

## Rollback
Delete the 2 new files; revert `generateMetadata`, `metadataBase`, and the `cache()` wrap. No data/schema to undo.

## Success Criteria
- [ ] Public pub URL passes a link-preview validator (title + image + description).
- [ ] X renders `summary_large_image`.
- [ ] No "metadataBase not set" build warning.

## Open decisions (product — for spec/design)
- `recomendacion` tipo: card author = recommender (`usuario.nombre`) or external work author (`obra_autor_externo`)?
- Blocked (`bloqueada=true`) pubs: render a share card or suppress?

observations.title: sdd/compartir-og/spec
observations.content:
# og-social-cards Specification

## Purpose
Per-publication rich link previews (dynamic OG image + social metadata) on the publication detail page, so links shared to WhatsApp/X/Facebook/Slack render a title, image, and description instead of a bare URL.

## Requirements

### Requirement: Dynamic OG Image
The system MUST generate a 1200x630 PNG per public `publicacion` via `app/(main)/publicacion/[id]/opengraph-image.tsx` using `next/og`'s `ImageResponse`, showing `titulo`, author, a `tipo` badge tinted with that tipo's tone accent color, and "Vitrina" branding.

#### Scenario: Public publication renders card
- GIVEN a `publicacion` id that exists and is not `bloqueada`
- WHEN the OG image route is requested
- THEN the response is a 1200x630 PNG showing `titulo`, author, a tipo-tone-accented badge, and "Vitrina" branding
- AND Spanish accented characters (á é í ó ú ñ) render correctly

#### Scenario: Long titulo or missing resumen do not overflow
- GIVEN a `publicacion` with an unusually long `titulo` or empty `resumen`
- WHEN the OG image is generated
- THEN `titulo` is line-clamped and the layout stays within the 1200x630 canvas without overflow or crash

### Requirement: Suppressed Cards for Non-Public Publications
The system MUST NOT expose data for a blocked or non-existent `publicacion` in the OG image or metadata, and MUST fall back to Next's default image/metadata instead.

#### Scenario: Blocked publication suppressed
- GIVEN a `publicacion` with `bloqueada = true`
- WHEN the OG image or metadata routes run anonymously
- THEN RLS returns no row and the system serves the default fallback image and generic metadata, without leaking the blocked `titulo`, author, or `resumen`

#### Scenario: Non-existent publication id suppressed
- GIVEN a `publicacion` id that does not exist
- WHEN the OG image or metadata routes are requested
- THEN the system serves the default fallback image and generic metadata without error

### Requirement: Social Metadata on Detail Page
The publication detail page MUST implement `generateMetadata` emitting `openGraph` (title, description, images, `type: 'article'`, url) and `twitter` (`card: 'summary_large_image'`, images) for public publications.

#### Scenario: Metadata for a public publication
- GIVEN a public, non-blocked `publicacion`
- WHEN `generateMetadata` runs for its detail page
- THEN `openGraph.title` equals `titulo`, `openGraph.description` is a truncated `resumen`, `openGraph.type` is `'article'`, `openGraph.url` is the canonical absolute URL, `openGraph.images`/`twitter.images` reference the OG image route, and `twitter.card` equals `'summary_large_image'`

#### Scenario: Metadata for a suppressed publication
- GIVEN a blocked or non-existent `publicacion` id
- WHEN `generateMetadata` runs
- THEN it returns minimal safe metadata (no `titulo`, author, or `resumen`) and does not throw

### Requirement: Author Attribution for Recomendacion
For `tipo = 'recomendacion'` publications, the OG image and metadata author line MUST use `obra_autor_externo` when present, else fall back to the recommender's `usuario.nombre`.

#### Scenario: Recomendacion with external author
- GIVEN a `recomendacion` publication with non-null `obra_autor_externo`
- WHEN the card is generated
- THEN the author line displays `obra_autor_externo`

#### Scenario: Recomendacion without external author
- GIVEN a `recomendacion` publication with null `obra_autor_externo`
- WHEN the card is generated
- THEN the author line displays the recommender's `usuario.nombre`

### Requirement: Absolute Metadata Base
The root layout MUST declare `metadataBase` from `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL` (fallback `https://vitrina.vercel.app`) so relative OG/twitter image URLs resolve absolutely and the "metadataBase not set" build warning does not occur.

#### Scenario: Build with metadataBase set
- GIVEN `app/layout.tsx` declares `metadataBase`
- WHEN the app is built
- THEN no "metadataBase not set" warning is emitted and image URLs in emitted metadata are absolute

### Requirement: Deduplicated Publication Fetch
`getPublicacion` in `lib/data/publicaciones.ts` MUST be wrapped in React `cache()` so the page component, `generateMetadata`, and `opengraph-image.tsx` share a single Supabase query per request.

#### Scenario: Single query per request
- GIVEN a request for a publication detail page
- WHEN the page, `generateMetadata`, and the OG image route all call `getPublicacion` with the same id during that request
- THEN only one Supabase query executes for that id

### Requirement: Documentation Sync
`promts/Vitrina_Pantallas_Componentes.md` MUST be updated in the same change to describe the new share-card/OG behavior on the publication detail page.

#### Scenario: Docs reflect new behavior
- GIVEN the og-social-cards change is applied
- WHEN `promts/Vitrina_Pantallas_Componentes.md` is reviewed
- THEN it documents the OG image, twitter card, and metadata behavior for the publication detail page

observations.title: sdd/compartir-og/design
observations.content:
# Design: compartir-og — Open Graph social cards for publication detail ## Technical Approach Next file convention (`opengraph-image.tsx` / `twitter-image.tsx`) + `next/og` `ImageResponse` (built into next@16.2.9, nodejs runtime, no font file, no new dep). `generateMetadata` in the detail page owns text tags (title/description/canonical/openGraph/twitter) and DELEGATES all image tags to the file convention (avoids double `og:image`/`twitter:image`). `getPublicacion` wrapped in React `cache()` dedupes page+metadata within one request. Security is RLS-anon: crawlers are unauthenticated, so blocked/private pubs return null → generic fallback card. No schema/RLS/RPC/dependency change. ~90-130 LOC. ## Architecture Decisions | Decision | Choice | Rejected | Rationale | |---|---|---|---| | Image delivery | Next file-convention `opengraph-image.tsx` inside `(main)/publicacion/[id]/` | manual `api/og/[id]/route.tsx` | Auto-wires `og:image*` meta, no manual absolute URL, per-`id` dynamic via `params`. Route groups don't affect resolution. | | Twitter card | sibling `twitter-image.tsx` re-exporting the OG default | inline `twitter.images` in generateMetadata | One image function, both conventions; can't ship OG-without-X. | | Image ownership | file convention owns `og:image`/`twitter:image`; generateMetadata sets ONLY title/description/url/canonical | also set `openGraph.images` | Prevents duplicate image tags. | | Colors | new inline `TONE_HEX: Record` literal-hex map from globals.css `@theme` | reuse `Badge`/`TipoBadge` | Satori ignores Tailwind classes; needs inline hex. | | Blocked/missing | `if (!data || data.bloqueada) return fallback` in image AND `return {}` in metadata | rely on RLS null only | Defense-in-depth vs titulo leak; honors locked "no leak" intent. | | Dedup | `cache()`-wrap `getPublicacion` | leave 2-3 duplicate queries | React per-request memo; dedupes page render + generateMetadata (image routes are separate requests — expected). | ## File Changes | File | Action | Description | |---|---|---| | `app/(main)/publicacion/[id]/opengraph-image.tsx` | Create | 1200x630 dynamic ImageResponse | | `app/(main)/publicacion/[id]/twitter-image.tsx` | Create | Re-export OG image + own `alt` | | `app/(main)/publicacion/[id]/page.tsx` | Modify | Add `generateMetadata` + `import type { Metadata }` | | `app/layout.tsx` | Modify | Add `metadataBase` to root `metadata` | | `lib/data/publicaciones.ts` | Modify | `cache()`-wrap `getPublicacion` | | `promts/Vitrina_Pantallas_Componentes.md` | Modify | Doc-sync note (no API-doc entry — file convention adds no endpoint) | ## Interfaces / Code ### TONE_HEX (from app/globals.css light @theme) ```ts const TONE_HEX: Record = { info: { fg: '#1d6fa4', bg: '#e8f3fa' }, success: { fg: '#1a6b3a', bg: '#e6f4ec' }, warning: { fg: '#92610a', bg: '#fdf3df' }, danger: { fg: '#c0392b', bg: '#fdecea' }, accent: { fg: '#6b4d9a', bg: '#f0ebfa' }, neutral: { fg: '#5a5652', bg: '#f0ede9' }, } // base tokens: text #1c1917, text-muted #6b6560, surface-muted #f7f5f2, brand teal #1a6b5e ``` ### opengraph-image.tsx (skeleton — Satori needs explicit display:'flex' on multi-child divs) ```tsx import { ImageResponse } from 'next/og' import { getPublicacion } from '@/lib/data/publicaciones' import { TIPO_META } from '@/lib/constants/publicaciones' import type { BadgeTone } from '@/components/ui/Badge' export const alt = 'Vista previa de la publicación en Vitrina' export const size = { width: 1200, height: 630 } export const contentType = 'image/png' const TONE_HEX: Record = { /* see above */ } const clip = (s: string, n: number) => (s.length > n ? s.slice(0, n).trimEnd() + '…' : s) function Fallback() { return (
Vitrina
Portafolio académico
) } export default async function Image({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) { const { id } = await params const { data } = await getPublicacion(id) if (!data || data.bloqueada) return new ImageResponse(, { ...size }) const meta = TIPO_META[data.tipo] const tone = TONE_HEX[meta.tone] const autor = data.obra_autor_externo ?? data.usuario?.nombre ?? 'Autor desconocido' return new ImageResponse( (
{meta.label}
Vitrina
{clip(data.titulo, 80)}
{clip(data.resumen, 160)}
Por {autor}
), { ...size } ) } ``` ### twitter-image.tsx (exact Next 16 shape) ```tsx export { default, size, contentType } from './opengraph-image' export const alt = 'Vista previa de la publicación en Vitrina' ``` (Re-export default+size+contentType; declare own `alt` — cannot re-export and redeclare the same name.) ### generateMetadata in page.tsx (mirror area/[slug], no images) ```tsx import type { Metadata } from 'next' export async function generateMetadata({ params }: PublicacionPageProps): Promise { const { id } = await params const { data } = await getPublicacion(id) if (!data || data.bloqueada) return {} const siteUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL ?? 'https://vitrina.vercel.app' const url = `${siteUrl}/publicacion/${id}` const description = data.resumen.length > 160 ? data.resumen.slice(0, 160).trimEnd() + '…' : data.resumen return { title: data.titulo, description, alternates: { canonical: url }, openGraph: { title: data.titulo, description, type: 'article', url }, twitter: { card: 'summary_large_image', title: data.titulo, description }, } } ``` Reuses existing `PublicacionPageProps` (line 31) + `getPublicacion` (already imported). ### app/layout.tsx metadataBase (one line into existing metadata export) ```ts export const metadata: Metadata = { metadataBase: new URL(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL ?? 'https://vitrina.vercel.app'), title: { default: 'Vitrina', template: '%s | Vitrina' }, description: 'Portafolio académico', } ``` ### lib/data/publicaciones.ts cache() wrap (no call-site breaks) ```ts import { cache } from 'react' export const getPublicacion = cache(async ( id: string ): Promise<{ data: PublicacionDetalle | null; error: unknown }> => { const supabase = await createClient() const { data, error } = await supabase .from('publicacion') .select('*, usuario(id, nombre), comentario(*, usuario(id, nombre)), publicacion_tag(*, tag(*))') .eq('id', id).single() return { data: data as PublicacionDetalle | null, error } }) ``` Same name/signature; `page.tsx` `import { getPublicacion }` unchanged. Reads cookies via createClient → image route is dynamic (per-request RLS), which is the desired security property. ## Data Flow ``` Crawler GET /publicacion/[id] → generateMetadata + page (1 request, cache() dedupes getPublicacion) Crawler GET /publicacion/[id]/opengraph-image → Image() (separate anon request → RLS) Crawler GET /publicacion/[id]/twitter-image → re-export → same Image() getPublicacion(id) → RLS: public row → styled card | null/bloqueada → Fallback ``` ## Testing Strategy | Layer | What | How | |---|---|---| | Type | compile | `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` | | Lint | style | `pnpm lint` | | Manual | image renders | GET `/publicacion//opengraph-image` → 200 image/png (5 public seed pubs) | | Manual | tags present | view-source of detail page shows `og:*`/`twitter:*` (title/desc/url/image), no duplicate image tags | | Manual | no leak | nonexistent/blocked id → fallback card + `{}` metadata (no titulo) | | Manual | no build warning | `pnpm build` has no "metadataBase not set" | ## Doc-sync `promts/Vitrina_Pantallas_Componentes.md`: short note on OG/link-preview behavior for the publication detail screen. No `Vitrina_Especificaciones_APIs.md` entry (file convention adds no endpoint). No CLAUDE.md schema bullet (no DB change). ## Migration / Rollout No migration. Rollback: delete the 2 new files; revert generateMetadata, metadataBase, cache() wrap. ## Open Questions - None blocking. Truncation lengths (80 titulo / 160 resumen) are tunable in apply.

observations.title: sdd/notificaciones-email-resend/explore
observations.content:
## Exploration: notificaciones-email-resend

### Current State

No email-notification infrastructure exists today: no `resend` npm dependency, no `supabase/functions/` directory locally (Supabase project is remote-managed, migrations applied via `mcp__supabase__apply_migration`), no `RESEND_API_KEY` anywhere, no Supabase Database Webhooks documented in `Vitrina_BD_Conexion_Backend.md`. `app/api/auth/resend/route.ts` is unrelated — it's Supabase Auth's `supabase.auth.resend({type:'signup'})` confirmation-email resend, not the Resend provider. This is a greenfield feature.

The source prompt (`prompts/prompt/prompt1.md`) is internally coherent but was written without checking the real schema/invariants. Four load-bearing errors, all verified directly against code/docs:

1. **`service_role` in both new Edge Functions (§2.2 step 3, §7.1)** — forbidden by CLAUDE.md's hard invariant "CERO `service_role` / `admin.ts`". Confirmed: `Vitrina_BD_Conexion_Backend.md` §7.4 states explicitly "Este proyecto no la usa (todo corre con el JWT del usuario)" and CLAUDE.md says "Si crees necesitar `service_role`, detente y pregunta." User already chose a zero-service_role redesign for this change.
2. **Table name `solicitud`** (§2.2 Type B, §3 Webhook 2, §6.1 step 2) — does not exist. Verified via grep on `Vitrina_BD_Conexion_Backend.md`: the real table is `solicitud_revista` (line 79 table list, RLS/RPC section lines 106-260). There's also a *second*, unrelated `solicitud_mensaje` table (line 86, full schema at lines 599-668) for message requests — Type A of the prompt actually targets the right table name for that one.
3. **`usuario.email` readable via RLS** (§2.2 step 3, §7.1 "buscar el usuario destinatario") — false. Verified `Vitrina_BD_Conexion_Backend.md` line 1042: "ni `anon` ni `authenticated` tienen `SELECT` sobre `usuario.email`... PostgREST respeta los privilegios de columna." `usuario` already has a public row-level SELECT policy (`lectura_publica`, confirmed via §3.19/§3.20 cross-references: "cubierta por las políticas existentes de usuario: lectura pública, escritura solo del propio dueño"), so adding a *row* policy for email access (as prompt implies) would do nothing — the block is a *column* GRANT, a completely different mechanism. This is the same footgun class documented in the `ciudad` incident (§3.19, 2026-07-09): column-level grants must be added explicitly per new column, independent of row RLS.
4. **46-municipio enum for `ciudad`** (§5.1 "Por ciudad" dropdown) — false. Verified `Vitrina_BD_Conexion_Backend.md` §3.19: `usuario.ciudad` is `text NULL, CHECK (char_length(ciudad) <= 50)`, free text, same pattern as `institucion`/`carrera`, added in migration `add_ciudad_to_usuario` (2026-07-08). No enum, no FK, no fixed municipio list exists anywhere in the schema. A "by city" recipient filter must resolve against whatever free-text values actually exist in the data (e.g. `SELECT DISTINCT ciudad`), not a static dropdown.

### Affected Areas

- `prompts/Vitrina_BD_Conexion_Backend.md` — needs new §3.x for `notif_email_habilitado` column, `correo_admin` history table (or renamed), any new RPC(s) for zero-service_role email resolution, and RLS/grants (per CLAUDE.md's mandatory doc-sync rule).
- `prompts/Vitrina_Especificaciones_APIs.md` — `/api/perfil` PATCH contract (§4.1, line 224) currently allows only `nombre, institucion, carrera, ciudad`; adding `notif_email_habilitado` here (vs. the prompt's separate `PATCH /api/usuario/preferencias`) is an open design choice. New `/api/admin/correos*` endpoints need full §4.x-style documentation.
- `prompts/Vitrina_Pantallas_Componentes.md` — new admin screen + preference toggle location need documenting.
- `lib/auth/requireAdmin.ts` — reusable as-is for all `/api/admin/correos*` routes (`{error, user, supabase}` contract, returns `forbidden()`/`unauthorized()` via `lib/supabase/handleError.ts`).
- `lib/supabase/handleError.ts` — reusable envelope helpers (`jsonOk`, `validationError`, `handleError` with the `23505→409 / 42501→403 / P0001→400(message preserved)` mapping). No changes needed unless a new Postgres error code needs mapping.
- `app/(main)/perfil/ajustes/page.tsx` (confirmed exists at this exact path, NOT `app/perfil/configuracion/page.tsx` as the prompt assumes) — existing settings page composed of bordered `<section>` cards, each backed by one client form component (`PerfilEditForm`, `LinksEditor`, `ChangePasswordForm`). A notification-preference toggle is a natural 4th section here rather than a whole new route.
- `components/perfil/PerfilEditForm.tsx` — confirmed pattern: `apiClient` wrapper (`lib/api/client.ts`), local `loading/error/success` state, inline success/error text (no toast), `router.refresh()` after save. This is the template a preference form would follow — and confirms no Toast component exists to reuse.
- `components/ui/*` inventory (confirmed via glob): `Avatar, Badge, Button, Card, CompartirButton, EmptyState, ErrorState, Field, Modal, PageLoading, Pagination, Spinner, TipoBadge`. **No Toast, no Switch/Checkbox/Toggle primitive.** `ThemeToggle.tsx` (`components/layout/`) is the only toggle-shaped component in the repo, but it's `localStorage`-only (client state via `useSyncExternalStore`, no server round-trip) — not a direct template for a DB-backed boolean.
- `components/admin/AdminNav.tsx` (confirmed exact path) — flat `links` array of `{href, label}`, currently `Revistas/Tags/Reportes`; adding "Enviar correos" is a one-line array addition.
- `components/buscar/SearchBox.tsx` — confirmed pattern (300ms debounce, `AbortController`, `apiClient`) backed by `buscar_usuarios` RPC which exposes only `(id, nombre, institucion, carrera, total)` — **never email/rol**. Useful as a debounce/abort template for an admin recipient picker, but NOT reusable as-is: it's single-select-and-navigate, not multi-select, and its backing RPC doesn't expose what a recipient picker would need (it's already correctly scoped to avoid PII leakage, which is good, but means a new admin-only search RPC/endpoint is needed instead of reusing `buscar_usuarios`).
- `lib/rag/embed.ts` + `embed` edge function — confirmed zero-service_role Edge Function template: `verify_jwt: true`, no Supabase client inside the function body at all, caller's JWT flows through via `supabase.functions.invoke('embed', {...})`. This works because `embed` only calls an external HF inference API, not Postgres. The new Edge Functions here DO need to read/write Postgres (recipient resolution, history logging), so `embed` is a partial template only — the more relevant precedent is the SECURITY DEFINER RPC pattern below.

### Zero-service_role precedents already in the codebase (confirmed)

- `consumir_cuota_rag()` (migration `20260704031258_rag_rate_limit`) — `SECURITY DEFINER`, fixed `search_path`, "mismo modelo que `es_admin`/`aceptar_solicitud`; **no** es `service_role`". Atomic row-locked counter table (`rag_rate_limit`, one row per user, RLS: user can SELECT own row only, no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE — RPC is the sole mutation path). `EXECUTE` revoked from `anon`, granted to `authenticated`.
- `solicitud_mensaje` anti-spam guards (migrations `solicitud_mensaje_anti_spam`, `solicitud_mensaje_cooldown_2_dias`) — a *lighter* rate-limit pattern: no dedicated counter table, just inline `SELECT count(*) ... WHERE creado_en > now() - interval` checks inside the existing SECURITY DEFINER RPC (`enviar_solicitud_mensaje`), raising `P0001` with exact user-facing messages.
- Additive `es_admin()`-gated RLS policies, always OR'd with owner policies, never replacing them: `admin_elimina` on `publicacion`, `admin_gestiona` on `revista`/`revista_articulo`, `chunk_admin_write`/`rag_admin_write` on the RAG tables (`FOR ALL using es_admin()`).
- Business RPCs (`aceptar_solicitud`, `bloquear_publicacion`, `retirar_articulo`, etc.) all follow: `SECURITY DEFINER` + internal `IF NOT es_admin() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'No autorizado'` + grant kept on `authenticated` (admin calls with their own JWT, not `service_role`) — documented exception to the advisor's WARN, accepted project-wide.

**Load-bearing implication for this change**: both new email-sending code paths need to read `usuario.email` (column-grant-blocked for everyone) for a *resolved* set of recipients:
- **Transactional path**: triggered by a DB webhook with no user JWT context at all (not even `anon` — Supabase webhooks call the Edge Function directly, no Supabase Auth session). Whatever resolves the single recipient's email must be a `SECURITY DEFINER` RPC (bypasses column grants internally, like `consumir_cuota_rag`) with `EXECUTE` granted to whichever role the Edge Function authenticates as when calling Postgrest/RPC (likely `anon`, mirroring the `es_admin()`-to-`anon` grant precedent from §7.1 of the BD doc) — never a `service_role` client constructed in code.
- **Admin bulk-send path**: the admin's own JWT can already SELECT `usuario.id`/`ciudad`/`notif_email_habilitado` (public row policy + presumably-granted columns) to resolve *which* users match a criterion — no new RLS needed for that part. But resolving their *emails* still requires calling a `SECURITY DEFINER` RPC (mirroring `retirar_articulo`/`aceptar_solicitud`: internal `es_admin()` check + bypasses grants) rather than a raw `SELECT email FROM usuario`.

This RPC-mediated email resolution is the central architectural decision the proposal phase needs to make explicit — it's the only way to satisfy both "zero service_role" and "column-grant-protected PII" simultaneously, and it has direct precedent in this codebase.

### Open Questions / Not Yet Resolved (for propose phase)

1. **Where does the webhook authenticate from?** Supabase Database Webhooks (dashboard-configured `pg_net` triggers) by default can be configured to send a bearer token in their request headers — historically Supabase's UI defaults this to the project's `service_role` key as the *webhook's own* calling credential to the Edge Function endpoint (an operational secret stored in Supabase's webhook config, not code the repo owns). This is a different concern from "the Edge Function constructs a `service_role` Supabase client to query Postgres" (which is what CLAUDE.md's invariant clearly forbids and what the prompt explicitly does in §2.2 step 3). Whether the *webhook→function* leg needs to avoid `service_role` too, or only the *function→Postgres* leg, needs an explicit decision — flag for the user/proposal, don't assume.
2. **Preference toggle placement**: prompt wants a new `/perfil/configuracion` route; the existing pattern (`/perfil/ajustes` with bordered `<section>` cards) argues for adding a 4th section there instead, avoiding a new route + new nav entry for one toggle. Needs a decision, not just a default.
3. **`/api/perfil` vs. new `/api/usuario/preferencias` endpoint**: extending the existing PATCH contract (adds one field to an already-documented endpoint) vs. the prompt's separate endpoint — both are viable, tradeoff is contract-churn vs. new-file overhead.
4. **UI toggle primitive**: this would be the first DB-backed boolean preference in the app. No `Switch`/`Checkbox` component exists in `components/ui/`; something new must be built (or a plain checkbox styled to look like a toggle) — small but real net-new UI-primitive work, not just wiring.
5. **New column grant footgun**: `notif_email_habilitado` (and any other new `usuario` column) MUST get explicit `GRANT SELECT/UPDATE (col) TO authenticated` in the same migration, per the `ciudad` incident lesson (§3.19) — otherwise the entire `SELECT`/`UPDATE` fails silently wherever that column is included, not just that field.
6. **Bulk-send guard**: prompt wants "max 1 send per 5 min per admin." Two precedents exist (dedicated counter table + RPC, or inline `SELECT count(*)` guard inside a SECURITY DEFINER RPC) — the lighter inline-guard pattern (`solicitud_mensaje` anti-spam) is likely sufficient for MVP given only admins trigger it (low volume), avoiding a new table; needs an explicit choice in propose.
7. **Recipient resolution for "por ciudad"**: since `ciudad` is free text (not enum), the admin UI needs to either query `SELECT DISTINCT ciudad FROM usuario WHERE ciudad IS NOT NULL` to populate a dynamic dropdown, or accept free-text input with an exact/fuzzy match — needs a decision informed by real data variance (e.g. "León" vs "Leon" vs "León, Gto.").
8. **`correo_admin` RLS** (prompt §8.1 suggests `service_role`-only INSERT, "alternatively just check admin in the REST endpoint") — should follow the `es_admin()`-gated-policy precedent instead (RLS INSERT/SELECT `using/with check es_admin()`), avoiding service_role entirely and staying consistent with `admin_elimina`/`admin_gestiona`.

### Approaches (email-resolution architecture — the core decision)

1. **SECURITY DEFINER RPC(s), zero service_role (recommended)** — one RPC for transactional single-recipient resolution (e.g. `resolver_destinatario_notificacion(p_tipo, p_registro_id)`, `EXECUTE` granted to whatever role the webhook call authenticates as), one RPC for bulk resolution (e.g. `resolver_destinatarios_correo(p_criterio jsonb)`, `EXECUTE` granted to `authenticated`, internal `es_admin()` check like `retirar_articulo`). Both bypass column grants internally via SECURITY DEFINER ownership, same trust model as `consumir_cuota_rag`/`aceptar_solicitud`.
   - Pros: matches every existing precedent in this codebase; satisfies CLAUDE.md hard invariant with zero exceptions; auditable (RPC is a single narrow surface); admin calls run under their own JWT.
   - Cons: two new RPCs to design/test; webhook-side RPC needs careful grant scoping to whatever unauthenticated-ish role the webhook uses (needs open question #1 resolved first); more moving parts than a single service_role client.
   - Effort: Medium.

2. **`service_role` client inside both Edge Functions (prompt's original design)** — direct table reads with full bypass.
   - Pros: simplest to write, no new RPCs, matches the prompt as-authored.
   - Cons: directly violates CLAUDE.md's hard invariant ("CERO service_role / admin.ts... si crees necesitar service_role, detente y pregunta"); user already rejected this. Not viable.
   - Effort: Low (but disqualified).

3. **Add row-level RLS policy for email visibility instead of fixing the real (column-grant) blocker** — e.g. an `es_admin()`-gated SELECT policy on `usuario` hoping it unblocks email reads.
   - Pros: none — this doesn't work.
   - Cons: as verified, `usuario` already has a permissive row policy (`lectura_publica USING true`); the block is a column GRANT, a completely separate Postgres privilege layer that row RLS cannot override. This would consume effort and ship broken.
   - Effort: N/A — technically incorrect, not a real option.

### Recommendation

Approach 1 (SECURITY DEFINER RPCs, zero service_role) is the only architecturally consistent option — it directly extends four precedents already live in this codebase (`consumir_cuota_rag`, `aceptar_solicitud`/`retirar_articulo`, `solicitud_mensaje` inline guards, `es_admin()`-gated additive policies). The proposal phase should design exactly two new RPCs (transactional resolver + bulk resolver), resolve open question #1 (webhook auth leg) explicitly with the user before writing migrations, and treat the `correo_admin` history table's RLS the same way (`es_admin()`-gated policy, no service_role INSERT). Table name `solicitud` must be corrected to `solicitud_revista` throughout, the `ciudad` filter must be data-driven (not a static 46-item enum), and the new `notif_email_habilitado` column needs its column-grant added in the same migration per the documented `ciudad` incident lesson.

### Risks

- **Webhook auth leg ambiguity (open question #1)** — if not resolved explicitly, implementation could silently reintroduce a `service_role`-flavored credential at the transport layer even after fixing the Postgres-client layer.
- **Column-grant footgun repeat** — this exact class of bug already broke `/perfil` once (`ciudad` incident, 2026-07-09, silently disguised as an expired session). High risk of recurrence for `notif_email_habilitado` if the migration author isn't explicitly reminded.
- **Free-text `ciudad` fragmentation** — "by city" bulk-send targeting could silently under-deliver if city values aren't normalized (typos/variants), with no validation feedback to the admin.
- **PII exposure surface** — two new RPCs that can resolve real email addresses are new attack surface; both need tight internal guards (`es_admin()` for bulk, narrow single-record resolution for transactional) and should be reviewed under `review-risk` at propose/design time given CLAUDE.md flags `**/payments/**`-style hot paths for 4R review — email/PII resolution RPCs warrant the same scrutiny even though not explicitly listed.
- **New infra surface**: Supabase Database Webhooks (`pg_net`) has no prior usage in this project — first-time setup risk (retry semantics, failure visibility, no existing runbook).
- **Doc sync burden**: this change touches BD (new column, new table, new RPCs, new RLS), API (multiple new endpoints), and UI (new admin screen, new toggle) — all three `prompts/*.md` docs need updates per CLAUDE.md's mandatory sync rule; likely to be a larger PR than usual, worth flagging for the review-workload guard (400-line budget) at tasks/apply time.

### Ready for Proposal

Yes — the source prompt's factual errors are now corrected and verified, the zero-service_role architecture direction is clear and precedented, and the open questions above are scoped narrowly enough for the propose phase to resolve with the user rather than blocking exploration further. The orchestrator should present open questions #1–#3 (webhook auth leg, toggle placement, endpoint shape) to the user before or during `sdd-propose`, since they materially change scope/file count.

observations.title: sdd/notificaciones-email-resend/proposal
observations.content:
# Proposal: Email Notifications (Resend) + Admin Bulk-Email Panel

## Intent
Vitrina has no email channel. Users who get a message request (`solicitud_mensaje`) or whose work is accepted into a magazine (`solicitud_revista → estado='aceptada'`) receive no out-of-app signal, hurting responsiveness/engagement; admins can't reach users for announcements. Add transactional email + an admin outreach panel, honoring a per-user opt-out — all under the zero-service_role invariant. Builds on explore #71 (4 verified source-prompt errors corrected).

## Scope
### In Scope
- **Transactional**: `usuario.notif_email_habilitado boolean` (+ same-migration column GRANTs per `ciudad` incident); SECURITY DEFINER resolver RPC gated by a shared secret (webhook carries only anon key, no end-user JWT); Edge Function `enviar-notificacion-email` (`verify_jwt:false`, validates secret header); 2 DB Webhooks — `solicitud_mensaje` INSERT; `solicitud_revista` UPDATE filtered `estado='aceptada'` with `old_record.estado != 'aceptada'` re-fire guard.
- **Preference toggle**: new section inside existing `/perfil/ajustes`; PATCH extends existing `app/api/perfil/route.ts`.
- **Admin bulk**: `correo_admin` history table + additive `es_admin()` RLS; SECURITY DEFINER recipient RPC (todos/ciudad/ids, always filtered `notif_email_habilitado=true`); Edge Function `enviar-correo-masivo` (`verify_jwt:true`, receives PRE-RESOLVED emails, internal `es_admin()` defense check, ≤50-batch chunking); UI `/admin/correos` (form, preview/confirm modal, history, recipient picker from SearchBox debounce backed by admin RPC); AdminNav link.

### Out of Scope / Non-Goals
- No React Email (simple HTML string). No async/queued send beyond ≤50 chunking. No quota RPC — confirm dialog is the guard. No Toast (inline status text). No service_role anywhere. No transactional events beyond the 2 webhooks. No changes to existing tables/RLS/RPC.

## Capabilities
### New
- `email-notifications`: transactional dispatch + per-user preference.
- `admin-bulk-email`: admin outreach panel + history.
### Modified
- `perfil`: settings page + PATCH contract gain the notification-preference field/section.

## Approach
Explore Approach 1 (SECURITY DEFINER RPCs, zero service_role). Both paths need `usuario.email` (column-grant-blocked for all roles) → each resolves it via a narrow SECURITY DEFINER RPC bypassing grants internally (mirrors `consumir_cuota_rag`/`aceptar_solicitud`). Transactional RPC is secret-gated (not RLS — webhooks are unauthenticated) to avoid a PII-harvest endpoint. Admin RPC is `es_admin()`-gated. `ciudad` targeting reads `SELECT DISTINCT ciudad` (free text, no enum). `correo_admin` RLS mirrors `admin_elimina`. Edge Function source committed to new `supabase/functions/` for reviewability. Exact SQL/HTML → sdd-design.

## Affected Areas
| Area | Impact | Change |
|---|---|---|
| BD (`usuario` col, `correo_admin`, 2 RPCs, RLS, webhooks) | New | zero-service_role email infra |
| `supabase/functions/{enviar-notificacion-email,enviar-correo-masivo}` | New | Edge Functions |
| `app/api/perfil/route.ts` | Modified | +`notif_email_habilitado` |
| `app/(main)/perfil/ajustes` | Modified | +toggle section |
| `app/admin/correos/*`, `app/api/admin/correos/*`, `components/admin/*`, `AdminNav` | New | admin panel |
| `Vitrina_BD_Conexion_Backend.md` / `_APIs.md` / `_Pantallas.md` + CLAUDE.md exception bullet | Modified | mandatory doc-sync |

## Risks
| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| Column-grant footgun repeat (silent) | High | GRANT SELECT/UPDATE in same migration; verify column_privileges |
| Webhook secret storage/rotation | Med | Store secret as Edge Function secret + webhook header; document rotation |
| Free-text `ciudad` fragmentation | Med | DISTINCT-driven picker; admin sees real values |
| PII-resolution RPC surface | Med | secret-gate (transactional) + `es_admin()` (bulk); review-risk lens |
| First-use Supabase Webhooks infra | Med | test re-fire guard; no prior runbook |
| Doc-sync across 3 docs inflates diff | Med | flag for delivery-strategy gate at tasks (6-area change) |

## Rollback
Additive-only. Revert: drop column/table/RPCs/policies (with grants), delete 2 webhooks, remove Edge Functions + secrets, revert PATCH + UI. No existing schema touched → clean revert.

## Dependencies
- Resend account + verified sending domain (`from:` address — operational unknown, blocks live send not build).
- `RESEND_API_KEY` + shared webhook secret in Supabase Edge secrets.

## Success Criteria
- [ ] `solicitud_mensaje` INSERT and `solicitud_revista`→aceptada send exactly one email to opted-in recipients; opted-out get none.
- [ ] Admin can send todos/ciudad/ids; opted-out users never receive even if hand-picked.
- [ ] Zero service_role; both Edge Functions verified against invariant.
- [ ] `correo_admin` history renders; 3 `prompts/*.md` + CLAUDE.md exception bullet updated.

## Open product questions (for user before design finalizes)
1. Unsubscribe/compliance: should bulk admin emails carry an unsubscribe/opt-out footer (CAN-SPAM/GDPR), given opt-out already gates delivery? Currently assumed: preference toggle is the opt-out, no in-email link for MVP.
2. Verified sending domain + `from:` address — real value needed before any live send.
3. `ciudad` picker UX when values are messy (e.g. "León" vs "Leon") — assumed: exact-match on DISTINCT values, no normalization for MVP.

observations.title: sdd/notificaciones-email-resend/spec
observations.content:
# Delta Spec: notificaciones-email-resend — Next.js API Contract

Scope: Next.js route contracts + DTOs only (preference toggle, admin bulk-email panel). Edge Function internals, RPC SQL, migration DDL are `sdd-design`'s job — referenced generically as "the admin recipient-resolution RPC" / "the dry-run resolution RPC". All user-facing validation messages MUST be Spanish, matching existing `app/api/perfil/route.ts` style.

## Domain: perfil (MODIFIED)

### Requirement: PATCH /api/perfil accepts email notification preference
(Previously: accepted `nombre, institucion, carrera, ciudad` only)
The system MUST accept optional `notif_email_habilitado: boolean` in the PATCH body, update `usuario.notif_email_habilitado` for the session's own row, and include it in the returned `.select()` alongside existing fields.

#### Scenario: Toggle off
- GIVEN an authenticated user
- WHEN they PATCH `{ notif_email_habilitado: false }`
- THEN response is `{ data: {..., notif_email_habilitado: false} }`, 200

#### Scenario: Non-boolean rejected
- GIVEN `notif_email_habilitado: "true"` (string, not boolean)
- WHEN PATCHed
- THEN 400 `validation_error`

#### Scenario: Combined with existing fields
- GIVEN body has `nombre` and `notif_email_habilitado` together
- WHEN PATCHed
- THEN both persist in one atomic update

#### Scenario: No session
- GIVEN no auth cookie
- WHEN PATCH called
- THEN 401 `unauthorized`

### Requirement: GET /api/auth/me exposes email notification preference
The system MUST include `notif_email_habilitado` in the `perfil` object returned for the caller's own session (safe: own-row read only).

#### Scenario: Own profile includes preference
- GIVEN an authenticated user
- WHEN GET /api/auth/me
- THEN `data.perfil.notif_email_habilitado` is present (boolean)

## Domain: admin-bulk-email (ADDED)

### Requirement: List sent bulk emails
`GET /api/admin/correos` MUST be gated by `requireAdmin()`, support `?limit=&offset=` (default 20, max 50, matching `mensajes` convention), order by `enviado_en DESC`, and return `{ data: { correos: CorreoAdmin[], hasMore: boolean } }` for use with `Pagination.tsx`.

#### Scenario: Paginated history
- GIVEN 30 prior sends and `?limit=20&offset=0`
- WHEN GET called by an admin
- THEN 20 items returned, `hasMore: true`

#### Scenario: Non-admin blocked
- GIVEN a non-admin session
- WHEN GET called
- THEN 403 `forbidden`

### Requirement: Send a bulk email
`POST /api/admin/correos` MUST be gated by `requireAdmin()`, accept `{ asunto, cuerpo, destinatarios_criterio }`, resolve recipients via the admin recipient-resolution RPC (always excluding `notif_email_habilitado=false` even for `tipo:'ids'`), reject if zero recipients resolve, insert a `correo_admin` row, invoke `enviar-correo-masivo` synchronously, update the row's outcome, and return the resource with 201. `admin_id` MUST come from `auth.getUser()`, never the body.

#### Scenario: Successful send
- GIVEN valid `asunto` (≤200 chars), `cuerpo` (10–5000 chars), `destinatarios_criterio: {tipo:'todos'}`
- WHEN POSTed by an admin
- THEN 201, `data` is the created `CorreoAdmin` with resolved `cantidad_destinatarios` and `estado`

#### Scenario: Zero resolved recipients rejected
- GIVEN `destinatarios_criterio: {tipo:'ciudad', valor:'NoExiste'}` matching no opted-in users
- WHEN POSTed
- THEN 400 `validation_error`, no `correo_admin` row created

#### Scenario: Opt-out enforced even for explicit ids
- GIVEN `destinatarios_criterio: {tipo:'ids', valor:[userA]}` where userA has `notif_email_habilitado=false`
- WHEN POSTed
- THEN userA is excluded from the resolved set (may trigger zero-recipient rejection)

#### Scenario: Body validation
- GIVEN `asunto` empty or `cuerpo` < 10 or > 5000 chars
- WHEN POSTed
- THEN 400 `validation_error`

#### Scenario: Non-admin blocked
- GIVEN non-admin session
- WHEN POSTed
- THEN 403 `forbidden`

### Requirement: Retrieve bulk email detail
`GET /api/admin/correos/[id]` MUST be gated by `requireAdmin()`, join `usuario` for the sender's `nombre`, and return 404 if the id doesn't exist.

#### Scenario: Detail with sender info
- GIVEN an existing `correo_admin` id
- WHEN GET called by an admin
- THEN `data.correo` includes `admin: {id, nombre}`

#### Scenario: Not found
- GIVEN a non-existent id
- WHEN GET called
- THEN 404

### Requirement: Dry-run recipient count
`POST /api/admin/correos/contar` MUST be gated by `requireAdmin()`, accept `{ destinatarios_criterio }` only (no `asunto`/`cuerpo`), resolve via the dry-run resolution RPC applying the same opt-out filter, return `{ data: { cantidad: number } }`, and create NO `correo_admin` row.

#### Scenario: Preview count before send
- GIVEN `destinatarios_criterio: {tipo:'ciudad', valor:'León'}`
- WHEN POSTed by an admin
- THEN 200, `data.cantidad` reflects opted-in matching users, no row persisted

#### Scenario: Malformed criterio
- GIVEN `destinatarios_criterio` missing `tipo` or invalid `tipo`
- WHEN POSTed
- THEN 400 `validation_error`

## DTOs (ADDED)

```ts
export type DestinatariosCriterio =
  | { tipo: 'todos' }
  | { tipo: 'ciudad'; valor: string }
  | { tipo: 'ids'; valor: string[] }

export type EstadoCorreoAdmin = 'enviado' | 'error'

export type CorreoAdmin = {
  id: string
  admin_id: string
  asunto: string
  cuerpo: string
  destinatarios_criterio: DestinatariosCriterio
  cantidad_destinatarios: number
  estado: EstadoCorreoAdmin
  enviado_en: string
}

export type CorreoAdminDetalle = CorreoAdmin & { admin: { id: string; nombre: string } }
```

`Usuario` DTO gains `notif_email_habilitado: boolean` (default `true` — opt-out model per proposal; needs design-phase confirmation of the column default).

## Non-Goals (explicit)
- No async/queued sending — `POST /api/admin/correos` is synchronous, no 202/polling.
- No quota/rate-limit RPC for admin sends — confirmation dialog is the only guard for MVP.
- No email template editor — plain textarea `cuerpo`, HTML conversion is server-side (Edge Function), out of this API contract.
- No unsubscribe link in bulk emails — `notif_email_habilitado` toggle is the sole opt-out.
- `correo_admin` resources are immutable once created — no PATCH/DELETE endpoint.

## Common Error Envelope (all endpoints above)
| Case | Status | code |
|---|---|---|
| No session | 401 | `unauthorized` |
| Authenticated, not admin | 403 | `forbidden` |
| Own validation failure | 400 | `validation_error` |
| Unique violation (Postgres 23505) | 409 | `23505` |
| RLS denial (Postgres 42501) | 403 | `42501` |
| RPC business error (P0001) | 400 | original message preserved |
| Unhandled | 500 | `internal_error` |

observations.title: sdd/notificaciones-email-resend/design
observations.content:
# Design: Email Notifications (Resend) + Admin Bulk-Email Panel

## Technical Approach
Zero-service_role throughout. Both new email paths need `usuario.email`, which is column-grant-blocked for every role (BD §7.2 line 1042). The block is a COLUMN privilege, not row RLS — `usuario` already has `lectura_publica USING true`, so no row policy can unblock it. The only precedented way to read that PII without service_role is a SECURITY DEFINER RPC that bypasses column grants under its owner (exact pattern of `consumir_cuota_rag`, `aceptar_solicitud`). Two RPCs: a secret-gated transactional resolver (webhook context has no user JWT) and an `es_admin()`-gated bulk resolver. Note: this design intentionally exceeds the skill's 800-word soft budget because the orchestrator scoped this as the load-bearing phase requiring exact signatures.

## Architecture Decisions

### D1 — Email read via SECURITY DEFINER RPC, not row RLS
**Choice**: Resolve `usuario.email` only inside SECURITY DEFINER RPCs (owner bypasses column grants).
**Rejected**: (a) row-level `es_admin()` SELECT policy on `usuario` — inert, the block is a column GRANT layer that row RLS cannot override (same footgun class as the `ciudad` incident, BD §3.19; verified line 1042 "PostgREST respeta los privilegios de columna"). (b) service_role client in the Edge Function — hard invariant violation.
**Rationale**: Mirrors 4 live precedents; single narrow auditable PII surface; runs under the caller's own identity model.

### D2 — Transactional RPC gated by a shared secret, not by role
**Choice**: `resolver_destinatario_notificacion(p_secret, p_usuario_id)` compares `p_secret` to `current_setting('app.settings.notif_webhook_secret', true)`. EXECUTE granted to `anon` + `authenticated`.
**Rejected**: grant EXECUTE to `anon` WITHOUT a secret gate — the webhook carries only the public anon key, so the RPC would be directly callable at `/rest/v1/rpc/resolver_destinatario_notificacion` by anyone holding the anon key; `usuario` ids are discoverable from public `/usuario/[id]` URLs → arbitrary-email PII harvest. The secret parameter (not reachable via a discoverable id) is the real gate; `es_admin()` cannot be used because there is no JWT.
**Rationale**: `current_setting('app.settings.*', true)` is the standard Supabase way to reach a DB-level secret from a SECURITY DEFINER body without vault/service_role. `true` = missing_ok (returns NULL, so an unset GUC fails closed on the `<>` compare).

### D3 — `notif_email_habilitado` GRANT to `authenticated` only (NOT anon)
**Choice**: `grant select, update (notif_email_habilitado) on usuario to authenticated;` — same migration as the ALTER TABLE.
**Rejected**: granting to `anon` too (as `ciudad`/`institucion` do) — those are PUBLIC profile fields; a private notification preference must not be world-readable.
**Rationale**: The `ciudad` incident (BD §3.19, hotfix migration `grant_usuario_ciudad_column_privileges`) proved that omitting the same-migration column grant makes every `select`/`update` touching that column fail silently with `permission denied for column`, disguised as an expired session. Verify against `information_schema.column_privileges` before closing.

### D4 — Admin RPC gated by `es_admin()`, opt-out filtered in EVERY branch
**Choice**: `resolver_destinatarios_correo(p_tipo, p_ciudad, p_ids)` raises `'No autorizado'` if not admin, filters `notif_email_habilitado = true` OUTSIDE the `p_tipo` branch so it applies to todos/ciudad AND ids. EXECUTE to `authenticated` only.
**Rejected**: applying the opt-out filter only in todos/ciudad — an admin hand-picking ids could bypass a user's opt-out. Rejected anon grant (internal `es_admin()` is the gate, same idiom as `aceptar_solicitud`/`retirar_articulo`; revoking from authenticated would break admin, BD line 1022).
**Rationale**: `'No autorizado'` (P0001) maps to 400 via existing `handleError` preserving the message.

### D5 — `correo_admin` RLS mirrors `chunk_admin_write`/`rag_admin_write`
**Choice**: additive `es_admin()`-gated policies; INSERT `with check (es_admin() and admin_id = auth.uid())`. PLUS table grant `grant select, insert, update on public.correo_admin to authenticated;`.
**Rationale**: `chunk_admin_write`/`rag_admin_write` are `FOR ALL to authenticated using es_admin() with check es_admin()` (BD §3.18). `admin_id = auth.uid()` enforces owner-id-from-session, never body. The table GRANT is separate from RLS (RLS gates rows, GRANT gates PostgREST visibility) — omitting it repeats the column-grant footgun at table scope.

### D6 — Edge Function auth models
**Choice**: `enviar-notificacion-email` `verify_jwt:false`, first line checks `x-webhook-secret` header vs `Deno.env.get('NOTIF_WEBHOOK_SECRET')` → 401 on mismatch. `enviar-correo-masivo` `verify_jwt:true` PLUS an internal `rpc('es_admin')` defense check on a client built from the forwarded `Authorization` header → 403 if false.
**Rationale**: `verify_jwt:true` proves "some authenticated user," not "admin" — without the `es_admin()` check the function URL is an open Resend relay for any logged-in user. `enviar-correo-masivo` is invoked via `admin.functions.invoke(...)` from the Route Handler (mirrors `lib/rag/embed.ts`), so the admin JWT flows through automatically.

### D7 — Webhooks: dashboard-configured, not migration DDL
**Choice**: Create the two DB Webhooks in the Supabase dashboard (Database → Webhooks), each with the `x-webhook-secret` custom header; document as an operational runbook step in BD §3.x (NOT a tracked migration).
**Rejected**: `create trigger ... execute function supabase_functions.http_request(...)` via `apply_migration` — technically possible but brittle/undocumented across Supabase versions, and it would embed the secret header value in the trigger definition; the dashboard is the supported path with retry/observability UI and keeps the secret out of any tracked artifact.
**Rationale**: First webhook usage in this project; prefer the supported, observable path. Tradeoff noted: less reproducible-from-code (accepted for MVP; documented instead).

### D8 — Toggle primitive uses `role="switch"`, not `aria-pressed`
**Choice**: New `components/ui/Toggle.tsx`, controlled, `role="switch"` + `aria-checked`.
**Rationale**: `ThemeToggle` (`components/layout/`) uses `aria-pressed` (momentary toggle-button, localStorage-only) — it is a STYLING reference only. A persisted DB-backed binary preference is `switch` semantics.

### D9 — Commit Edge Function source to `supabase/functions/`
**Choice**: Create `supabase/functions/{enviar-notificacion-email,enviar-correo-masivo}/index.ts` + `_shared/email-template.ts` in-repo.
**Rationale**: Deliberate deviation from the `embed` precedent (live but untracked in-repo) for reviewability. Flagged as intentional, not oversight.

## Schema — 4 migrations (`apply_migration`; names `<YYYYMMDDHHMMSS>_<snake>`, timestamp at apply)

**M1 `add_notif_email_habilitado_to_usuario`**
```sql
alter table public.usuario
  add column notif_email_habilitado boolean not null default true;
grant select, update (notif_email_habilitado) on public.usuario to authenticated; -- NOT anon
```

**M2 `create_resolver_destinatario_notificacion_rpc`**
```sql
create or replace function public.resolver_destinatario_notificacion(
  p_secret text, p_usuario_id uuid
) returns table(email text, notif_email_habilitado boolean)
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if p_secret is null
     or p_secret <> current_setting('app.settings.notif_webhook_secret', true) then
    raise exception 'No autorizado';
  end if;
  return query
    select u.email, u.notif_email_habilitado
    from public.usuario u where u.id = p_usuario_id;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.resolver_destinatario_notificacion(text, uuid) from public;
grant execute on function public.resolver_destinatario_notificacion(text, uuid) to anon, authenticated;
```
One-time operational setup (run via MCP/dashboard SQL, secret value NOT committed to docs):
`alter database postgres set app.settings.notif_webhook_secret = '<NOTIF_WEBHOOK_SECRET>';`
Same secret string lives in: (a) Edge secret `NOTIF_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, (b) the webhook `x-webhook-secret` header, (c) this GUC. Single shared secret for MVP (could be split into header-secret vs db-secret; not needed).

**M3 `create_correo_admin_table`**
```sql
create table public.correo_admin (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  admin_id uuid references public.usuario(id) on delete set null,
  asunto text not null check (char_length(asunto) between 1 and 200),
  cuerpo text not null check (char_length(cuerpo) between 10 and 5000),
  destinatarios_criterio jsonb not null,
  cantidad_destinatarios int not null default 0,
  cantidad_enviados int not null default 0,
  cantidad_fallidos int not null default 0,
  estado text not null default 'pendiente' check (estado in ('pendiente','completado','fallido')),
  enviado_en timestamptz not null default now()
);
alter table public.correo_admin enable row level security;
create policy correo_admin_select on public.correo_admin
  for select to authenticated using (public.es_admin());
create policy correo_admin_insert on public.correo_admin
  for insert to authenticated with check (public.es_admin() and admin_id = auth.uid());
create policy correo_admin_update on public.correo_admin
  for update to authenticated using (public.es_admin()) with check (public.es_admin());
grant select, insert, update on public.correo_admin to authenticated;
```

**M4 `create_resolver_destinatarios_correo_rpc`**
```sql
create or replace function public.resolver_destinatarios_correo(
  p_tipo text, p_ciudad text default null, p_ids uuid[] default null
) returns table(id uuid, email text, nombre text)
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if not public.es_admin() then raise exception 'No autorizado'; end if;
  return query
    select u.id, u.email, u.nombre
    from public.usuario u
    where u.notif_email_habilitado = true      -- opt-out enforced in ALL branches
      and u.email is not null
      and case p_tipo
            when 'todos'  then true
            when 'ciudad' then u.ciudad = p_ciudad
            when 'ids'    then u.id = any(p_ids)
            else false
          end;
end $$;
revoke all on function public.resolver_destinatarios_correo(text, text, uuid[]) from public;
grant execute on function public.resolver_destinatarios_correo(text, text, uuid[]) to authenticated;
```
`ciudad` picker: the Route Handler resolves the DISTINCT city list under the admin JWT via `supabase.from('usuario').select('ciudad')` (ciudad already granted to authenticated) + JS-dedupe of non-null values — NO 5th DB object, staying within the locked 4-migration scope. Exact-match on real values (no normalization, MVP).

## Edge Functions (contracts)

**`enviar-notificacion-email`** (`verify_jwt:false`). Env: `NOTIF_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, `RESEND_API_KEY`, `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`, `NOTIF_FROM_EMAIL`.
1. `x-webhook-secret` header ≠ env → **401**.
2. Parse native payload `{type, table, record, old_record?, schema}`.
3. Route: `table==='solicitud_mensaje' && type==='INSERT'` → recipient `record.receptor_id`, template A. `table==='solicitud_revista' && type==='UPDATE' && record.estado==='aceptada' && (old_record?.estado ?? null) !== 'aceptada'` → recipient `record.solicitante_id`, template B. Else → **204** (ignored). The `old_record.estado !== 'aceptada'` guard prevents re-firing when an already-accepted row is updated for any other reason.
4. Anon client `createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY)`; `rpc('resolver_destinatario_notificacion', { p_secret: NOTIF_WEBHOOK_SECRET, p_usuario_id })`.
5. No row OR `!notif_email_habilitado` OR `!email` → **204** (skip; user not found / opted out).
6. Resend send (`npm:resend`). Resend error → **500** with Resend's message; success → **200**.

**`enviar-correo-masivo`** (`verify_jwt:true`). Env: `RESEND_API_KEY`, `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`, `NOTIF_FROM_EMAIL`.
1. Client from forwarded `Authorization` header + anon key; `rpc('es_admin')`; falsy → **403**.
2. Input `{asunto, cuerpo, destinatarios: [{id, email, nombre}]}` — PRE-RESOLVED by the Route Handler; this function NEVER queries `usuario`.
3. Chunk `destinatarios` into groups ≤50; Resend send per recipient; collect per-email outcome.
4. Output `{enviados: number, fallidos: number, detalles: [{email, error?}]}`. The Route Handler (not this function) writes the `correo_admin` counts/estado update.

**`_shared/email-template.ts`**: `renderEmail({ titulo, cuerpoHtml, nombre? }): string` — consistent HTML header/footer/branding, used by both. No unsubscribe footer (MVP decision).

## Data Flow
```
Transactional:
  solicitud_mensaje INSERT | solicitud_revista UPDATE→aceptada
    └─ pg_net DB Webhook (x-webhook-secret) ─► enviar-notificacion-email (verify_jwt:false)
         header check → route(old_record guard) → anon client
           └─ rpc resolver_destinatario_notificacion(p_secret,p_usuario_id) [SECDEF, secret-gated]
                └─ opted-in? no→204 · yes→ Resend ─► 200/500

Admin bulk:
  /admin/correos form ─► POST /api/admin/correos (Route Handler, admin JWT, requireAdmin())
    ├─ rpc resolver_destinatarios_correo(p_tipo,p_ciudad,p_ids) [SECDEF, es_admin, opt-out filtered]
    ├─ INSERT correo_admin (estado='pendiente', admin_id=auth.uid())
    ├─ admin.functions.invoke('enviar-correo-masivo',{asunto,cuerpo,destinatarios}) [JWT forwarded]
    │     └─ es_admin() defense → ≤50 chunks → Resend ─► {enviados,fallidos,detalles}
    └─ UPDATE correo_admin (counts, estado='completado'|'fallido')
```

## File Changes
| File | Action | Description |
|---|---|---|
| BD migrations M1–M4 | Create (MCP) | column+grant, 2 RPCs, `correo_admin`+RLS |
| `supabase/functions/enviar-notificacion-email/index.ts` | Create | transactional dispatcher |
| `supabase/functions/enviar-correo-masivo/index.ts` | Create | admin bulk sender |
| `supabase/functions/_shared/email-template.ts` | Create | shared HTML wrapper |
| `app/api/perfil/route.ts` | Modify | PATCH accepts `notif_email_habilitado` (validate boolean; add to `updates`; add to `.select(...)`) |
| `app/(main)/perfil/ajustes/page.tsx` | Modify | 4th `<section>`: notifications |
| `components/perfil/NotificacionesForm.tsx` | Create | client form (PerfilEditForm pattern) wrapping Toggle → PATCH /api/perfil |
| `components/ui/Toggle.tsx` | Create | `role="switch"` primitive |
| `app/admin/correos/page.tsx` | Create | admin panel (form, preview/confirm modal, history) |
| `app/api/admin/correos/route.ts` | Create | POST: requireAdmin → resolve → insert history → invoke fn → update history; GET: history list |
| `components/admin/RecipientPicker.tsx` | Create | debounce/abort (SearchBox pattern) via admin-only search |
| `components/admin/AdminNav.tsx` | Modify | +`{href:'/admin/correos', label:'Enviar correos'}` |
| `lib/types/database.ts` | Modify | +`notif_email_habilitado`; `correo_admin` DTO |
| `prompts/Vitrina_BD_Conexion_Backend.md` / `_APIs.md` / `_Pantallas.md` + CLAUDE.md exception bullet | Modify | mandatory doc-sync |

## Interfaces
```ts
interface ToggleProps {
  checked: boolean
  onChange: (next: boolean) => void
  label: string
  disabled?: boolean
  id?: string
}
// PATCH /api/perfil body gains: notif_email_habilitado?: boolean (reject non-boolean → validationError)
// POST /api/admin/correos body: { asunto, cuerpo, destinatarios_criterio: {tipo:'todos'|'ciudad'|'ids', ciudad?, ids?} }
// enviar-correo-masivo out: { enviados:number, fallidos:number, detalles:{email:string, error?:string}[] }
```

## Testing Strategy
| Layer | What | Approach |
|---|---|---|
| Unit (Vitest) | webhook route predicate (extract pure), email-template render, PATCH boolean validator | pure functions |
| Integration (supabase MCP) | wrong `p_secret`→No autorizado; opt-out filtered in ALL 3 branches incl `ids`; `es_admin()` gate; `column_privileges` shows authenticated-only on new column | direct RPC + introspection |
| E2E (testsprite/webapp-testing) | INSERT/accept fires exactly one email to opted-in; re-fire guard (re-update accepted row → no email); admin todos/ciudad/ids; opted-out never receives even hand-picked; toggle persists | live flows |

## Migration / Rollout
Additive-only. Order: M1→M4, `alter database ... set app.settings.notif_webhook_secret`, deploy both Edge Functions + set secrets (`RESEND_API_KEY`, `NOTIF_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, `NOTIF_FROM_EMAIL`), create 2 dashboard webhooks with header, verify `column_privileges`. Rollback: delete webhooks → drop functions/secrets → drop RPCs/table/column (+grants) → reset GUC → revert Next code. No existing schema touched.

## Open Questions / Deviations
- [ ] Verified Resend sending domain + `from:` (`NOTIF_FROM_EMAIL`) — blocks live send, not build (proposal Q2).
- **Deviation D7**: webhooks = dashboard (documented runbook), not migration DDL — reduces code-reproducibility; accepted for MVP.
- **Refinement**: `ciudad` DISTINCT list via Route-Handler JS-dedupe (no 5th DB object), honoring the locked 4-migration scope.
- **Simplification**: one shared secret across header/`p_secret`/GUC (splittable later).
- **Deviation D9**: Edge source committed in-repo (vs untracked `embed`) — intentional for review.
- All proposal locked decisions honored: zero service_role, no unsubscribe footer, confirm-dialog-only rate limit, DISTINCT free-text ciudad, same-migration column grant.
