observations.content:
\
# Tasks: Email Notifications (Resend) + Admin Bulk-Email Panel

Note: exceeds the skill's 530-word soft budget (mirrors design's own noted overage) — this is the load-bearing phase requiring exact migration/RPC/file names for `sdd-apply`; compressing further would drop identifiers the orchestrator explicitly requested.

## Review Workload Forecast

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Estimated changed lines (repo diff; 4 migrations run via `apply_migration` MCP calls, NOT tracked files, so they add 0 to git diff) | ~850–1050 total across 5 work units |
| 400-line budget risk, single PR | High |
| 400-line budget risk, per recommended unit | Medium (PR2 ~200-260, PR4b ~330-400 nearest ceiling); PR1/PR3 Low, **PR4a revised to High post-4R-review — see below** |
| Chained PRs recommended | Yes |
| Suggested split | PR1 → PR2 → PR3 → PR4a → PR4b |
| Delivery strategy | ask-on-risk |
| Chain strategy | stacked-to-main (resolved) |

Decision needed before apply: No (resolved — stacked-to-main)
Chained PRs recommended: Yes
Chain strategy: stacked-to-main
400-line budget risk: High

### Suggested Work Units

| Unit | Goal | Likely PR | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Transactional schema (M1+M2) + types | PR1 | Base: feature branch (`feat/notif-email-schema`, from `origin/main`). ~20-40 lines (migrations don't diff; only types+doc do). |
| 2 | Edge Fn `enviar-notificacion-email` + webhooks | PR2 | Base: PR1. ~200-260 lines incl. Vitest. Nearest ceiling. Actual final: 397 changed lines (394 insertions/3 deletions across 7 files) — includes 2 `review-risk` security fixes applied post-implementation (raw-error passthrough hardening in `index.ts`, HTML-escaping in `email-template.ts`); briefly touched 404 (over budget) before comment-trimming brought it back to 397. Still under the 400 ceiling, no `size:exception` needed. |
| 3 | Perfil toggle UI + API | PR3 | Base: PR1 (independent of PR2). ~160-200 lines. Actual final: 255 changed lines (240 insertions/15 deletions across 9 files, incl. doc sync + a post-implementation 4R-review DB privacy fix) — under budget. |
| 4a | Admin backend: `correo_admin` schema/RLS (M3) + resolver RPC (M4) + `enviar-correo-masivo` Edge Fn | PR4a | Base: PR1+PR2 (reuses `_shared/email-template.ts`). ~110-140 lines estimated. **First batch actual: 272 changed lines** (268 insertions/4 deletions across 5 files) — under budget. **A mandatory 4R review on that staged diff found a BLOCKER-level architecture flaw (see Phase 4a below) requiring a real contract change plus several other fixes, all applied in a second batch. Revised final: 566 changed lines** (558 insertions/8 deletions across 11 files) — **OVER the 400-line budget.** Flagged explicitly, not silently absorbed — see Phase 4a's "Budget note" for the accounting and why further splitting this specific revision was judged worse than flagging it. |
| 4b | Admin frontend: `/api/admin/correos*` + `/admin/correos` UI + docs wrap | PR4b | Base: PR4a. ~330-400 lines. If it grows past 400, split API routes vs UI further. **Simplified by PR4a's contract revision**: the POST route handler no longer needs to resolve recipients itself before invoking `enviar-correo-masivo` — it passes `destinatarios_criterio` straight through and derives `cantidad_destinatarios` from the response (`enviados + fallidos`). It may still call `resolver_destinatarios_correo` separately for the dry-run/preview count (4b.3), which is a distinct use case (no sending). |

Refinement note: design suggested collapsing an earlier 6-slice plan into 4 (bundling admin schema+RLS+RPC into the same slice as admin edge fn+UI). This plan further splits that admin slice into 4a (backend, no UI) / 4b (frontend) purely for the 400-line guard — dependency order is unchanged, PR4b still depends on PR4a.

## Phase 1: Foundation — Transactional Schema + Types (PR1) — STATUS: 6/7 done, 1 blocked

- [x] 1.1 `mcp__supabase__apply_migration` `add_notif_email_habilitado_to_usuario`: `usuario.notif_email_habilitado boolean not null default true` + `grant select, update (notif_email_habilitado) on usuario to authenticated` (NOT `anon`, per design D3). **Done by orchestrator.** Live on project `fdfbyhjwnbteccagulxb`. **SUPERSEDED IN PART by PR3's post-review fix**: the `grant select` half of this migration was a confirmed privacy bug (usuario's SELECT RLS is row-public, so the column grant leaked the value across users, not just to `anon`) — see PR3 section below and BD §3.21 for the corrective migration `revoke_select_notif_email_habilitado_add_self_rpc`. `grant update` remains correct/unchanged (row-scoped via `editar_propio` RLS).
- [x] 1.2 Verify `information_schema.column_privileges`: only `authenticated` row on the new column, no `anon` — guards the documented `ciudad` footgun (CLAUDE.md). **Confirmed by orchestrator at the time**, but this check only verified the anon/authenticated axis, not the row-scoping axis — see 1.1's supersession note. Re-verified post-fix in PR3: `authenticated` now shows `UPDATE` only, no `SELECT` row for that column.
- [x] 1.3 `apply_migration` `create_resolver_destinatario_notificacion_rpc` (M2): `resolver_destinatario_notificacion(p_secret text, p_usuario_id uuid)` SECURITY DEFINER, `revoke all from public; grant execute to anon, authenticated`. **Done by orchestrator.** DEVIATION: secret comparison originally spec'd against `current_setting('app.settings.notif_webhook_secret', true)` — see 1.4. Unaffected by PR3's fix (this RPC is secret-gated, not a column grant).
- [x] 1.4 One-time secret setup for the RPC gate. DEVIATION FROM DESIGN: `alter database postgres set app.settings.notif_webhook_secret = '<value>'` FAILED — Supabase-hosted `postgres` role has no real superuser, custom GUCs can't be set at DB level (`permission denied to set parameter`). Fixed via follow-up migration `fix_resolver_destinatario_notificacion_secret_store`: new `private` schema (revoked from public/anon/authenticated) + `private.notif_config(key text primary key, value text)` holding the secret; RPC body now does `p_secret <> (select value from private.notif_config where key = 'webhook_secret')` instead of `current_setting(...)`. Function signature, revoke/grant structure, return shape unchanged from design. Verified end-to-end by orchestrator: wrong secret → `P0001 No autorizado`; correct secret → returns `{email, notif_email_habilitado}`. Documented as the actual implementation in BD §3.21 (GUC approach explicitly marked as never-live).
- [ ] 1.5 testsprite: RPC returns row for correct secret; wrong/missing secret raises `No autorizado` → 400 via `handleError`. **BLOCKED — not executed.** Neither the `sdd-apply` executor nor this session has `testsprite` MCP tool access. Substitute evidence exists (orchestrator manually verified via `mcp__supabase__apply_migration`/direct RPC call: wrong secret → P0001 No autorizado, correct secret → returns row; `information_schema.column_privileges` and `get_advisors` also checked — only the expected `security_definer_function_executable` WARN, same class as `aceptar_solicitud`/`consumir_cuota_rag`), but this does NOT satisfy the formal testsprite E2E task. Explicitly flagged back to orchestrator/user as deferred — needs either testsprite MCP access granted to a future apply batch, or explicit sign-off that the manual verification is accepted as equivalent.
- [x] 1.6 `lib/types/database.ts`: add `notif_email_habilitado: boolean` to the `Usuario` DTO. **Done.** Excluded from `PerfilPublico` (`Omit<Usuario, 'email' | 'rol' | 'notif_email_habilitado'>`) — private preference, not a public profile field, same treatment as `email`/`rol`. Still accurate post-PR3-fix — the DTO shape didn't change, only the read path did.
- [x] 1.7 `Vitrina_BD_Conexion_Backend.md` new §3.21: document column+grant + RPC M2 + secret-storage step (extended in Phase 4a/4b). **Done**, then **corrected in PR3** — the original "`grant select, update ... to authenticated`" framing for the column is now marked as a documented-and-fixed privacy bug (see PR3 section + §3.21's "Corrección (2026-07-10)" callout).

## Phase 2: Transactional Edge Function + Webhooks (PR2, base=PR1) — STATUS: 4/7 done, 3 deferred (out of this executor's tool scope, not silently skipped)

### What happened (two batches within Phase 4a)

**First batch** implemented the design's literal contract: `enviar-correo-masivo` received a caller-supplied, pre-resolved `destinatarios` array. Passed `pnpm test`/`tsc`/`lint`, staged, 272 changed lines. The coordinator then ran a 4R review on that staged diff and found:

1. **BLOCKER (risk) — architecture flaw in the Edge Function's input contract.** `enviar-correo-masivo` is `verify_jwt:true` and standalone-invokable via `functions.invoke` by ANY admin account, not only the future PR4b Route Handler. The original contract (`destinatarios` pre-resolved by caller) had nothing structurally forcing that list to originate from `resolver_destinatarios_correo` — any admin (or a compromised admin account) could hand-construct `destinatarios` to (a) bypass the `notif_email_habilitado` opt-out filter entirely, or (b) send to arbitrary non-Vitrina addresses using the project's verified sending domain as an open spam/phishing relay.
2. **CRITICAL (risk) — `cuerpo` treated as trusted HTML.** The product prompt (§5.1) specifies `cuerpo` as a plain `<textarea>`, not a rich-text/HTML editor. `renderEmail`'s `cuerpoHtml` contract (unescaped, caller-owns-safety) was designed for PR2's hardcoded transactional templates, not admin free-text — passing `cuerpo` straight through would allow HTML/XSS injection in the sent email.
3. **WARNING (risk) — `correo_admin_update` RLS missing ownership check.** Only required `es_admin()`, not `admin_id = auth.uid()` — any admin could rewrite another admin's send-history row (asunto, cuerpo, destinatarios_criterio, even reassign `admin_id`), breaking audit-trail integrity. `correo_admin_insert` already had the ownership check from the start; `correo_admin_update` did not.
4. **WARNING (resilience, MVP mitigation only)** — an unbounded `tipo:'todos'` send has no progress checkpointing; a runtime kill mid-send could leave `correo_admin.estado` stuck at `'pendiente'` forever undetectably. Building real queueing/checkpointing was explicitly out of scope (product prompt accepts synchronous for MVP); a cheap upper bound was requested instead.
5. **WARNING (readability + reliability, cross-lens)** — inline payload validation (`esPayloadValido`) should be extracted to a Vitest-tested sibling, same pattern as PR2's `route-predicate.ts`, especially since the contract was changing anyway.
6. **WARNING (readability)** — both `enviar-correo-masivo/index.ts` and PR2's `enviar-notificacion-email/index.ts` had a header comment falsely claiming ESLint exclusion (verified false — only `tsc --noEmit` excludes these files; ESLint lints them normally and they pass clean).
7. **WARNING (readability)** — the BD doc's §3.21 additions referenced `sdd/notificaciones-email-resend/apply-progress` as if it were a repo file path (it's an Engram topic_key, not trackable from the repo) and an undefined bare "M3"/"M4" label.
8. **SUGGESTION (cheap, applied)** — `chunk.test.ts` was missing driving tests for the `size <= 0` branch (already implemented, untested) and the exact-multiple-of-size case.

```sql
create table public.correo_admin (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  admin_id uuid references public.usuario(id) on delete set null,
  asunto text not null check (char_length(asunto) between 1 and 200),
  cuerpo text not null check (char_length(cuerpo) between 10 and 5000),
  destinatarios_criterio jsonb not null,
  cantidad_destinatarios int not null default 0,
  cantidad_enviados int not null default 0,
  cantidad_fallidos int not null default 0,
  estado text not null default 'pendiente' check (estado in ('pendiente','completado','fallido')),
  enviado_en timestamptz not null default now()
);

alter table public.correo_admin enable row level security;

create policy correo_admin_select on public.correo_admin
  for select to authenticated using (public.es_admin());

create policy correo_admin_insert on public.correo_admin
  for insert to authenticated with check (public.es_admin() and admin_id = auth.uid());

create policy correo_admin_update on public.correo_admin
  for update to authenticated
  using (public.es_admin() and admin_id = auth.uid())
  with check (public.es_admin() and admin_id = auth.uid());

grant select, insert, update on public.correo_admin to authenticated;
```

```sql
create or replace function public.resolver_destinatarios_correo(
  p_tipo text, p_ciudad text default null, p_ids uuid[] default null
) returns table(id uuid, email text, nombre text)
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if not public.es_admin() then raise exception 'No autorizado'; end if;
  return query
    select u.id, u.email, u.nombre
    from public.usuario u
    where u.notif_email_habilitado = true      -- opt-out enforced in ALL branches
      and u.email is not null
      and case p_tipo
            when 'todos'  then true
            when 'ciudad' then u.ciudad = p_ciudad
            when 'ids'    then u.id = any(p_ids)
            else false
          end;
end $$;

revoke all on function public.resolver_destinatarios_correo(text, text, uuid[]) from public;
revoke execute on function public.resolver_destinatarios_correo(text, text, uuid[]) from anon;
grant execute on function public.resolver_destinatarios_correo(text, text, uuid[]) to authenticated;
```

observations.title: Live PII leak found and partially fixed: usuario table-wide SELECT grant to authenticated
observations.content:
**What**: Found and partially fixed a live, pre-existing security defect in the `usuario` table's grants — unrelated to any single feature, discovered while reviewing the `notificaciones-email-resend` change.

**Why**: `usuario` has RLS policy `lectura_publica USING (true)` (row-public for ALL roles, confirmed via `pg_policies`). A leftover TABLE-WIDE `GRANT SELECT ON usuario TO authenticated` (confirmed via `pg_class.relacl`: `authenticated=ardDxtm`, the `r`=SELECT) meant RLS's row-level filtering did nothing — every column was readable by any logged-in user for any other user's row, contradicting the documented column-grant-only security model (`Vitrina_BD_Conexion_Backend.md` §7.3, which claimed `authenticated` lacked SELECT on `email`/`rol` — that claim was false in the live DB).

**Fixed**: Revoked the table-wide grant, re-granted only `id, nombre, rol, institucion, carrera, creado_en, ciudad` (`notif_email_habilitado` is RPC-only, see below) as explicit column grants to `authenticated`. `email` is now correctly unreachable by any role except via the existing SECURITY DEFINER RPC (`resolver_destinatario_notificacion`), which bypasses column grants via owner privilege — audited (via Explore agent) and confirmed nothing in the app reads `email` directly, so this was zero-blast-radius.

**NOT fixed — tracked follow-up**: `rol` is still column-granted to `authenticated` (i.e. still readable by any logged-in user, not just the row owner). This is real but lower severity than `email` (knowing someone's role isn't PII on the same level, though it could aid social engineering against admins). Not fixed because `lib/auth/requireAdmin.ts` (gates 10 admin routes) and `proxy.ts` (session-refresh middleware, runs on every request, gates `/admin/*`) both do a raw `.select('rol')` under the caller's own session — revoking would break admin access. Proper fix requires refactoring both to use an `es_admin()`-style SECURITY DEFINER RPC instead of a direct column read. `proxy.ts` is the single most sensitive file in the app (every request goes through it) — deliberately deferred rather than rushed.

**Also fixed same session**: `notif_email_habilitado` (new column from PR1 of `notificaciones-email-resend`) had the identical bug at smaller scope — role-wide grant on a row-public table. Fixed by revoking SELECT entirely and adding `mi_notif_email_habilitado()`, a parameterless SECURITY DEFINER RPC that derives the id from `auth.uid()` internally (can't be pointed at another user). Note: Supabase auto-grants EXECUTE to anon/authenticated/service_role on every new function via default privileges — `revoke all ... from public` does NOT remove those separate explicit per-role grants; you must explicitly `revoke execute ... from anon` too if the intent is authenticated-only. Learned this the hard way (had to fix twice).

**Where**: Live Supabase project `fdfbyhjwnbteccagulxb`. Migrations: `fix_notif_email_habilitado_column_leak`, `revoke_authenticated_table_wide_select_usuario_email`, `revoke_notif_email_habilitado_select_reintroduced_by_mistake`, `tighten_mi_notif_email_habilitado_anon_execute`.

**Learned**: Always check `pg_class.relacl` (table-wide grants) in addition to `information_schema.column_privileges` when auditing a "column-grant-protected" column on a table with public-row RLS — a column-specific REVOKE is a no-op if a broader table-wide GRANT already covers it. This whole class of bug (row-public RLS + role-wide column grant = no real per-owner protection) is worth checking on any other "private" column added to `usuario` or similar row-public tables in the future.

observations.title: Live E2E verification of enviar-notificacion-email webhook chain (PR2)
observations.content:
**What**: Ran a real live smoke test of the `enviar-notificacion-email` webhook chain end-to-end, substituting for tasks 1.5/2.6 (testsprite, deferred — no MCP access in sub-agents). Used the safe `example.com` E2E test account (`b5e67ea5-...`, `testuser+20260709t120000@example.com`, RFC 2606 non-routable domain) as the always-receiving party so no real person got emailed.

**Verified**:
- Type A (`solicitud_mensaje` INSERT) → real Resend send, subject "Tienes una nueva solicitud de mensaje", status "sent" (confirmed via `mcp__resend__list-emails`).
- Type B (`solicitud_revista` UPDATE → aceptada) → real Resend send, subject "Tu obra fue aceptada en una revista", status "sent".
- Re-fire guard: updating an already-`aceptada` row again (different field, same estado) did NOT produce a second email — confirmed via Resend send count staying at 1 for that row.
- Full auth chain: `x-webhook-secret` header check → `resolver_destinatario_notificacion` RPC → Resend send, all working correctly once secrets were configured.

**Bugs found and fixed during this verification (webhook config, not code)**:
1. User initially put the webhook secret in the URL query string instead of the HTTP Headers section of the Supabase Database Webhook config — function correctly rejected with 401 (code was right, config was wrong).
2. After fixing #1, still 401 — `NOTIF_WEBHOOK_SECRET` was never actually set as an Edge Function secret. Diagnosed via a temporary diagnostic deploy (returned `{secretSet, secretLen, headerLen, match}` — never the real secret value) — confirmed `secretSet: false`, header arriving correctly. User then added the secret via Dashboard → Edge Functions → Secrets (project-level, shared across all functions, not per-function — worth remembering, easy to assume it's per-function).
3. After secret fixed, got a generic 500 "Internal Server Error" (not our custom error messages) — `RESEND_API_KEY` wasn't set yet, likely the Resend SDK throwing synchronously in its constructor on an empty key, uncaught by our try/catch (which only wraps `resend.emails.send`, not `new Resend(...)`). Resolved once `RESEND_API_KEY` + `NOTIF_FROM_EMAIL` were both set.

**Where**: Live Supabase project `fdfbyhjwnbteccagulxb`, function `enviar-notificacion-email` (currently deployed version 3, the clean/real code — versions 1-2 were an initial deploy and a temporary diagnostic build, both superseded).

**Learned**: Supabase Edge Function secrets are project-level (Dashboard → Edge Functions → Secrets), not scoped per-function — don't assume otherwise when debugging "secret not found" issues. Also: if a constructor of an SDK can throw synchronously on bad/missing config, wrap the whole handler body in a top-level try/catch for a clean error response instead of relying only on inner try/catches around specific await calls — worth revisiting in `enviar-notificacion-email/index.ts` as a small resilience improvement (not done yet, low priority since it's now fully configured and working).

observations.title: sdd/dev-tooling-quality/explore
observations.content:
## Exploration: dev-tooling-quality (husky+lint-staged, Sentry, Playwright+CI)

### Current State

**1. Hooks (husky + lint-staged) — confirmed absent, safe to add**
- No `.husky/` dir (Glob empty).
- `package.json` scripts: `dev`, `build`, `start`, `lint` (`eslint`), `test` (`vitest run`) only — no `prepare`, no `typecheck` script, no `lint-staged` key. No `.lintstagedrc*` file anywhere.
- No husky/lint-staged in devDependencies.
- `eslint.config.mjs` (19 lines): flat config, `defineConfig([...nextVitals, ...nextTs, globalIgnores([...])])` from `eslint-config-next/core-web-vitals` + `eslint-config-next/typescript`. No typed-linting/`parserOptions.project` wiring visible — these configs use non-type-checked TS rules, so `eslint --fix <file>` on a single staged file resolves fine without needing full-program context.
- `tsconfig.json`: broad `include: ["next-env.d.ts","**/*.ts","**/*.tsx",...]`, path alias `@/* -> ./*`, no project-service linting hookup that would break per-file invocation.
- `packageManager: pnpm@11.9.0` pinned — no husky/lint-staged/pnpm incompatibility found.

**2. Sentry (`@sentry/nextjs`) — confirmed clean slate + concrete integration points**
- Zero "sentry" references anywhere in the repo (case-insensitive grep, no matches).
- 3 error boundaries exist exactly as expected, all near-identical `'use client'` components rendering `<ErrorState title="Algo salió mal" description={error.message || 'Ocurrió un error inesperado...'} retry={reset} />`:
  - `app/error.tsx`, `app/(admin)/error.tsx`, `app/(main)/error.tsx` — all UI-only, zero capture/logging calls.
- No `app/global-error.tsx` (Glob empty) — must be created. NOTE (risk): `global-error.tsx` replaces the root layout on crash, so per Next.js convention it must render its own `<html>/<body>` — it can NOT be a copy-paste of the 3 existing segment-scoped error boundaries, which assume the root layout is still mounted.
- `next.config.ts` (71 lines) read in full:
  - Line 21: `connect-src 'self' ${SUPABASE_HOST} ${SUPABASE_WSS}` — no `*.sentry.io`, would block direct browser SDK ingest POSTs.
  - Line 10: `unsafe-eval` only added in dev (`isDev` ternary) — prod stays strict.
  - Line 71: `export default nextConfig` — plain object, zero wrapping today. `withSentryConfig` would wrap exactly here: `export default withSentryConfig(nextConfig, sentryOptions)`.
  - `tunnelRoute` confirmed (via Sentry docs) as the correct same-origin-proxy fix, and confirmed to work identically under Turbopack.
- `lib/supabase/handleError.ts` (73 lines) read in full. Exact `logServerError` (lines 28-31):
  ```ts
  function logServerError(tag: string, error: unknown): void {
    const e = error as { code?: string; message?: string; status?: number }
    console.error(tag, { code: e?.code, status: e?.status, message: e?.message })
  }
  ```
  Comment above (lines 25-27) cites SECURITY_AUDIT.md finding N-8 (2026-07-04): never log raw Postgres/PostgREST error objects (`details`/`hint` may carry row data). Called from 2 catch-all 500 paths: AuthError default (line 51) and Postgres-error default (line 70). This is exactly where `Sentry.captureException(error, { extra: { code: e?.code, status: e?.status } })` belongs — same sanitization discipline, never the raw error object.
- Version/compat (websearched, since no MCP tools were exposed to this executor): `@sentry/nextjs` current major (10.x) declares peer support for Next `^16.0.0-0` — 16.2.9 covered. Turbopack baseline is Next ≥15.4.1, well below 16.2.9 — no blocker. CAVEAT: two webpack-only `withSentryConfig` options (`disableLogger`, `automaticVercelMonitors`) are no-ops/deprecated under Turbopack — exclude them from the eventual config.
- pnpm build-script gate (flagged risk, now confirmed with hard precedent): `pnpm-workspace.yaml` already has:
  ```yaml
  allowBuilds:
    sharp: true
    unrs-resolver: true
  ```
  pnpm ≥10 blocks dependency postinstall scripts by default; this repo pins `pnpm@11.9.0` and already uses the newer `allowBuilds` key (not the older `onlyBuiltDependencies`), confirming it's on pnpm-v11-compatible config vocabulary. `@sentry/cli` (pulled transitively by `@sentry/nextjs`, used for sourcemap upload) ships a postinstall script downloading a platform binary — without adding it to `allowBuilds`, that script is silently skipped and sourcemap upload during `next build` could fail or produce unsymbolicated stacks in Sentry. This is a genuinely new risk item, not previously covered by the wishlist.

**3. Playwright E2E + CI — confirmed current CI shape + hard external blocker**
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (only workflow file) has exactly 4 jobs, trigger `on: pull_request` + `push: [main]`:
  - `lint` → `pnpm lint`
  - `typecheck` → `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit`
  - `test` → `pnpm test`
  - `build` → `pnpm build` with 4 placeholder env vars (`NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`).
  - A 5th `e2e` job needs REAL Supabase secrets (placeholders can't authenticate), and since `on:` triggers are shared across all jobs in this file, "PR-only" needs an explicit job-level `if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'` — the existing file has no per-job trigger gating precedent.
- Seeded-account blocker verified verbatim against CLAUDE.md: 3 seeded accounts (2 `usuario` + 1 `administrador`) are currently BANNED in Supabase Auth (`banned_until`), credentials intentionally undocumented ("pedir acceso al dueño del proyecto"). This is a hard external/non-code blocker — auth spec and admin-flow spec cannot actually run in CI until accounts are unbanned or dedicated CI test accounts are provisioned by the project owner. Specs can be written/reviewed now; execution is gated externally.
- RLS delete rule for `publicacion` confirmed precisely from `docs/Vitrina_BD_Conexion_Backend.md` (lines 229-240): base policy `eliminar_propio` (`auth.uid() = autor_id`) PLUS additive `admin_elimina` (`using (public.es_admin())`) — both PERMISSIVE, OR-combined. Supports the "publicar" spec's `afterEach` cleanup (author deletes own row). Confirmed `DELETE` handler exists at `app/api/publicaciones/[id]/route.ts` line 124 (`export async function DELETE`), requires `supabase.auth.getUser()` session (line 131-133 → 401 if none).
- Admin-flow spec's plan to create its own solicitud rather than consume the seeded `pendiente` one is consistent with CLAUDE.md's documented seed data (exactly one seeded `pendiente`, one `aceptada`, one `rechazada`).
- Vitest fully wired already: `vitest.config.ts` (`environment: 'node'`, `include: ['**/*.test.ts']`, `@/*` alias), `package.json` `"test": "vitest run"`, 4 test files under `lib/**` (`lib/storage/validateFile.test.ts`, `lib/supabase/handleError.test.ts`, `lib/utils/revistaCiclo.test.ts`, `lib/validation/correoAdmin.test.ts`) + 5 more under `supabase/functions/**`, and a dedicated `test` CI job. Adding Jest would be pure duplication — confirmed.

### Out-of-scope confirmations
- **Staging**: no `vercel.json` in repo root (Glob empty) — deploy config lives entirely in Vercel's own git integration, confirming "no new infra" framing. Neither `CLAUDE.md` nor a `CONTRIBUTING.md` (doesn't exist) currently documents PR preview URLs as the de facto staging step — confirmed real gap for a short process note.
- **Jest**: confirmed pure duplication (see Vitest wiring above).
- **Load testing**: confirmed `docs/Vitrina_Estado_Proyecto.md` marks Vercel deployment "⚠️ No verificado" in 3 places (lines 52, 232, 275) — matches the stated rationale for deferring load testing until deployment itself is confirmed.

### Risks / unknowns the earlier planning pass may have missed
1. **pnpm `allowBuilds` gate for `@sentry/cli`** — confirmed real via existing `sharp`/`unrs-resolver` precedent in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`; must add `@sentry/cli` (or the resolved package name) to `allowBuilds` or sourcemap upload silently no-ops.
2. **Turbopack-incompatible `withSentryConfig` options** (`disableLogger`, `automaticVercelMonitors`) must be excluded from config — design-phase detail, not a blocker.
3. **`app/global-error.tsx` must define its own `<html>/<body>`** — can't copy-paste the 3 existing segment error boundaries as-is.
4. **CI job-level `if:` gating needed** for PR-only `e2e` job since top-level `on:` triggers are shared across all 4 existing jobs today.
5. **Seeded accounts banned** — hard external blocker for actually exercising (not writing) the auth/admin Playwright specs; recommend sequencing as "write specs + `continue-on-error: true`" now, account provisioning as a separate tracked action for the project owner.
6. `package.json` `"name": "back"` (not `es_vitrina`) — cosmetic, noted only because Sentry project naming / CI job naming sometimes borrows the package name.
7. `pnpm@11.9.0` is a notably new major version; peer-dep declarations for `@sentry/nextjs`/`@sentry/cli` were checked via websearch only (no context7/npm MCP tool was exposed to this executor) — worth a real smoke install during design/apply rather than assuming further.

### Recommendation
All 3 in-scope areas are safe to proceed to `sdd-propose`: no conflicting existing tooling, clear integration points identified with exact file/line anchors, and the CSP/pnpm-allowBuilds/Turbopack-option risks are now documented so the design phase isn't surprised. The seeded-account ban is the one item that should be called out explicitly in the proposal as an external dependency outside this change's control.

### Ready for Proposal
Yes — proceed to `sdd-propose` for `dev-tooling-quality`.

observations.title: sdd/dev-tooling-quality/proposal
observations.content:
# Proposal: Dev Tooling & Quality Baseline

## Intent
Vitrina has zero local quality gates, zero production error visibility, and zero committed E2E coverage. Bad commits reach CI unfiltered, runtime errors vanish silently (only sanitized `console.error`), and critical flows (auth/session-refresh, publish, admin curation) have no repeatable regression net. Add three orthogonal dev-tooling layers to catch defects earlier without touching the Supabase security model.

## Scope

### In Scope
- **P1 Hooks (husky + lint-staged)**: pre-commit → `lint-staged` (`eslint --fix` on staged `*.{ts,tsx}`); pre-push → `tsc --noEmit && pnpm test`. Add `package.json` scripts `prepare`, `typecheck`, and `lint-staged` block. No Playwright in local hooks.
- **P2 Sentry (@sentry/nextjs)**: new `instrumentation.ts`, `instrumentation-client.ts`, `sentry.server.config.ts`, `sentry.edge.config.ts`, `app/global-error.tsx` (own `<html>/<body>`). Modify 3 `error.tsx` (capture in `useEffect`), `logServerError` (sanitized `captureException`, never raw error), `next.config.ts` (`withSentryConfig` + `tunnelRoute:'/monitoring'` so CSP `connect-src` stays strict). Source maps uploaded; add `@sentry/cli` to `allowBuilds`. Low `tracesSampleRate`, `environment` from `VERCEL_ENV`.
- **P3 Playwright E2E (@playwright/test), committed**: `playwright.config.ts` (chromium-only), `e2e/auth.spec.ts`, `e2e/publicar.spec.ts` (RLS self-delete cleanup), optional `e2e/admin-solicitud.spec.ts` (creates own solicitud). New CI job `e2e` (PR-only via job `if:`, `continue-on-error:true`, real Supabase secrets).
- Short CONTRIBUTING.md/CLAUDE.md note: Vercel PR previews are the de-facto staging step.

### Out of Scope (non-goals)
- Staging branch/env — Vercel PR previews already cover it; process note only.
- Jest — Vitest fully wired; pure duplication.
- Load testing (k6/etc.) — deferred until Vercel deploy is verified.

## Capabilities
### New Capabilities
- `git-quality-hooks`: local pre-commit/pre-push gates.
- `error-observability`: Sentry client/server/edge capture + sourcemaps.
- `e2e-testing`: committed Playwright flows + CI job.
### Modified Capabilities
- None (dev-tooling; no user-facing API/schema/UI behavior changes).

## Approach
Three independent, additively-installable layers. Each ships behind existing precedents found in exploration (allowBuilds, CSP tunnel, RLS delete, CI job shape). Sentry only observes errors — response envelope and `handleError` contract unchanged.

## Risks
| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|-----------|------------|
| Sourcemaps silently skip (`@sentry/cli` postinstall gated) | Med | Add to `allowBuilds`, smoke-install |
| `global-error.tsx` missing `<html>/<body>` | Med | Explicit new file, not copy of scoped boundaries |
| Turbopack-incompatible Sentry opts | Low | Exclude `disableLogger`/`automaticVercelMonitors` |
| E2E flaky/non-repeatable seed data | Med | Self-create+cleanup; `continue-on-error` first |

## Rollback Plan
Each layer reverts independently: remove `.husky/`+scripts; drop `withSentryConfig` wrap + Sentry files; delete `e2e/`+CI job. No schema/data mutations to undo.

## Dependencies (external, owner-provisioned)
- Sentry org/project/DSN + `SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN` in Vercel.
- Real Supabase test credentials as GH Actions secrets.
- **Blocker**: 3 seeded Auth accounts are banned (`banned_until`) — auth/admin specs writable now, executable only after owner unbans or provisions dedicated CI accounts.

## Success Criteria
- [ ] pre-commit blocks lint errors; pre-push blocks type/test failures.
- [ ] Errors appear in Sentry with symbolicated stacks and env tags; CSP unchanged.
- [ ] `e2e` job runs on PRs (non-blocking) and passes once accounts provisioned.
- [ ] Staging-via-preview note documented; no Supabase schema change.

observations.title: sdd/dev-tooling-quality/spec
observations.content:
# Spec: Dev Tooling & Quality Baseline

Three new capabilities (no existing specs — full specs, not deltas).

## Capability: git-quality-hooks

### Requirement: Automatic hook installation
The system MUST install husky hooks automatically via a `prepare` script run on `pnpm install`, with no manual step.

#### Scenario: Fresh clone install
- GIVEN a fresh clone with no `.husky/` directory
- WHEN `pnpm install` runs
- THEN `prepare` executes and `.husky/pre-commit` and `.husky/pre-push` exist and are executable

### Requirement: Pre-commit scoped linting
Pre-commit MUST run `lint-staged` against staged `*.{ts,tsx}` files only, never the whole repo.

#### Scenario: Lint error in staged file
- GIVEN a staged `.ts` file with an ESLint violation
- WHEN `git commit` runs
- THEN pre-commit blocks the commit

#### Scenario: Unstaged files unaffected
- GIVEN an unstaged `.ts` file with lint errors and a clean staged file
- WHEN `git commit` runs
- THEN the commit succeeds (proves scoping to staged files)

### Requirement: Pre-push type/test gate
Pre-push MUST run `tsc --noEmit && pnpm test` and MUST block the push if either fails.

#### Scenario: Type error blocks push
- GIVEN a type error exists in the repo
- WHEN `git push` runs
- THEN pre-push fails and the push is rejected

#### Scenario: Test failure blocks push
- GIVEN a Vitest failure exists
- WHEN `git push` runs
- THEN pre-push fails and the push is rejected

### Requirement: No Playwright in local hooks
Pre-commit and pre-push MUST NOT execute Playwright specs; `e2e/` runs only in CI.

#### Scenario: Push with passing type/test
- GIVEN typecheck and unit tests pass
- WHEN `git push` runs
- THEN pre-push succeeds without invoking anything under `e2e/`

## Capability: error-observability

### Requirement: Scoped boundary capture
`app/error.tsx`, `app/(admin)/error.tsx`, `app/(main)/error.tsx` MUST call `Sentry.captureException(error)` when rendered, in addition to existing `ErrorState` UI.

#### Scenario: Admin segment error
- GIVEN an error thrown inside `app/(admin)`
- WHEN the boundary renders
- THEN Sentry receives the exception and `ErrorState` still displays retry UI

### Requirement: Root-layout failure capture
A new `app/global-error.tsx` MUST capture root-layout-level crashes and MUST render its own `<html>`/`<body>` (it cannot assume the root layout is mounted).

#### Scenario: Root layout throws
- GIVEN an error escapes the root layout
- WHEN Next.js renders the fallback
- THEN `global-error.tsx` renders complete `<html>/<body>` markup and Sentry captures the event

### Requirement: Sanitized server-side capture
`logServerError` in `lib/supabase/handleError.ts` MUST send Sentry only `{ code, status }` as extra context and MUST NOT send the raw Postgres/PostgREST error object (same rule as its existing sanitized `console.error`, per SECURITY_AUDIT.md N-8).

#### Scenario: AuthError default path
- GIVEN an unhandled AuthError reaches the default 500 branch
- WHEN `logServerError` runs
- THEN the Sentry event's extra data contains only `code`/`status`, never `message`/`details`/`hint` from the raw error

#### Scenario: Postgres-error default path
- GIVEN an unhandled Postgres error reaches the default branch
- WHEN `logServerError` runs
- THEN the same sanitization applies

### Requirement: CSP-safe browser transport
Browser-side Sentry events MUST route through `tunnelRoute: '/monitoring'`; the existing CSP `connect-src 'self' ...` MUST NOT be widened to allow `*.sentry.io`.

#### Scenario: Client captures an event
- GIVEN a client-side error is captured
- WHEN the SDK sends the event
- THEN the network request targets the same-origin `/monitoring` route, not a `sentry.io` domain

### Requirement: Environment tagging
Every captured event MUST carry an `environment` tag sourced from `process.env.VERCEL_ENV`.

#### Scenario: Event from preview deploy
- GIVEN the app runs with `VERCEL_ENV=preview`
- WHEN an event is captured
- THEN the event's `environment` tag equals `preview`

### Requirement: No Supabase security involvement
Sentry integration MUST NOT alter RLS policies, RPCs, schema, or require `service_role`.

#### Scenario: Integration review
- GIVEN the Sentry capture code paths
- WHEN reviewed
- THEN none reference `service_role`, `admin.ts`, or schema changes

## Capability: e2e-testing

### Requirement: Auth session persistence
`e2e/auth.spec.ts` MUST verify a session survives a page reload (proxy.ts refresh), then verify logout clears it.

#### Scenario: Reload keeps session
- GIVEN a logged-in user
- WHEN the page reloads
- THEN the session remains active

#### Scenario: Logout clears session
- GIVEN an active session
- WHEN the user logs out
- THEN a protected route redirects to `/login`

### Requirement: Publicar spec self-cleanup
`e2e/publicar.spec.ts` MUST create a real `publicacion` row and MUST delete it in `afterEach` via the author's own DELETE, relying on the RLS self-delete rule confirmed at `app/api/publicaciones/[id]/route.ts:124`.

#### Scenario: Successful run cleans up
- GIVEN the spec creates a publicacion
- WHEN `afterEach` runs
- THEN the author deletes the row and no leftover data remains

#### Scenario: Mid-test failure still cleans up
- GIVEN an assertion fails mid-test
- WHEN `afterEach` runs
- THEN cleanup still executes

### Requirement: Admin-solicitud spec independence (optional)
If `e2e/admin-solicitud.spec.ts` is included, it MUST create its own solicitud via the public flow before resolving it as admin, and MUST NOT depend on or consume the single seeded `pendiente` row.

#### Scenario: Repeatable CI run
- GIVEN the spec runs in CI
- WHEN it creates and resolves its own solicitud
- THEN the seeded `pendiente` row remains untouched and the run is repeatable

### Requirement: CI job scope and trigger
The CI `e2e` job MUST trigger on `pull_request` only (not push-to-main) and MUST run with `continue-on-error: true`.

#### Scenario: PR opened
- GIVEN a pull request is opened
- WHEN CI runs
- THEN the `e2e` job executes non-blocking

#### Scenario: Push to main
- GIVEN a push to `main`
- WHEN CI runs
- THEN the `e2e` job does not execute

## Process Notes (non-functional, documented not implemented)
- Staging is NOT a new environment: Vercel PR previews already serve that role; this change only adds a documentation note, no infra.
- Jest and load testing are explicit non-goals — no requirement in this spec covers them (Vitest already fully wired; load testing deferred until Vercel deploy is verified).

observations.title: sdd/dev-tooling-quality/design
observations.content:
# Design: Dev Tooling & Quality Baseline

## Technical Approach
Three orthogonal, independently-revertible layers built on precedents from exploration (pnpm `allowBuilds`, CSP `tunnelRoute`, RLS self-delete, existing CI jobs). Sentry only OBSERVES — `handleError` response envelope and status mapping are untouched. Hooks are local pre-flight; CI (`lint`/`typecheck`/`test`/`build`) stays source of truth even under `--no-verify`. No schema/`service_role`.

## Architecture Decisions
| Decision | Choice | Rejected | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hook split | pre-commit=`lint-staged`(eslint --fix); pre-push=`tsc --noEmit && pnpm test` | tsc/test in pre-commit | tsc is whole-program; off-commit keeps commits fast, push still gated |
| Client init file | `instrumentation-client.ts` | `sentry.client.config.ts` | current @sentry/nextjs v10 / Next16 convention; legacy file deprecated |
| Ingest transport | `tunnelRoute:'/monitoring'` (same-origin) | add `*.sentry.io` to `connect-src` | keeps CSP strict (hard constraint) |
| Tunnel route matcher | exclude `/monitoring` from `proxy.ts` matcher negative-lookahead | leave matcher as-is | Sentry Turbopack guidance (verified by orchestrator): tunnel route must be a fixed string excluded from middleware/proxy matching. Repo runs Turbopack by default + `proxy.ts` matches `/monitoring`. Would NOT redirect (no `/monitoring` branch in proxy) but WOULD add one `supabase.auth.getUser()` round-trip per browser Sentry event, silently, forever — the exact "no build/lint/type error" footgun class this project warns about |
| Sourcemap postinstall | add `@sentry/cli` to `allowBuilds` | leave default | pnpm11 blocks postinstall → unsymbolicated stacks |
| Turbopack opts | omit `disableLogger`/`automaticVercelMonitors` | include | no-ops/deprecated under Turbopack |
| `global-error.tsx` | self-contained `<html><body>`, minimal inline markup | reuse `ErrorState` | replaces root layout; globals.css/theme tokens not mounted |
| E2E auth | `setup` project writes `storageState`; specs reuse | login per spec | one real UI login; fast, stable |
| e2e CI gate | job-level `if: github.event_name=='pull_request'` + `continue-on-error:true` | edit top-level `on:` | triggers shared across all jobs; non-blocking until accounts exist |

## File Changes
| File | Action | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `.husky/pre-commit` | Create | `pnpm exec lint-staged` (husky v9 = bare command, no header) |
| `.husky/pre-push` | Create | `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm test` |
| `package.json` | Modify | scripts `prepare:\"husky\"`, `typecheck:\"tsc --noEmit\"`, `test:e2e:\"playwright test\"`; `lint-staged:{\"*.{ts,tsx}\":\"eslint --fix\"}`; devDeps husky, lint-staged, @sentry/nextjs, @playwright/test |
| `instrumentation.ts` | Create | `register()` NEXT_RUNTIME branch + `onRequestError` (shape verified correct vs current Sentry Next.js docs) |
| `instrumentation-client.ts` | Create | browser `Sentry.init` + `onRouterTransitionStart` |
| `sentry.server.config.ts` / `sentry.edge.config.ts` | Create | runtime `Sentry.init` (edge branch = forward-compat; proxy.ts pinned nodejs) |
| `app/global-error.tsx` | Create | own `<html>/<body>` + `captureException` in useEffect |
| `app/error.tsx`, `app/(main)/error.tsx`, `app/(admin)/error.tsx` | Modify | add `useEffect(()=>Sentry.captureException(error),[error])`, keep ErrorState UI |
| `lib/supabase/handleError.ts` | Modify | `logServerError` also calls sanitized `captureException` |
| `proxy.ts` | Modify | error-observability: add `monitoring` to the matcher negative-lookahead (one-line change) so the Sentry tunnel route bypasses the session-refresh proxy; add inline rationale comment (Sentry Turbopack guidance — tunnel must skip proxy to avoid a `supabase.auth.getUser()` round-trip per browser error event). New matcher: `'/((?!_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|monitoring|.*\\.(?:svg|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp)$).*)'` |
| `next.config.ts` | Modify | `export default withSentryConfig(nextConfig,{...})` (line 71 wrap) |
| `pnpm-workspace.yaml` | Modify | `allowBuilds: @sentry/cli: true` (sharp/unrs-resolver precedent) |
| `playwright.config.ts` | Create | chromium-only, webServer, storageState |
| `e2e/support/auth.setup.ts` | Create | real UI login → save `e2e/.auth/user.json` |
| `e2e/auth.spec.ts` | Create | unauth login+logout UI flow (`storageState:undefined`) |
| `e2e/publicar.spec.ts` | Create | create pub + `afterEach` self-DELETE (RLS `eliminar_propio`) |
| `e2e/admin-solicitud.spec.ts` | Create (optional) | create own solicitud, admin resolve |
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | Modify | 5th `e2e` job |
| `.gitignore` | Modify | `/test-results/`, `/playwright-report/`, `/e2e/.auth/`, `.env.sentry-build-plugin` |
| `CONTRIBUTING.md` | Create | note: Vercel PR previews = de-facto staging |

## Key Interfaces
`instrumentation.ts` (shape confirmed vs current Sentry Next.js docs):
```ts
export async function register() {
  if (process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME === 'nodejs') await import('./sentry.server.config')
  if (process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME === 'edge') await import('./sentry.edge.config')
}
export const onRequestError = Sentry.captureRequestError
```
Every `Sentry.init` guarded by DSN presence (`SENTRY_DSN`/`NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN`) → no-op locally; `tracesSampleRate:0.1`, `environment: process.env.VERCEL_ENV`.

`proxy.ts` matcher (tunnel-route exclusion — one-line change + inline comment):
```ts
export const config = {
  matcher: [
    // '/monitoring' is the Sentry tunnelRoute; exclude it so proxy session-refresh
    // (supabase.auth.getUser) does not run on every browser-side error event (Turbopack guidance).
    '/((?!_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|monitoring|.*\\.(?:svg|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp)$).*)',
  ],
}
```

`logServerError` (sanitized — NEVER raw object, N-8 discipline):
```ts
Sentry.captureException(error, { extra: { code: e?.code, status: e?.status } })
```

`withSentryConfig(nextConfig, { org, project, authToken:SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN, silent:!process.env.CI, tunnelRoute:'/monitoring', widenClientFileUpload:true })`.

`playwright.config.ts`:
```ts
webServer:{ command:'pnpm build && pnpm start', url:'http://localhost:3000', reuseExistingServer:!process.env.CI }
projects:[ {name:'setup',testMatch:/auth\.setup\.ts/}, {name:'chromium',dependencies:['setup'],use:{storageState:'e2e/.auth/user.json'}} ]
reporter: process.env.CI ? 'github' : 'list'
```
`auth.spec.ts` opts out of state (`test.use({storageState:undefined})`).

CI `e2e` job: `if: github.event_name=='pull_request'`, `continue-on-error:true`, env from GH secrets (`E2E_SUPABASE_*`, `E2E_*_EMAIL/PASSWORD`); steps checkout → pnpm/node → `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` → `pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium` → `pnpm test:e2e` → `actions/upload-artifact` of `playwright-report/` `if: failure()`.

## Testing Strategy
| Layer | What | Approach |
|---|---|---|
| Hooks | lint/type/test gate fires | bad-commit smoke |
| Sentry | symbolicated capture, CSP intact, tunnel bypasses proxy | throwaway route on PR preview |
| E2E | auth, publicar(+cleanup), admin | Playwright chromium |

## Migration / Rollout
Additive; no data migration. Each layer reverts independently (proposal rollback plan). `proxy.ts` matcher change reverts by removing `monitoring|` from the negative-lookahead.

## Blocking Prerequisites (external — NOT file-work in this change)
- Sentry org/project/DSN + `SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN`/`SENTRY_ORG`/`SENTRY_PROJECT`.
- GH secrets: real Supabase test creds + test-account passwords.
- 3 seeded Auth accounts BANNED (`banned_until`) → specs written now, `continue-on-error` until owner unbans/provisions CI accounts.

## Open Questions
- [x] RESOLVED (orchestrator verified vs current Sentry Next.js docs): `instrumentation.ts` `register()`/`onRequestError` shape is correct as designed; tunnel + Turbopack requires excluding `/monitoring` from the `proxy.ts` matcher (merged above). Apply phase should still confirm `instrumentation-client.ts`/`captureRouterTransitionStart` naming against the installed `@sentry/nextjs` version.
- [ ] admin-solicitud cleanup: prefer REJECT path (no `revista_articulo` row to undo) over accept.

400-line budget risk: High (combined) / Low per capability

- Files: `package.json` (husky/lint-staged deps+scripts), `.husky/pre-commit`, `.husky/pre-push`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

## Batch 2 of 3 — error-observability (Sentry) — COMPLETE (original + corrective fix pass)

Branch `feat/dev-tooling-sentry` off `chore/dev-tooling-hooks` tip (`57d30a3`). 2 commits:
- `c3b7bef` feat(observability): add Sentry error tracking
- `98af7c3` fix(observability): stop leaking raw error object to Sentry (post-review corrective fix — sanitized
  `logServerError`'s Sentry payload to a code/status-only synthetic Error, tightened `proxy.ts`'s tunnel-route
  matcher from `monitoring` to `monitoring(?:/|$)` to stop prefix-matching e.g. `/monitoring-dashboard`).
- 12/12 assigned Phase 2 tasks complete.

## Batch 3 of 3 — e2e-testing (Playwright) — COMPLETE (original + 2nd corrective fix pass)

**Mode**: Standard (config/spec authoring; no TDD module applies).

Branch `test/dev-tooling-playwright` off `feat/dev-tooling-sentry` tip (`98af7c3`). 2 commits:
- `4c532f5` test(e2e): add Playwright suite for auth, publicar, and solicitud flows (original, full detail in
  prior revision of this observation).
- `797bee5` fix(e2e): address reviewer findings on Playwright suite reliability (this session's corrective pass,
  after two independent fresh-context reviews: review-reliability + review-resilience).

### Corrective pass (`797bee5`) — 7 findings addressed

| # | Severity | Finding | Fix | File(s) |
|---|----------|---------|-----|---------|
| 1 | BLOCKER | `crearPublicacionViaUI` derived id from post-submit redirect URL; PublicarForm deliberately skips the redirect on a tag-attach failure (shows inline warning instead), so `created` could stay `undefined` and `afterEach` cleanup would never fire, orphaning the row in the one real Supabase project | Capture the id straight from the `POST /api/publicaciones` JSON response body (`page.waitForResponse` registered BEFORE the submit click, `Promise.all([...])` pattern), independent of whatever happens with the redirect/tag-attach afterwards | `e2e/support/publicaciones.ts` |
| 2 | CRITICAL | Shared test-user account: `auth.spec.ts` does a real login+logout (global-scope `signOut`, confirmed default in `@supabase/auth-js` — revokes ALL sessions for that user) of the SAME account whose storageState `publicar.spec.ts` reuses; different spec files run in separate parallel workers by default, so the logout could invalidate `publicar.spec.ts`'s session mid-flight | Did NOT touch `app/api/auth/logout/route.ts`'s signOut scope (real product/security behavior, out of scope). Split `auth.spec.ts` into its own Playwright **project** (`chromium-auth-lifecycle`) with `dependencies: ['setup', 'chromium']` — guarantees every test in `chromium` (incl. `publicar.spec.ts`) finishes before `auth.spec.ts` starts. Rejected `workers: 1` alone: reasoned through it explicitly — Playwright's default file-discovery order is alphabetical, so `auth.spec.ts` would still run BEFORE `publicar.spec.ts` even serially, and global signOut permanently revokes the shared refresh token (not just during a concurrency window) — so `workers:1` would convert an intermittent bug into a guaranteed one. Project dependencies are the documented cross-file-ordering mechanism (https://playwright.dev/docs/test-projects#dependencies) | `playwright.config.ts` |
| 3 | CRITICAL (both reviewers) | Job-level `continue-on-error: true` covered every step uniformly, masking real infra failures (broken lockfile, failed browser install, webServer timeout) identically to the accepted "banned test accounts" failure | Moved `continue-on-error: true` from job level to ONLY the `pnpm test:e2e` step (`id: e2e_tests`). Traced GHA semantics: step-level `continue-on-error` overrides that step's `conclusion` to `success` (what determines job pass/fail) but leaves `outcome` as the real pre-override result — so changed `upload-artifact`'s `if: failure()` (would now silently never fire) to `if: steps.e2e_tests.outcome == 'failure'`. Verified via `js-yaml` parse (resolved from `node_modules/.pnpm/js-yaml@5.2.1`, a transitive eslint dep — same fallback as prior batches): job-level `continue-on-error` is now `undefined`, step has `continue-on-error:true`+`id:e2e_tests`, upload step's `if` is exactly `steps.e2e_tests.outcome == 'failure'`; other 4 jobs + top-level `on:` byte-for-byte unchanged | `.github/workflows/ci.yml` |
| 4 | CRITICAL | `webServer`'s default 60s timeout must cover the entire `pnpm build && pnpm start` for a ~90-route Next 16 Turbopack app; could abort the whole suite before any test runs | Measured: cold production build (deleted `.next`, same placeholder env as CI's `build` job) took **30.21s wall-clock** locally. Added explicit `timeout: 180_000` (~6x measured local time) to pad for slower/contended CI runners | `playwright.config.ts` |
| 5 | WARNING | `ci.yml`'s job comment said the blocker was "the 3 seeded accounts are banned"; `env.ts`'s comment said the vars "point at a dedicated, unbanned test account" (implying NOT the seeded ones) — two different stories | Aligned both comments on one story: requires `E2E_TEST_USER_EMAIL/PASSWORD` + `E2E_TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL/PASSWORD` secrets pointing at dedicated test accounts, separate from the 3 seeded/possibly-banned accounts in CLAUDE.md; provisioning them is an external, owner-driven prerequisite (design's "Blocking Prerequisites" section) | `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `e2e/support/env.ts` |
| 6 | WARNING | `auth.spec.ts` only tested the happy path (login→reload→logout→redirect); no regression coverage for invalid credentials | Added a small test: wrong password → asserts `role="alert"` error renders (LoginForm.tsx), URL stays `/login` (no redirect), no `Cerrar sesión` button, and no cookie whose name includes `auth-token` gets set | `e2e/auth.spec.ts` |
| 7 | SUGGESTION | No `retries` configured — real browser E2E against a live backend is flake-prone | Added `retries: process.env.CI ? 2 : 0` (standard Playwright idiom) | `playwright.config.ts` |

### Verification (corrective pass)
- `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` — clean, both before and re-checked after commit (lint-staged's `eslint --fix` ran during the pre-commit hook and could have touched formatting; re-ran tsc post-commit to confirm no regression).
- `pnpm lint` — clean.
- `pnpm exec playwright test --list` — 6 tests / 5 files (grew from 5/5 pre-fix: `auth.spec.ts` now has 2 tests instead of 1, and is grouped under its own new `chromium-auth-lifecycle` project instead of `chromium`). No config errors.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — parsed with `js-yaml` (resolved via `node_modules/.pnpm/js-yaml@5.2.1/node_modules/js-yaml`, since a plain top-level `require('js-yaml')` doesn't resolve under pnpm's non-hoisted store) — confirmed exact structure described in Finding 3's row above.
- `pnpm test` (Vitest) — 9 files / 95 tests passing, unchanged.
- Diff size: 125 changed lines across 5 files (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `e2e/auth.spec.ts`, `e2e/support/env.ts`, `e2e/support/publicaciones.ts`, `playwright.config.ts`) — well within the 400-line review budget.

### Explicitly not touched (per instruction — accepted as-is)
- `admin-solicitud.spec.ts`'s brittle `contains(@class, "rounded-md")` selector — would need a `data-testid` on `SolicitudesList.tsx`, out of scope for this dev-tooling PR.
- `admin-solicitud.spec.ts`'s live-precondition `test.skip()` — already correctly a real skip, not a false pass.

### Auth-blocker limitation (still applies, unchanged)
The 3 seeded Supabase Auth accounts are still banned. Full green E2E execution against real credentials was NOT
attempted/claimed in this corrective pass (no live browser run this session — the fixes were verified statically:
tsc, lint, `playwright test --list`, YAML parse, Vitest, plus a real local `pnpm build` timing measurement).

## Remaining Tasks
- [ ] 4.2: document blocking prerequisites for green CI e2e (Sentry secrets, GH secrets for real + E2E test
  Supabase creds, unban/provision the 3 seeded Auth accounts or dedicated E2E accounts). Documentation-only,
  no code — recommended as a short follow-up, not blocking for this PR chain.

## Workload / PR Boundary
- Mode: chained PR slice (feature-branch-chain) — 3rd and final child PR in the chain, now with a corrective
  fix commit on top.
- Current work unit: Unit 3 — e2e-testing (Playwright).
- Boundary: `test/dev-tooling-playwright` has 2 commits (`4c532f5`, `797bee5`) on top of `feat/dev-tooling-sentry`
  tip (`98af7c3`). Not pushed; no PR opened.
- Estimated review budget impact: original ~458 lines (incl. lockfile) + this pass's 125 lines = still a single,
  cohesive, independently-revertible work unit (e2e-testing only).

## Status
20/21 total change tasks complete across all 3 batches (only 4.2 — a documentation note, not code — remains).
All 3 planned PRs (hooks, Sentry, Playwright) are implemented on their respective branches, chained as
`chore/dev-tooling-hooks` → `feat/dev-tooling-sentry` → `test/dev-tooling-playwright` (now 2 commits, includes
the corrective fix pass), off tracker `chore/dev-tooling-tracker` (off `origin/main`). None pushed; no PRs
opened — ready for the user/orchestrator to review and decide on pushing/opening PRs. Recommended next:
sdd-verify, then judgment-day per the post-apply trigger rule.

# Verification Report: Dev Tooling & Quality Baseline

**Change**: dev-tooling-quality
**Mode**: Full artifacts (spec + design + tasks + apply-progress all present)

Consistent with orchestrator brief's expectation (non-blocking, known gap). Classified WARNING (cleanup/doc task), not CRITICAL, per sdd-verify Decision Gates.

All code tasks (1.1-1.4, 2.1-2.12, 3.1-3.9, 4.1) spot-checked against real files, not just trusted from checkboxes — see below.

## Spec Compliance Matrix

| Requirement | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Automatic hook installation (prepare script) | PASS | package.json `prepare:"husky"`; `.husky/_` auto-generated with 0o755 wrapper scripts on `pnpm install`; core.hooksPath=.husky/_ |
| Pre-commit scoped linting (staged-only) | PASS (runtime-tested) | Live smoke test: staged file with `react-hooks/rules-of-hooks` error → commit blocked (exit 1, hook output shown, no commit created). Staged clean file + unstaged violation → commit succeeded (proves scoping). Test commits reset --hard afterward; worktree confirmed clean at correct tip. |
| Pre-push type/test gate | PASS | `.husky/pre-push` = `pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test`; both commands independently run and passed (tsc clean, 95/95 vitest) |
| No Playwright in local hooks | PASS | Hook file contents contain no `e2e`/`playwright` reference |
| Scoped boundary capture (error.tsx x3) | PASS | app/error.tsx, app/(admin)/error.tsx, app/(main)/error.tsx all call `Sentry.captureException(error)` in useEffect, keep ErrorState UI |
| Root-layout failure capture (global-error.tsx) | PASS | Renders own `<html>/<body>`, no ErrorState/globals.css dependency, captures via useEffect |
| Sanitized server-side capture | PASS | `logServerError` builds a synthetic `Error` from `code`/`status` only, passes that (never raw `error`/`e`) to `Sentry.captureException`; `extra` limited to `{code,status}`. Confirmed both by source read AND by 2 dedicated Vitest tests (`never passes the raw error object...`) — both passing in the 95/95 run. This is the FIXED version (commit 98af7c3), verified current, not the original buggy one. |
| CSP-safe browser transport | PASS | `next.config.ts` `tunnelRoute:'/monitoring'`; CSP `connect-src 'self' <supabase host> <supabase wss>` — no `sentry.io` added anywhere in the diff |
| Environment tagging | PASS w/ WARNING | Server/edge configs use `process.env.VERCEL_ENV`; client uses `process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_ENV` (necessary adaptation — VERCEL_ENV is server-only). WARNING: `NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_ENV` is only populated if the Vercel project has "Automatically expose System Environment Variables" enabled — an unverified external precondition; if off, client events silently tag `'development'` even in prod/preview (silent-misbehavior class risk, same footgun pattern this repo already documents elsewhere). |
| No Supabase security involvement | PASS | Zero diff in `docs/`, zero diff in `app/api/**`, zero `service_role` additions (only a code comment saying "no service_role, no admin bypass"), zero `.sql`/schema files touched |
| Auth session persistence (e2e) | PASS | `e2e/auth.spec.ts`: reload keeps session assertion + logout→redirect assertion; discoverable via `playwright test --list` |
| Publicar spec self-cleanup | PASS | `e2e/publicar.spec.ts` `afterEach` calls `eliminarPublicacion` unconditionally when `created` is set (survives mid-test failure) |
| Admin-solicitud spec independence (optional, included) | PASS | Creates its own publicación/solicitud via real UI flow, skips (not fails) on business-rule preconditions, doesn't touch seeded `pendiente` row |
| CI e2e job scope/trigger | PASS | `if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'` at job level (not push-to-main); `continue-on-error:true` on the `pnpm test:e2e` step only (not job-level) |

## Design Compliance

| Design decision | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| proxy.ts matcher excludes /monitoring | PASS | `monitoring(?:/|$)` present (tightened form, not the original loose `monitoring` substring match) — confirms the review-risk-flagged fix from 98af7c3 is live |
| withSentryConfig tunnelRoute | PASS | `tunnelRoute: '/monitoring'` in next.config.ts, CSP unchanged |
| Sourcemap postinstall (@sentry/cli allowBuilds) | PASS | `pnpm-workspace.yaml` has `allowBuilds: '@sentry/cli': true` |

| @sentry/nextjs dependency placement | MINOR DEVIATION (SUGGESTION) | Design's file-changes table listed it under devDeps; actual code correctly places it under `dependencies` (runtime import in server/client/edge code) — this is objectively the more correct placement, flagged only for design-doc accuracy, not a defect |

## Post-Review Fixes Verified Present at Current Tip

1. Sentry data-leak fix (98af7c3) — sanitized `logServerError` payload: CONFIRMED in source + tests.
2. proxy.ts matcher tightened to `monitoring(?:/|$)`: CONFIRMED.
3. Playwright 7-finding corrective pass (797bee5), all 7 independently confirmed present in current files:
   - id capture via `page.waitForResponse` on `POST /api/publicaciones` (not redirect URL) — `e2e/support/publicaciones.ts`
   - `chromium-auth-lifecycle` project with `dependencies:['setup','chromium']` — `playwright.config.ts`
   - `continue-on-error` moved to step level (`id: e2e_tests`), `upload-artifact` gated on `steps.e2e_tests.outcome == 'failure'` — `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
   - `webServer.timeout: 180_000` — `playwright.config.ts`
   - Doc-comment consistency between `env.ts` and `ci.yml` (same "dedicated test accounts, not the seeded ones" story) — both files
   - Invalid-credentials test added — `e2e/auth.spec.ts` (2nd test)
   - `retries: process.env.CI ? 2 : 0` — `playwright.config.ts`

## Independent Test/Build Execution (run by verifier, not trusted from prior self-reports)

- `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` → clean, 0 errors
- `pnpm lint` → clean, 0 errors/warnings surfaced
- `pnpm test` (Vitest) → **9 files, 95/95 tests passing** (matches claimed count, above the pre-change baseline of 92 — +3 new tests are the handleError Sentry-sanitization assertions)
- `pnpm exec playwright test --list` → **6 tests across 5 files** (2 setup, 1 admin-solicitud, 1 publicar, 1 auth-with-2-tests, grouped into `setup`/`chromium`/`chromium-auth-lifecycle` projects) — matches claim exactly, no config errors

Confirms `withSentryConfig` wrapping doesn't break Turbopack production build.
- Live git-hook smoke test (pre-commit): staged file with a genuine ESLint **error**-severity violation (`react-hooks/rules-of-hooks`) → commit correctly blocked; staged clean file + unstaged violation → commit correctly succeeded (scoping proven). Test commits were reset --hard afterward; worktree verified clean and back at commit `797bee5` with the exact expected 7-commit chain.

## Scope Boundary Check (hard invariants)

- Zero diff in `docs/` — no doc-sync obligation was skipped (this change touches no BD schema, no API contract, no UI screen/flow — only observability plumbing and dev tooling).

observations.content:
# Archive Report: Dev Tooling & Quality Baseline

**Change**: dev-tooling-quality  
**Artifact Store Mode**: engram  
**Archive Date**: 2026-07-21  
**Verdict**: **ARCHIVED** — Full SDD cycle complete (proposal → spec → design → tasks → apply → verify → archive).

---

## Traceability: Observation IDs

All artifacts persisted to Engram and linked here for the audit trail:

| Artifact | ID | Type | Created | Status |
|----------|----|----|---------|--------|
| proposal | #81 | architecture | 2026-07-20 12:06:05 | active |
| spec | #82 | architecture | 2026-07-20 12:09:45 | active |
| design | #83 | architecture | 2026-07-20 12:12:14 | active |
| tasks | #84 | architecture | 2026-07-20 12:17:11 | active |
| verify-report | #86 | architecture | 2026-07-21 10:52:27 | active |
| archive-report | *current* | architecture | 2026-07-21 | active |

---

## Change Summary

**Scope**: Three orthogonal dev-tooling capabilities added to Vitrina.

### Delivered Capabilities

1. **git-quality-hooks** — Local pre-commit/pre-push gates (husky + lint-staged).
   - Pre-commit: staged `.ts/.tsx` files scoped to `eslint --fix`.
   - Pre-push: full `tsc --noEmit && pnpm test` blocking push.
   - Reverts cleanly; no schema/security implications.

2. **error-observability** — Sentry client/server/edge capture + sourcemaps.
   - Scoped boundary capture in 3 `error.tsx` files + new `global-error.tsx`.
   - Sanitized server-side capture (N-8 discipline: never raw error objects).
   - CSP-safe tunnel route (`/monitoring`, same-origin, excludes `*.sentry.io` from `connect-src`).
   - Environment tagging from `VERCEL_ENV`; Turbopack-compatible.
   - Zero Supabase schema/RLS/service_role involvement.

3. **e2e-testing** — Committed Playwright specs + CI job.
   - Auth persistence (session reload + logout), publicar (with self-cleanup via RLS `eliminar_propio`), admin-solicitud (independent, optional).
   - CI job: PR-only (`if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'`), non-blocking (`continue-on-error: true` on step).
   - Chromium-only; setup project writes `storageState` for credential reuse.

---

## Implementation Status

### Code Delivery

**Code Location**: 3 chained local branches in isolated worktree `C:\proyectos\Es_Vitrina-dev-tooling`:
- `chore/dev-tooling-hooks` (foundation)
- `feat/dev-tooling-sentry` (error-observability, built on hooks)
- `test/dev-tooling-playwright` (e2e-testing, built on Sentry)

**Status**: All code implemented and verified. **NOT pushed to GitHub**; awaiting user's manual review/push/PR per explicit choice at apply time. Archiving closes the **planning/tracking/verification loop**, not the deployment/PR pipeline.

### Task Status

**20/21 tasks complete** (from design → tasks → apply → verify):

- ✓ Phase 1 (git-quality-hooks): 4/4 tasks.
- ✓ Phase 2 (error-observability): 12/12 tasks.
- ✓ Phase 3 (e2e-testing): 9/9 tasks.
- ⚠ Phase 4 (documentation): 1/2 tasks — **4.2 remains open** (prerequisite note on CI e2e secrets/account provisioning).

**4.2 Status**: Genuine documentation task (not code), explicitly marked as non-blocking and deferred in the orchestrator brief. Recommend closing before first merge, but does not block this archive.

---

## Verification Outcome

**Verdict**: **PASS WITH WARNINGS** (from verify-report #86).

### Issues

- **CRITICAL**: None.
- **WARNING (2)**:
  1. Task 4.2 doc note open (expected, non-blocking).
  2. Client-side Sentry `environment` tag depends on unverified Vercel project setting (`NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_ENV` exposure); silent-misbehavior risk if not enabled.
- **SUGGESTION (2)**:
  1. Design artifact's file-changes table listed `@sentry/nextjs` under devDependencies; actual code correctly placed it under `dependencies` (not a defect, doc accuracy only).
  2. `e2e/admin-solicitud.spec.ts` selector brittleness acknowledged; deferred `data-testid` follow-up.

### Post-Review Fixes Confirmed Live

Verifier confirmed all 7 corrective-pass commits from Playwright review cycle are present at current tip (`797bee5`):
- ✓ Sentry data-leak fix (98af7c3): sanitized `logServerError` payload + tests.
- ✓ proxy.ts matcher tightened to `monitoring(?:/|$)`.
- ✓ Playwright fixtures for id capture, session-race fix, artifact upload gating, timeout tuning, doc consistency, invalid-credentials test, retry config.

### Independent Runtime Verification

Verifier executed (not self-report):
- `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` → clean, 0 errors.
- `pnpm lint` → clean, 0 errors/warnings.
- `pnpm test` (Vitest) → **95/95 tests passing** (+3 new Sentry-sanitization tests vs pre-change 92).
- `pnpm exec playwright test --list` → **6 tests across 5 files**, 0 config errors.
- `pnpm build` (Turbopack) → succeeded, 62 routes, `withSentryConfig` hook ran cleanly, TypeScript check inside build passed.
- **Live git-hook smoke test**: staged file with ESLint error → commit blocked; staged clean + unstaged violation → commit succeeded (scoping proven).

**Scope boundary**: Zero diff in `docs/`, zero in `app/api/**`, zero `service_role`, zero schema changes. API contract and RLS unchanged.

---

## Architecture & Design Decisions Finalized

Per design artifact (#83), all architecture decisions are locked and verified:

| Decision | Rationale | Status |
|----------|-----------|--------|
| Hook split (pre-commit lint, pre-push tsc/test) | pre-commit fast, whole-program tsc deferred to pre-push | ✓ |
| Client init file (`instrumentation-client.ts`) | Current @sentry/nextjs v10 convention | ✓ |
| Tunnel route (`/monitoring` same-origin) | CSP strictness (hard constraint) | ✓ |
| Exclude `/monitoring` from proxy.ts matcher | Avoid `auth.getUser()` round-trip per browser error event (Turbopack guidance) | ✓ Tightened to `monitoring(?:/|$)` post-review |
| Add `@sentry/cli` to `allowBuilds` | Unblock sourcemap postinstall (pnpm11 guards) | ✓ |
| `global-error.tsx` self-contained markup | Replaces root layout; globals.css not available | ✓ |
| E2E setup project writes `storageState` | One real UI login; reusable, fast | ✓ |
| CI e2e job PR-only + non-blocking | Unblock PR flow until accounts provisioned | ✓ |

---

## Risks & Mitigation (Final)

| Risk | Mitigation | Residual |
|------|-----------|----------|
| Sourcemaps silently skip | Added to `allowBuilds`; smoke-installed ✓ | Low |
| `global-error.tsx` missing markup | Explicit new file, verified vs design ✓ | Low |
| Turbopack incompatibility | Excluded deprecated opts; build passed ✓ | Low |
| E2E flaky/non-repeatable | Self-create+cleanup; CI non-blocking ✓ | Low |
| Task 4.2 prerequisites unstated | Documented here; recommend CONTRIBUTING.md note before merge | Medium (deferred) |
| Client `environment` tag silent misbehavior | Depends on unverified Vercel setting | Medium (external) |

---

## What's NOT in Scope (Explicit Non-Goals)

- Staging environment — Vercel PR previews already cover (process note only, no infra).
- Jest — Vitest fully wired; no duplication introduced.
- Load testing (k6/etc.) — Deferred post-Vercel-deploy.
- Schema changes, service_role, RLS modification — Zero touch.

---

## Dependencies (External, Requires Owner Action)

Before CI e2e can run green:
- [ ] Sentry org/project + DSN + `SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN`/`SENTRY_ORG`/`SENTRY_PROJECT` provisioned in Vercel.
- [ ] GH secrets: real Supabase test credentials + test account `E2E_TEST_*_EMAIL`/`E2E_TEST_*_PASSWORD`.
