3. Instruct the subagent to read those exact `SKILL.md` files before reading, writing, reviewing, testing, or creating artifacts.
4. If no matching skill exists, proceed without project skill injection and report `skill_resolution: none`.

observations.title: sdd/report-documents/explore
observations.content:
## Exploration: Reporte de Documentos admin screen

### Current State
Spec source: `c:\proyectos\frontend_juventudes\report-documents-frontend-spec.md` (untracked, repo root). Porting a legacy CodeIgniter/jQuery/DataTables screen to Angular 18. Screen: filter folios (text/comma-list/bulk XLSX) -> server-paginated table with 6 fixed columns + dynamic per-document-type column pairs (Estatus/Observación) rebuilt from a headers endpoint on filter change. Plus Exportar Excel (export-all -> {ok,url} navigate) and Descargar plantilla (confirm dialog -> GET download). Access restricted to groupId in [40,70,80].

No backend companion spec exists in this repo — grep for `report.documents|report_documents|reportDocuments` across `src` only matches the frontend spec file itself. API contract section 9 of the frontend spec is the only reference; unconfirmed against real backend code.

### Affected Areas (verified against current code)
- `src/app/private/general-report/general-report.component.ts` — best structural template (component+models+services layout). Bulk XLSX parsing: drag/drop handlers lines 202-222, `processFile()` lines 224-247 (FileReader+XLSX.read, column B = `r[1]`, `rows.slice(6)` skip header rows 1-6/index 6, cap check `folios.length > 5000` at line 239 with Swal error). No 20000 ceiling exists in this Angular code (only in legacy PHP per spec) — general-report already enforces 5000 directly, matching report-documents' real business limit. Its own Export flow (`exportExcel()` lines 389-419) builds the xlsx CLIENT-SIDE from a raw JSON array response (`searchRequestsForExcel`) — this is NOT the `{ok,url}`-navigate pattern the new spec needs, so don't copy that part.
- `src/app/private/general-report/general-report.component.html:526` — single `<tr mat-header-row *matHeaderRowDef="displayedColumns; sticky: true">`. Confirms no 2-row/grouped header anywhere in this table.
- `src/app/private/carga-de-pagos/carga-de-pagos.component.ts` — `downloadTemplate()` (205-227) has the reusable SweetAlert2 "¿Desea descargar la plantilla?" confirm pattern; but its action `descargarDesdeAssets()` (196-203) is a static-asset anchor click, not usable as-is for an authenticated backend GET.
- `src/app/private/private-routing.module.ts` — routes are added directly to the `children` array under `authActivateGuard`+`authMatchGuard`; `reporteGeneral` entry confirmed at lines 70-74 (component registered without a wrapping module).
- `src/app/private/private.module.ts:53,77` — `GeneralReportComponent` imported and listed in `declarations` (NgModule-declared, NOT standalone) — contradicts nothing but worth noting the codebase mixes standalone (`CargaDePagosComponent`) and module-declared components; decide per design phase, lean toward matching general-report (most recent full-feature precedent).
- `src/app/guards/auth-match.guard.ts` (lines 30-40) — flat route-name allow-list only, zero groupId/profile dimension. Confirmed still true.
- `src/app/services/auth.service.ts`, `src/app/guards/utils.ts`, `src/app/models/main.model.ts` — see Risks for gpo_id findings.
- `src/app/services/private.service.ts` (lines ~145-150, 348-352, 431-436, 438-443, 578, 586) + consumers `escuelas.component.ts:460-484`, similarly in carreras-escuelas/solicitudes-por-programa/mostrar-expediente/reportes-de-pagos — established authenticated file-download pattern: `getHeaders()+responseType:'blob'` service call -> component does `URL.createObjectURL(blob)` + anchor `.download` + click + `URL.revokeObjectURL()`. Directly reusable for "Descargar plantilla" (a direct GET stream per spec §9.4).
- `src/app/models/main.model.ts:199-216` — `estatusDocumentos`/`document`/`actualizacionDocumento` interfaces model a document-status CATALOG (`id_cat_documento_estatus`, `descripcion`, `fa_icono`) used by the single-applicant `mostrar-expediente` review screen + `private.service.ts getEstatusDocuments()`. Not reusable as report-row models (different shape), but the status catalog/colors could be cross-referenced for consistent labeling. No existing `Folio` or dynamic-document-report row interface anywhere — new interfaces required.
- `package.json` — Angular Material `^18.2.14`. CDK table natively supports dynamic `matColumnDef` (`*ngFor`) and multiple header-row defs (framework capability confirmed, not version-blocked) — but zero examples exist in this codebase (grep across all 7 mat-table usages: all static compile-time `displayedColumns`), so this is genuinely new/first-of-its-kind code here, raising implementation + review risk.

### Approaches
1. **Mirror general-report structure (component+models+services, NgModule-declared) + native CDK dynamic matColumnDef/header rows** — Pros: consistent with newest precedent, reuses proven XLSX-parse + blob-download idioms. Cons: dynamic grouped header is unprecedented in this codebase (first implementation, more review scrutiny needed). Effort: Medium.
2. **Build a small reusable "dynamic grouped table" wrapper component** (generic, driven by a headers response) instead of a one-off — Pros: could be reused if more document-style reports appear later; cleaner separation. Cons: extra upfront design/abstraction cost for a single consumer today; premature generalization risk. Effort: Medium-High.
3. **For template download**: reuse the exact `getHeaders()+blob+createObjectURL` pattern already used 5+ times (escuelas/carreras-escuelas/solicitudes-por-programa/mostrar-expediente/reportes-de-pagos) wrapped in carga-de-pagos' SweetAlert2 confirm — Pros: zero new pattern, fully precedented, low risk. Cons: none meaningful. Effort: Low. (Recommended, no real alternative needed.)
4. **For Excel export `{ok,url}`**: (a) implement spec literally (client navigates to returned url) — Cons: zero precedent for `window.location.href`/`window.open` navigation-download anywhere in this repo (confirmed via grep, 0 matches); if url needs Bearer auth, browser navigation can't carry it — real risk. (b) push back on backend spec to instead return the file directly as a blob response (reusing pattern #3) — Pros: fully precedented, no auth-in-URL problem. Recommended to raise with backend/product before locking the contract.

### Recommendation
Approach 1 (mirror general-report's file layout) + reuse the precedented blob-download pattern for template download. For the dynamic grouped header, accept it as new-but-framework-supported work (CDK handles it natively in Material 18) rather than a workaround. Push the export `{ok,url}` auth question back to whoever owns the backend contract before implementation — do not guess an auth mechanism.

### Risks
- **gpo_id is NOT present anywhere in the decoded JWT or session state in this frontend.** Confirmed: `Login` interface (`main.model.ts:1-11`) — backend login response shape is only `{ok,message,usuario:{id,login,nombre,token}}`, no group field. `AuthService.setUserSession` (`auth.service.ts:65-68`) persists only `{usu_login,token,nombre}` to localStorage. All 4 JWT `atob()` decode sites in the repo (`guards/utils.ts:13`, `auth.service.ts:56,80`, `general-report.component.ts:178`) only ever read `exp` and `usu_id` — never `gpo_id`. Every other `gpo_id` reference in the codebase (`private.service.ts:647,656`, `usuarios.component.ts`, `edit-usuario-dialog.component.ts`) belongs to the admin "Usuarios" feature managing OTHER users' group assignments via a backend query — not the logged-in user's own session claim. This is a confirmed gap, not a guess: implementing groupId in [40,70,80] restriction requires either (a) backend adds `gpo_id` to the JWT payload so it can be decoded like `usu_id` is today, or (b) a new lookup call after login. `auth-match.guard.ts` also has no groupId dimension today and must be extended. Flag as a proposal-blocking open question.
- **Export `{ok,url}`-then-navigate flow has zero precedent** in this codebase (confirmed 0 matches for `window.location.href`/`window.open` across `src/app`). Every existing "export" flow does one authenticated call returning the file directly as a blob. If the backend's returned `url` needs the same Bearer header, a plain navigation can't carry it — must be resolved with the backend spec owner (signed URL, cookie auth, or switch to direct blob response) before/at sdd-propose.
- Dynamic 2-row grouped `mat-header-row` + runtime `matColumnDef` set is genuinely new code for this codebase (0 existing examples across 7 mat-table usages) — higher implementation/testing/review risk than a typical CRUD table, though not blocked by the Angular Material 18.2.14 version in use.
- No backend companion spec file found in this repo; API contract in frontend spec §9 is unverified against real backend code.

### Ready for Proposal
Yes, with two explicit open questions to carry into sdd-propose: (1) how the logged-in user's `gpo_id` will become available client-side for the [40,70,80] access check, and (2) the auth mechanism for the export `{ok,url}` navigation flow (or a request to change that endpoint to return the file directly). Everything else in the prior manual investigation was confirmed accurate against current code, with corrected/precise line numbers noted above.

observations.title: Proposal: Reporte de Documentos (report-documents)
observations.content:
# Proposal: Reporte de Documentos (report-documents)

## Intent

Admins auditing applicants' submitted documents have no screen in this Angular app — the capability only exists in the legacy CodeIgniter/jQuery system. Port it: filter by folio (typed or bulk XLSX) → server-paginated table with 6 fixed columns plus dynamic per-document-type `Estatus`/`Observación` pairs → export all matches to Excel. Success: an authorized admin audits document status for up to 5000 folios in one pass without touching the legacy system.

## Scope

### In Scope
- Route `reportDocuments` under `/home/private/`, nav entry, `auth-match.guard` allow-list entry.
- Filters card (collapsible, expanded by default, "select at least one filter" banner): folio free text (single or comma list), `.xls`/`.xlsx` dropzone parsed client-side (column B, skip template header rows, 5000-folio cap), **Filtrar**, **Descargar plantilla** (SweetAlert2 confirm → download).
- Results card: **Exportar Excel** hidden until first successful search; server-paginated `mat-table` with 2-row grouped header rebuilt only on filter change; horizontal scroll.
- `PrivateService` methods for columns / data / export / template; new row + header models.
- Business rule (spec §6): `Observación` renders empty when status is "Documento correcto".
- Manual folio text takes precedence over an uploaded file.

### Out of Scope
- Program dropdown, request-status dropdown, date-range picker, remove-filters button (legacy commented-out; spec §3.1 says do not port).
- Client-side Excel generation for export (legacy dead code, spec §7).
- Any server upload of the folios file — parsing stays client-side; no upload endpoint (spec §7).
- Column sorting; a generic reusable dynamic-table abstraction; backend implementation.

## Decisions

### D1 — Access control: no client-side group gate
`gpo_id` is absent from the login response, the `AuthService` session, and all four JWT decode sites. Spec §2 itself makes the server authoritative ("Implement equivalent server-side gate; do not rely on frontend-only hiding"), so a client-side `[40,70,80]` check would be decorative, not security, and would force a backend JWT/contract change we do not own.
**Decision:** route-name gating in `auth-match.guard.ts` exactly like the existing 9 routes; the backend enforces the group allow-list; the frontend satisfies "redirected to an error page" by routing to `/forbidden` on `403`. If `gpo_id` is later added to the JWT, the guard tightens without redesign.

### D2 — Export: `{ok,url}` with a public/signed URL — plain navigation, confirmed final
Backend contract is fixed (confirmed by user 2026-08-31): `POST /report-documents/export` always returns `{ok,url}` and cannot be changed to stream a blob directly. Initial concern was that this app manually attaches `Bearer` via `getHeaders()` everywhere (interceptor is a stub) and a plain browser navigation can't carry a custom header — user confirmed the returned `url` is **public/signed** (carries its own access, e.g. embedded/expiring token), not a Bearer-protected endpoint.
**Decision:** `POST /report-documents/export` with `getHeaders()` (auth on the export call itself) → receive `{ok,url}` → `window.location.href = url` (or open in new tab) to trigger the browser download directly. No blob-fetch workaround needed. This is the first navigation-download in this codebase (0 prior precedent) but is safe given the URL requires no additional auth.
**Template download** (`GET /report-documents/template`, spec §5.6) — same reasoning applies if it also returns/serves a public-access download; confirm this specifically before implementation (not yet explicitly confirmed — the `{ok,url}` confirmation was scoped to the export flow). If the template endpoint instead requires Bearer auth (unlike export), fall back to the repo's established `getHeaders()+responseType:'blob'`→`createObjectURL` pattern (reused from `carga-de-pagos.component.ts` confirm-dialog + 5+ existing blob-download examples in `private.service.ts` consumers) for that one flow only.

## Capabilities

### New
- `report-documents`: folio-filtered document-status report with dynamic grouped columns, XLSX bulk filter input, server-side export, template download.

### Modified
- None.

## Approach

Mirror `src/app/private/general-report/` (component + models + services, NgModule-declared). Reuse its dropzone/XLSX-parse idiom (`processFile()`, `general-report.component.ts:224-247`) for bulk folio extraction — extracted folios sent to the backend as a list filter (`{field:'folio', value:[folios,'in']}`) in the same JSON payload contract as the manual-text filter, never as a file upload. Dynamic grouped header via native CDK `*ngFor` `matColumnDef` + two `matHeaderRowDef` rows — framework-supported in Material 18.2.14 but first-of-its-kind here. Headers fetched on filter change only; page turns hit the data endpoint alone. Export uses `window.location.href = url` per D2 (revised).

## Affected Areas

| Area | Impact | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `src/app/private/report-documents/` | New | component, models, service wiring |
| `src/app/private/private-routing.module.ts` | Modified | route entry |
| `src/app/private/private.module.ts` | Modified | declaration |
| `src/app/guards/auth-match.guard.ts` | Modified | allow-list string |
| `src/app/shared/full-layout/full-layout.component.html` | Modified | nav link |
| `src/app/services/private.service.ts` | Modified | 4 endpoints |
| `src/app/models/main.model.ts` | Modified | new interfaces |

## Risks

| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| Backend never gates by group, leaving the screen open (D1) | Med | State the server-side requirement explicitly in the spec phase; treat as a delivery dependency |
| Dynamic 2-row header is unprecedented here | Med | Isolate header-building in a pure function; cover with unit tests |
| API contract §9 unverified against real backend | High | Confirm shapes before apply; keep models in one file for cheap correction |
| Template-download URL auth mode not yet confirmed (public/signed vs Bearer) | Med | Confirm before apply; two ready-made implementation paths depending on the answer |
| Wide dynamic tables degrade on small screens | Low | Horizontal scroll + sticky fixed columns |

## Rollback

Revert the feature commit. Shared-file edits are additive only (one route, one declaration, one allow-list string, one nav link, appended service methods and interfaces); removing them restores current behavior. No data migration, no schema change.

## Dependencies

- Backend endpoints §9.1–§9.4 implemented and reachable.
- Export `url` confirmed public/signed (resolved 2026-08-31 — no further action needed).
- Template-download URL auth mode (public/signed vs Bearer) — needs confirmation before apply.
- Backend enforcement of the `[40,70,80]` group gate (D1).
- Static folios template file available from `GET /report-documents/template`.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Authorized admin filters by typed folio list and sees correct fixed + dynamic columns.
- [ ] XLSX upload extracts folios from column B, skips the header row, rejects >5000 and wrong extensions.
- [ ] Header rebuilds on filter change; page turns do not refetch headers.
- [ ] Export returns all matching rows and downloads via direct navigation to the returned url.
- [ ] "Descargar plantilla" confirms, then downloads the template (mechanism per its own auth-mode confirmation).
- [ ] `Observación` empty when status is "Documento correcto".
- [ ] Unauthorized user reaching the route lands on `/forbidden`.

## Proposal question round

1. **Removing the uploaded file** (spec §5.4 leaves this a UX call): assumed it clears the folio text and **empties the results** rather than re-running an unfiltered search. Still needs confirmation.
2. **D1 acceptance**: is relying purely on backend group enforcement acceptable to the product owner, or is adding `gpo_id` to the JWT already on the backend roadmap? Still open.
3. **D2 ownership** — RESOLVED 2026-08-31: `{ok,url}` contract is fixed, backend cannot change it. URL confirmed public/signed. Plain navigation approach locked in.
4. **Empty result state**: what should the results card show when a filter matches zero folios — an empty table with headers, or a "no results" message with no columns? Still open.
5. **Status filter** (spec §7 calls it "recommended"): confirmed excluded from this first slice? Still open (assumed yes, no pushback yet).

observations.title: sdd/recrear-endpoints-report-documents/explore
observations.content:
## Exploration: Recreate "Reporte de Documentos" backend endpoints (Express/Sequelize/MSSQL)

### Current State

`report-documents-backend-spec.md` exists at repo root, content verified line-by-line against the description: 4 endpoints (`POST /report-documents/columns`, `POST /report-documents/data`, `POST /report-documents/export`, `GET /report-documents/template`), a shared `Filter[]` contract (`field`/`value`/operator: `=`/`in`/`like`/`between`), a hardcoded document-type display-order map with a `display_order` column recommendation, a known legacy row-leak bug NOT to port, an access-control requirement (`gpo_id` allow-list `[40,70,80]`), and explicitly-excluded supporting endpoints.

**Closest analog** — `src/routes/reporteGeneralRoutes.js` + `src/controllers/reporteGeneralController.js` — verified accurate:
- `searchGeneralReport` = DataTables-style pagination: `draw/start/length` + `COUNT(*) OVER()` window function + `OFFSET :start ROWS FETCH NEXT :length ROWS ONLY`. Response is bare `{draw, recordsTotal, recordsFiltered, data}`, no `ok` wrapper.
- `buildCustomDataWhere(customData)` expands `IN` arrays manually into numbered placeholders (`:key_0`, `:key_1`...) because Sequelize replacements don't support array `IN` in raw queries.
- **Found but not previously flagged — 3 real problems in this exact helper that must NOT be copied verbatim into the new code:**
  1. **SQL injection gap**: `field` is interpolated directly into the WHERE clause (`` `${field}${op} :${key}` ``) with zero validation against an allow-list. The report-documents spec explicitly calls this out as a risk to close with a field allow-list — the existing analog does NOT have that guard, so it cannot be reused as-is.
  2. **Broken catch block**: `catch (err) { console.error('buildCustomDataWhere:', error.message); return res.status(500)... }` references an undefined `error` and an out-of-scope `res` (this is a plain helper, not an Express handler) — if it ever throws, it throws a `ReferenceError` instead of failing cleanly.
  3. **Missing operators**: only `=`(implicit) and `in` are handled. `like` and `between` (both required by the spec's filter contract) are NOT implemented — `between` with a 2-element array value would bind an array to a single placeholder and fail against MSSQL/tedious.
- No Sequelize model file exists for `reporteGeneralController.js` at all — it's 100% raw `sequelize.query()`, confirming fact 3.

**Excel export precedents** (both stream directly to the HTTP response, no disk save, no returned URL — verified):
- `src/controllers/reportValidationController.js` → `getReportValidation` (lines 311-357): `ExcelJS.Workbook()`, `workbook.xlsx.write(res); res.end()`.
- `src/controllers/reportePagosController.js` → `downloadReportePagos` (lines 103-199): same streaming pattern, plus logo image embed and cell styling. **Note**: this route file (`reportePagosRoutes.js`) applies **no `verifyToken` middleware at all** on either route — an existing gap in a sibling file, not a pattern to imitate.

This directly **conflicts with spec §3.3**, which asks for save-to-disk + `{ok:true, url}`. Given a 2-for-2 established project convention, and the spec itself flags this as an area open to redesign ("legitimate improvement... if your stack supports it easily"), streaming is the recommended deviation.

**Auth** — `src/middlewares/authMiddlware.js` (typo confirmed, no "d") only verifies the JWT and does `req.user = decoded` (the whole payload, not a manual pick). Token payload confirmed via `src/controllers/authController.js:generateToken` (line 91): `jwt.sign({ usu_id, usu_login, gpo_id }, JWT_SECRET, { expiresIn: '2h' })` — matches fact 5 exactly. Grepped every `gpo_id` usage project-wide (authModel.js, authController.js, reporteGeneralController.js, userController.js, userRoutes.js) — all uses are either JWT embedding, model field defs, business-data filtering (fetch users of group 80), or CRUD validation that a group id exists in `sis_grupo`/`Grupo`. **None gate a request based on the caller's own `req.user.gpo_id`.** Confirmed: no role/group authorization middleware exists anywhere — must be written from scratch.

**Route registration / Swagger** — `src/index.js` lines 44-54 confirmed. Two mounting styles coexist: most routers (`reportValidationRoutes`, `reportePagosRoutes`, `pagosRoutes`, `usersRoutes`, `solicitudesRoutes`) are mounted at a shared/dedicated prefix and define their **full sub-path** inside the router file (e.g. `reportePagosRoutes.js` defines `/reporte-pagos` while mounted at `app.use('/api', reportePagosRoutes)` → final path `/api/reporte-pagos`); only `reporteGeneralRoutes.js` uses the newer "own dedicated prefix + root-relative routes" style (`app.use('/api/generalReport', reporteGeneralRoutes)`). Since the spec's paths already read `/report-documents/columns` etc. verbatim, the **shared-`/api`-mount + full-sub-path** style (matching `reportValidationRoutes`/`reportePagosRoutes`, the majority pattern) satisfies the spec literally without inventing a prefix. `src/config/swagger.js`'s `endpointsFiles` array (lines 23-34) confirmed; a new route file must be appended there, using inline `/* #swagger.xxx = ... */` comments (not JSDoc), per project convention.

`package.json` confirmed: `exceljs: ^4.4.0` present in `dependencies` (also `xlsx: ^0.18.5`, used elsewhere for a different, client-side-SheetJS-shaped export — `searchRequestsForExcel` returns bare JSON, not a server-built workbook). ExcelJS is the library to reuse for the report-documents export endpoint, matching both existing streamed-export precedents.

**Naming convention** — no single convention exists project-wide: `reportValidationRoutes.js`/`Controller.js` use English "report", while `reportePagosRoutes.js`/`reporteGeneralRoutes.js` use Spanish "reporte". Since the spec's own endpoint paths are English (`report-documents`), and the closest same-domain sibling (`reportValidationRoutes.js`, also documents-related) uses English, recommend **`reportDocumentsRoutes.js`/`reportDocumentsController.js`** (English, camelCase) over a Spanish `reporteDocumentos*` name.

**Models** — `src/models/filesModel.js` confirmed exact 4 exports (`EducafinSolicitudesDocumentos`, `CatTipoDocumento`, `CatDocumentoEstatus`, `HistorialSolicitudesDocumentos`) — related domain, no `vw_report_documents` model. `CatTipoDocumento`'s current Sequelize definition has **no `display_order`-equivalent column** (`descripcion`, `id_categoria_documento`, `fcaptura`, `cat_tipo_documento_estatus` only) — the spec's recommended data-driven ordering column does not exist in the DB today. `src/models/reportValidationModel.js` confirmed as the correct precedent for defining a Sequelize model over a SQL view (`VwReporteValidacionSolicitantes`, `schema: 'dbo'`, `freezeTableName: true`, `timestamps: false`) — useful IF a model is created for `vw_report_documents`, but given fact 3's raw-query analog has zero models, a model-free approach is recommended instead (see Approaches).

No cross-schema (`schema.table`) raw SQL usage exists anywhere in this codebase today (grepped `educafin.` — zero hits); the target view lives in schema `educafin` per the user's stated fact, so this will be the **first** query in the codebase needing an explicit schema-qualified table reference (`educafin.vw_report_documents` in raw SQL, or Sequelize's `schema: 'educafin'` option if a model is used).

`public/` directory is served statically (`app.use(express.static('public'))` in index.js) and currently only contains `public/assets/logo.png` — no `plantilla_folios.xlsx` template file exists yet anywhere in the repo; it must be sourced/added. `res.sendFile` precedent exists in `reportValidationController.js`'s `viewDocument` (line 134, downloads from SFTP to a temp path then sends it) as the pattern for a controlled-header file-download response.

### Affected Areas
- `src/routes/reportDocumentsRoutes.js` (new) — 4 routes, mounted via shared `/api`, mirrors `reportValidationRoutes.js` style.
- `src/controllers/reportDocumentsController.js` (new) — raw `sequelize.query()` against `educafin.vw_report_documents`, no model, mirrors `reporteGeneralController.js`.
- `src/middlewares/` (new file, e.g. `requireGroups.js`) — first-ever group/role-gate middleware in this codebase; applied after `verifyToken` on all 4 routes.
- `src/index.js` — add `app.use('/api', reportDocumentsRoutes)`.
- `src/config/swagger.js` — append new route file to `endpointsFiles`.
- `public/templates/plantilla_folios.xlsx` (new static asset, does not exist yet) — served for `GET /report-documents/template`.
- `src/models/filesModel.js`, `src/models/reportValidationModel.js` — read as precedent only, not modified (no `vw_report_documents` model recommended, but `reportValidationModel.js`'s `schema:` option is the reference if a model is later wanted).

### Approaches

1. **Raw-query, no-model (mirrors `reporteGeneralController.js`)** — write plain `sequelize.query()` calls against `educafin.vw_report_documents`, with a hand-rolled (but corrected) filter-builder supporting all 4 operators plus a field allow-list.
   - Pros: matches fact 3's exact precedent; simplest given the view's columns are already fully enumerated in the spec (10 columns, no CRUD needed); avoids fighting Sequelize ORM for window functions (`COUNT(*) OVER()`) and per-folio pivoting into `doc_<id>` objects, which have no clean ORM equivalent anyway.
   - Cons: filter-builder, allow-list, and SQL-injection guard must be written fresh (existing helper has 3 bugs, see Current State) rather than reused wholesale.
   - Effort: Medium.

2. **Model-backed via `sequelize.define` on the view (mirrors `reportValidationModel.js`)** — define a `VwReportDocuments` model, use Sequelize `where`/`Op.in`/`Op.between`/`Op.like` for filtering.
   - Pros: gets `Op.in` "for free" (no manual array-placeholder expansion); model attribute keys double as an implicit field allow-list.
   - Cons: the pagination/grouping logic (distinct-folio count via window function, then group-by-folio into nested `doc_<id>` objects) still doesn't map to ORM query builders — would still need raw SQL for the actual data-fetch, making the model mostly decorative; doesn't match the closest analog (fact 3); adds a model file for a report screen where none exists in the sibling precedent.
   - Effort: Medium-High (same core work as Approach 1 plus a model file that mostly goes unused for the hard part).

### Recommendation

**Approach 1** (raw-query, no-model), because it matches the one directly-comparable existing precedent (`reporteGeneralController.js`) exactly, and because the report's actual hard logic (window-function counts, per-folio grouping into dynamic `doc_<id>` columns) requires raw SQL regardless of whether a model exists — a model would add a file without removing any of the real complexity.

Within that approach: write a **new**, corrected filter-builder (allow-listed fields, all 4 operators, proper try/catch) rather than reusing `buildCustomDataWhere` verbatim; stream the export with ExcelJS directly to the response (deviating intentionally from spec §3.3's save+URL design, matching the 2 existing export precedents); add the first-ever group-gate middleware; and decide (as a `sdd-propose`-level decision, not resolved here) whether to port the legacy hardcoded document-order map into JS for v1 or request a DB `display_order` column addition out-of-band (this project has no migrations — "tables must exist in the DB").

### Risks

- `buildCustomDataWhere`'s raw field-interpolation is a live SQL-injection pattern in existing code — must NOT be copied unguarded; spec explicitly demands a field allow-list for report-documents.
- Same helper's catch block references undefined `error`/`res` — a latent crash-on-error bug, must not be replicated.
- Same helper doesn't implement `like`/`between` at all, despite the spec's filter contract requiring exactly those operators — needs new code, not reuse.
- No group/role-gating middleware exists anywhere in this codebase; spec §4's access control is 100% new code.
- Spec's export design (disk + URL) conflicts with this project's established streaming convention (2/2 existing precedents) — needs an explicit decision in `sdd-propose`, not just an assumption.
- Spec's recommended `display_order` column doesn't exist on `cat_tipo_documento` today; adding it conflicts with the project's no-migrations convention (DB changes happen out-of-band) — needs a decision (port hardcoded map vs. request DB change).
- `plantilla_folios.xlsx` referenced by spec §3.4 doesn't exist anywhere in this repo yet and must be sourced before the template endpoint can work.
- `educafin.vw_report_documents` is the first cross-schema raw-SQL reference in this codebase — must confirm the DB connection's default schema and use an explicit schema prefix to avoid "invalid object name" errors.
- `reportePagosRoutes.js` (a sibling report route file) has no `verifyToken` at all — a reminder that not every existing file is a safe pattern to imitate; report-documents routes must apply both `verifyToken` and the new group-gate on every route, per spec §4's explicit requirement.
- CodeGraph note: `.codegraph/` does not exist in this repo and no CodeGraph CLI/MCP tool was available in this execution context, so this exploration used direct Read/Grep/Glob instead (documented per fallback policy, not a data-quality risk to the findings above, which were all verified against live file contents).

### Ready for Proposal
Yes — enough is verified (spec content, closest analog with 3 newly-found bugs to avoid, both export precedents, auth gap, route/swagger conventions, naming, models, static-file serving, dependencies) to proceed to `sdd-propose`. Open decisions to surface to the user during propose: (1) stream-to-response vs. disk+URL for export, (2) hardcoded order map vs. DB `display_order` column, (3) confirm `educafin` schema prefix and default-schema behavior with the actual DB before writing queries.

observations.title: sdd/recrear-endpoints-report-documents/proposal
observations.content:
# Proposal: Recreate "Reporte de Documentos" Backend Endpoints

## Intent
The document-review report lives only in the legacy CodeIgniter app. A new frontend is being built against the wire contract in `report-documents-backend-spec.md`, but this backend has no equivalent. Reviewers (groups 40/70/80) need per-folio document-status visibility, filtering, and Excel export. Success: the new frontend runs unmodified against this backend, and the legacy's folio-misattribution bug (§3.2) and unguarded field interpolation are NOT carried over.

## Scope
### In Scope
- `POST /report-documents/columns`, `POST /report-documents/data`, `GET /report-documents/template` — exact spec JSON contracts preserved.
- `POST /report-documents/export` — **deliberate deviation from spec §3.3**: streams the ExcelJS workbook to the response (project convention: `reportValidationController`, `reportePagosController`), not disk + `{ok,url}`.
- New filter-builder: field allow-list validated against real view columns, operators `=`/`""`/`in`/`like`/`between`, `in` chunked at 500 into OR'd batches.
- New `requireGroups([40,70,80])` middleware on `req.user.gpo_id`, applied with `verifyToken` to all 4 routes.
- Correct grouping: fixed fields read from the folio's grouped item.

### Out of Scope
- Sequelize model for the view; DB view/migration (`educafin.vw_report_documents` exists).
- `display_order` column on `cat_tipo_documento` (data-driven ordering deferred).
- Async/background export job; excluded supporting endpoints (spec §5).
- Refactoring `buildCustomDataWhere`'s existing bugs.

## Capabilities
### New
- `report-documents`: filtered, paginated, per-folio document-status reporting + Excel export + template download.
- `group-authorization`: reusable `gpo_id` allow-list request gate.
### Modified
- None.

## Approach
Raw `sequelize.query()` against `educafin.vw_report_documents` (mirrors `reporteGeneralController.js`): `COUNT(*) OVER()` for distinct-folio counts, `OFFSET/FETCH NEXT` paging, then in-JS grouping into `doc_<id>` objects. Document order ported as a JS constant map (like `PROGRAM_IDS_DEFAULT`). Routes mounted at shared `/api`; swagger via inline `#swagger` comments.

## Affected Areas
| Area | Impact | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `src/routes/reportDocumentsRoutes.js` | New | 4 routes + swagger comments |
| `src/controllers/reportDocumentsController.js` | New | Queries, filter-builder, grouping, export |
| `src/middlewares/requireGroups.js` | New | Group gate |
| `src/index.js` | Modified | Mount router |
| `src/config/swagger.js` | Modified | Append to `endpointsFiles` |
| `public/templates/plantilla_folios.xlsx` | New asset | **Missing — must be supplied** |

## Risks
| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| Real view columns differ from spec's 10 (e.g. `estatus_solicitud_id`) | High | `SELECT TOP 1 *` sanity check as first task; build allow-list from actuals |
| First `educafin.`-schema raw SQL in repo | Med | Verify resolution against live DB before writing queries |
| Missing template file blocks `/template` | High | Source from legacy; ship other 3 endpoints independently |
| Hardcoded order map drifts from DB | Med | Isolated constant; documented as future `display_order` work |
| Large export memory/timeout | Med | Chunk folios at 500 while streaming |

## Rollback
Additive-only. Revert the commit, or remove the `app.use` line in `src/index.js` and the `endpointsFiles` entry.

## Dependencies
- `educafin.vw_report_documents` reachable by the app DB user.
- `plantilla_folios.xlsx` from the legacy system (blocking for `/template` only).

## Success Criteria
- [ ] All 4 endpoints reject requests without a valid token or with `gpo_id` outside `[40,70,80]`.
- [ ] `/columns` and `/data` responses match spec shapes byte-for-byte in key naming.
- [ ] Fixed fields come from the grouped folio (§3.2 bug not reproduced).
- [ ] `estatus === "Documento correcto"` forces `observacion` null in both `/data` and export.
- [ ] Non-allow-listed `field` values are rejected, never interpolated.
- [ ] Export downloads a styled workbook with merged per-document headers.

## Proposal question round (blocked — needs user review)
1. `recordsTotal` vs `recordsFiltered`: keep legacy parity (both = filtered count) or fix now?
2. Are group ids `[40,70,80]` still the correct allow-list in this system, or should they be env-configurable?
3. Is there an expected max result size for export (affects whether sync streaming is acceptable long-term)?

observations.title: sdd/recrear-endpoints-report-documents/spec
observations.content:
# Report Documents Backend — Spec

## Domain: report-documents (new capability)

Purpose: filtered, paginated, per-folio document-review reporting with dynamic columns, Excel export, and template download.

### Requirement: Dynamic Document Columns
`POST /report-documents/columns` MUST return `{documents: [{id, orden, descripcion}]}` for document types present in the filtered dataset, ordered by the fixed map `164→1,165→2,166→3,4→4,5→5,10→6,2→7,222→8,76→9,50→10,30→11,77→12,78→13,79→14`; unmapped ids sort last (order 999).

#### Scenario: Ordered mixed columns
- GIVEN filters match document types 164, 2, and 999 (unmapped)
- WHEN `/columns` is called
- THEN items are ordered 164, then 2, then 999

#### Scenario: No matches
- GIVEN filters match zero rows
- WHEN `/columns` is called
- THEN response is `{documents: []}`, HTTP 200

### Requirement: Paginated Folio Data
`POST /report-documents/data` MUST return paginated folio rows where `recordsTotal` and `recordsFiltered` both equal the count of distinct folios matching filters+search (confirmed legacy parity — no separate unfiltered total).

#### Scenario: Counts match (parity decision)
- GIVEN 842 distinct folios match filters+search
- WHEN `/data` is called with any `draw/start/length`
- THEN `recordsTotal === recordsFiltered === 842`

#### Scenario: Missing doc type filled NA
- GIVEN a folio has no row for document type 2
- WHEN it appears in a page
- THEN `doc_2 = {estatus: "NA", observacion: null}`

#### Scenario: Correct status nulls observation
- GIVEN a folio's document row has `estatus: "Documento correcto"` and a stored observation
- WHEN it appears in a page
- THEN `observacion` is `null` regardless of stored value

#### Scenario: Fields attributed to correct folio (regression — legacy bug NOT ported)
- GIVEN a page with multiple folios, each with multiple document rows, in arbitrary DB row order
- WHEN `/data` returns rows
- THEN each row's `convocatoria`, `estatus_solicitud`, `estatus_docs` belong to that row's own grouped folio, never leaked from the last document row scanned across a different folio

#### Scenario: Empty page keeps counts
- GIVEN a pagination window past the last folio
- WHEN `/data` is called
- THEN `data: []` while counts still reflect the full distinct-folio total

### Requirement: Full Excel Export
`POST /report-documents/export` MUST stream all matching folios (unpaginated) as an `.xlsx` attachment directly in the HTTP response, using the same grouping/flattening rules as `/data`. (Deviation from literal legacy spec text — no disk save, no `{ok,url}` JSON, matching existing project export precedents.)

#### Scenario: Streamed, not saved
- GIVEN filters match more folios than one `/data` page
- WHEN `/export` is called
- THEN response is a binary `.xlsx` stream with attachment headers — not JSON, not `{ok, url}`

#### Scenario: Flattening rules apply
- GIVEN a folio missing a document type or marked "Documento correcto"
- WHEN it appears in the export
- THEN the same NA-fill and null-observation rules from `/data` apply, one cell per column (no nested objects)

### Requirement: Template Download
`GET /report-documents/template` MUST serve the static `plantilla_folios.xlsx` file, no filters/body required.

#### Scenario: Template served
- GIVEN the template file exists at its configured path
- WHEN `GET /report-documents/template` is called
- THEN the file streams with download-appropriate headers

### Requirement: Filter Contract & Validation
All 3 filterable endpoints MUST accept filters as `[{field, value:[val, operator]}]` with operators `=`/`""` (equals), `in`, `like`, `between`; MUST validate `field` against an allow-list of real `educafin.vw_report_documents` columns and MUST reject non-allow-listed fields with HTTP 400 instead of executing them. `in` arrays over 500 items MUST be chunked into OR'd batches. `search` MUST OR-match substrings of `cuestionario_id`, `persona_curp`, `programa_nombre`.

#### Scenario: Operators applied correctly
- GIVEN filters using `in`, `like`, and `between`
- WHEN applied
- THEN `in` matches list membership, `like` matches substring, `between` matches an inclusive 2-value range

#### Scenario: Invalid field rejected
- GIVEN a filter with `field: "unlisted_column"`
- WHEN any filterable endpoint is called
- THEN response is HTTP 400 and no query executes against that field

#### Scenario: Large IN chunked
- GIVEN an `in` filter with 1200 values
- WHEN the query builds
- THEN values are batched into OR'd groups of ≤500

#### Scenario: Global search
- GIVEN a `search` value substring-matching `persona_curp` on some folios
- WHEN `/data` is called with that search and no other filters
- THEN only matching folios are included

## Domain: group-authorization (new capability)

Purpose: gate all report-documents endpoints to authenticated users in an allowed group.

### Requirement: Group-Based Access Control
All 4 report-documents endpoints MUST require a valid JWT (existing `verifyToken`) and MUST reject authenticated requests whose `gpo_id` is not in `[40, 70, 80]`.

#### Scenario: No/invalid token
- GIVEN a request with no Authorization header or an invalid/expired JWT
- WHEN any report-documents endpoint is called
- THEN response is HTTP 401

#### Scenario: Wrong group
- GIVEN a valid JWT with `gpo_id` not in `[40, 70, 80]`
- WHEN any report-documents endpoint is called
- THEN response is HTTP 403

#### Scenario: Allowed group
- GIVEN a valid JWT with `gpo_id` in `[40, 70, 80]`
- WHEN any report-documents endpoint is called
- THEN the request reaches controller logic

observations.title: sdd/recrear-endpoints-report-documents/design
observations.content:
# Design: Recreate "Reporte de Documentos" Backend Endpoints

> **Revision note (corrective re-run)**: only the source-view identifier handling changed. The prior open-ended "verify `educafin` is a schema or a database before writing queries" note is replaced by the ordered blocking procedure in **Source View Resolution** below. All other decisions were reviewed and carried forward unchanged.

## Technical Approach

Route → Controller, no service layer, no Sequelize model — a literal clone of `reporteGeneralController.js`'s shape (zero model imports, `sequelize.query` + `QueryTypes.SELECT` + named `replacements`). One new router mounted at `/api/report-documents`, one controller holding 4 handlers plus 3 pure helpers, one new middleware. Read source is the pre-existing `educafin.vw_report_documents` view (one row per folio×document-type), whose exact resolvable identifier must be confirmed by Task 0 before any query is written.

## Architecture Decisions

| # | Decision | Alternatives rejected | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Router mounted `app.use('/api/report-documents', reportDocumentsRoutes)`, internal paths `/columns` `/data` `/export` `/template` | Mount at bare `/api` with full paths in the router (as `reportValidationRoutes` does) | `index.js` mixes both, but every *cohesive feature* router added recently uses a dedicated prefix (`/api/pagos-isseg`, `/api/users`, `/api/solicitudes`, `/api/generalReport`). Bare `/api` mounts are legacy grab-bags. A dedicated prefix also enables decision 2. |
| 2 | `router.use(verifyToken, requireGroups(ALLOWED_GROUPS))` once at router scope | Repeat both middlewares on each of the 4 routes (existing per-route convention) | Spec §4 requires *every* endpoint gated. Router-scope is fail-closed: a future 5th route cannot be added unguarded. Deviation from convention is deliberate and documented in-file. |
| 3 | New `buildDocumentWhere(filters, allowList)` written from scratch | Reuse/extend `buildCustomDataWhere` | That function interpolates `field` unvalidated into SQL, has a `catch` referencing an undefined `error` and an out-of-scope `res`, and lacks `like`/`between`. Refactoring it is out of scope (proposal). |
| 4 | `/data` uses **two** queries: `COUNT(DISTINCT …)` then the folio page | Single query with `COUNT(*) OVER()` (the `searchGeneralReport` pattern) | That pattern reads the count off row 0 and yields `0` when the requested page is past the end (`rows.length ? … : 0`). Two queries (the `reportePagosController` pattern) are correct on out-of-range pages. |
| 5 | `/export` streams `workbook.xlsx.write(res)`; DB reads chunked 500 folios at a time | Save to disk + return `{ok,url}` (spec §3.3); `ExcelJS.stream.xlsx.WorkbookWriter` | Streaming matches `downloadReportePagos` and `reportValidationController`. Chunking bounds *query* memory; whole-workbook memory is the accepted ceiling. `WorkbookWriter` is the documented upgrade path if exports exceed ~50k rows. |
| 6 | Template asset at `src/assets/plantilla_folios.xlsx`, served via `res.download()` | `public/templates/plantilla_folios.xlsx` | `index.js` runs `express.static('public')` — anything under `public/` is reachable **without a token**, defeating decision 2. `src/assets/` is already used for private assets (`Logo_juventudes_azul.png`). |
| 7 | `DOC_ORDER` hardcoded module-level constant | `display_order` column on `cat_tipo_documento` (spec's recommendation) | Project has no migrations convention (CLAUDE.md: "no migrations — tables must exist"). Isolated as one constant; data-driven ordering deferred. |
| 8 | `recordsTotal === recordsFiltered` | Separate unfiltered total | Legacy parity, confirmed with the user. |
| 9 | Source identifier written **once** as a module-level `const VIEW = '<resolved identifier>';`, interpolated into the three raw SQL strings | Repeating the literal string in each query (prior design's implicit shape) | Added by this correction. Task 0 can change the identifier from 2-part to 3-part; a single constant makes that a one-line edit instead of a multi-site find/replace, and keeps the resolved-vs-assumed name auditable in one place. |

## Source View Resolution (Task 0 — BLOCKING, FIRST implementation task)

**Provenance of the name.** `educafin.vw_report_documents` was supplied **directly by the project owner** (who administers this database) in answer to an explicit request for the exact view name. It was not inferred, guessed, or synthesized by any SDD phase.

**Why nothing in the repo references it.** A grep for `educafin` finds it only as a substring of unrelated identifiers (`educafin_solicitudes_documentos` table, `escuelas_conv_educafin` column) — never as a dot-qualifier — while every schema-qualified reference in this repo uses `dbo.` (e.g. `reportValidationController.js`, `schema: "dbo"` in model options). **This is the expected state, not a red flag**: this is a brand-new feature, and no controller queries this view today because these endpoints do not exist yet. Codebase absence is neither confirmation nor refutation of the identifier. It is resolvable only against the live database.

**Sequelize context.** `src/config/database.js` constructs ONE `Sequelize` instance bound to `process.env.DB_NAME`. Raw SQL is passed through verbatim, so a 2-part `schema.object` name needs no `schema` option, model, or config change — but a 2-part name only resolves *inside the connected database*.

Execute in order. Stop at the first step that succeeds. Write no production query and do not finalize `ALLOWED_FILTER_FIELDS` until this resolves.

| Step | Run | If it succeeds | If it fails |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1** | `SELECT TOP 1 * FROM educafin.vw_report_documents` | `educafin` is a schema in the connected DB. Use the 2-part name verbatim. Capture the returned column list → step 4. | Invalid-object-name error (MSSQL `Msg 208`) → step 2. |
| **2** | `SELECT s.name AS schema_name, v.name AS view_name FROM sys.views v JOIN sys.schemas s ON v.schema_id = s.schema_id WHERE v.name = 'vw_report_documents'` — or `SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VIEWS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'vw_report_documents'` | Row(s) returned: the view lives under a different schema in this DB. Use `{returned_schema}.vw_report_documents`, report the discrepancy to the project owner, → step 4. | Zero rows → step 3. |
| **3** | `SELECT name FROM sys.databases WHERE name = 'educafin'` | `educafin` is a separate **database**, not a schema. The correct reference is 3-part: `educafin.{schema}.vw_report_documents` — resolve `{schema}` by repeating step 2 against `educafin.sys.views` / `educafin.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VIEWS`; **do not assume `dbo`**. **STOP and confirm with the project owner**: this is not merely a longer string — the app login needs cross-database rights on this same connection, otherwise the feature requires a second Sequelize instance or a linked-server setup, which is a scope change. | Zero rows → **BLOCKED**. The object is not reachable from this connection under any form. Report steps 1-3 outputs to the project owner; do not guess alternative names or schemas. |
| **4** | `SELECT TOP 1 *` against the **resolved** identifier | Build `ALLOWED_FILTER_FIELDS` as a `Set` of the ACTUAL returned columns. Reconcile spec §2's `estatus_solicitud_id` (absent from spec §1's column list): drop it from examples if it is not a real column, include it if it is. | — |

## Data Flow

```
POST /data
  ├─ buildDocumentWhere(filters, ALLOWED_FILTER_FIELDS) ──┐  (throws → 400)
  ├─ + search OR-group (cuestionario_id|persona_curp|programa_nombre)
  │                                                        │
  ├─ Q1 COUNT(DISTINCT cuestionario_id) ───────────────────┤ WHERE
  ├─ Q2 folio page (DISTINCT, ORDER BY id, OFFSET/FETCH) ──┘
  │        └─ empty? → early return {draw, counts, data: []}
  ├─ Q3 all doc rows WHERE cuestionario_id IN (page ids)   (no filter re-apply)
  ├─ resolveDocumentColumns(filters, search)               (Q4, parallel w/ Q1-Q2)
  └─ groupByFolio(rows, folioIds, columns) → data[]
```

## File Changes

| File | Action | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `src/routes/reportDocumentsRoutes.js` | Create | 4 routes, router-level gate, inline `/* #swagger.tags = ['Reporte Documentos'] … */` comments (swagger-autogen style, **not** JSDoc `@swagger`) |
| `src/controllers/reportDocumentsController.js` | Create | 4 handlers + `buildDocumentWhere`, `resolveDocumentColumns`, `groupFoliosToRows`; `VIEW`, `DOC_ORDER`, `ALLOWED_FILTER_FIELDS`, `SEARCH_COLS` constants |
| `src/middlewares/requireGroups.js` | Create | Factory, single default export |
| `src/index.js` | Modify | `require` + `app.use('/api/report-documents', …)` after line 54 |
| `src/config/swagger.js` | Modify | Append `'./src/routes/reportDocumentsRoutes.js'` to `endpointsFiles`; run `npm run swagger` |
| `src/assets/plantilla_folios.xlsx` | Create (asset) | **MISSING — blocking for `/template` only** |

## Interfaces / Contracts

```js
// requireGroups.js — mirrors authMiddlware.js's single-export shape
const requireGroups = (allowedGroupIds) => {
  const allowed = new Set(allowedGroupIds.map(Number));
  return (req, res, next) => {
    const gpoId = Number(req.user?.gpo_id);
    if (!req.user || Number.isNaN(gpoId) || !allowed.has(gpoId)) {
      return res.status(403).json({ ok: false, message: 'No tiene permisos para acceder a este recurso' });
    }
    next();
  };
};
module.exports = requireGroups;
// Ordering is load-bearing: verifyToken MUST run before this (it sets req.user).
```

**`buildDocumentWhere(filters, allowList) → { whereClause, replacements }`** — pure, synchronous, no `res`/`next`. Throws `FilterFieldError` (custom `Error` subclass with `.field`) when `!allowList.has(field)`; every handler's `catch` maps it to `400 {ok:false, message}` and everything else to `500 {ok:false, message:'Error interno del servidor'}`.

| Operator (`value[1]`, lowercased) | Emitted SQL |
|---|---|
| `""` / `"="` | `field = :k` |
| `"in"` | chunks of ≤500 OR'd: `(field IN (:k_0_0,…) OR field IN (:k_1_0,…))` |
| `"like"` | `field LIKE :k`, replacement `%v%` |
| `"between"` | `field BETWEEN :k_lo AND :k_hi`; throws if `value[0]` is not a 2-element array |

Edge cases: empty `in` array emits `1=0` (never `IN ()`, which is a SQL syntax error); placeholder keys are still sanitized `field.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/g,'_') + '_' + i` as defense-in-depth even though `field` is already allow-listed; `whereClause` is `''` when there are no conditions. `ALLOWED_FILTER_FIELDS` is a `Set` built from the **verified** view columns produced by Task 0 step 4.

**`resolveDocumentColumns(filters, search) → [{ id, orden, descripcion }]`** — shared by `/columns` (passes `search = ''`) and `/data`; recomputed every call, no caching (intentional).

```js
const rows = await sequelize.query(
  `SELECT documento_id, MIN(descripcion) AS descripcion
   FROM ${VIEW} ${finalWhere}
   GROUP BY documento_id`, { type: QueryTypes.SELECT, replacements });
return rows
  .map(r => ({ id: Number(r.documento_id), orden: DOC_ORDER[r.documento_id] ?? 999, descripcion: r.descripcion }))
  .sort((a, b) => a.orden - b.orden);   // Array#sort is stable (Node >= 11)
```
Stability is load-bearing: unmapped ids all share `orden: 999` and must retain DB return order, per spec §3.1. `VIEW` is the Task 0-resolved constant (decision 9) — never a literal repeated per query.

**Grouping — the §3.2 bug guard.** Fixed fields are read from the grouped folio entry, never from a loop-leaked row variable:

```js
const byFolio = new Map();
for (const r of docRows) {
  if (!byFolio.has(r.cuestionario_id)) byFolio.set(r.cuestionario_id, { head: r, docs: new Map() });
  byFolio.get(r.cuestionario_id).docs.set(Number(r.documento_id), r);
}
const data = folioIds.map((id) => {
  const item = byFolio.get(id);                    // ← the ONLY source of fixed fields
  const out = {
    cuestionario_id: id,
    curp: item.head.persona_curp,
    programa: item.head.programa_nombre,
    convocatoria: item.head.convocatoria_descripcion,
    estatus_solicitud: item.head.estatus_solicitud_estatus,
    estatus_docs: item.head.estatus_docs,
  };
  for (const col of columns) {
    const d = item.docs.get(col.id);
    const estatus = d?.estatus ?? 'NA';
    out[`doc_${col.id}`] = {
      estatus,
      observacion: estatus === 'Documento correcto' ? null : (d?.mensage ?? null),
    };
  }
  return out;
});
```
`docRows` and `r` must not be referenced after the grouping loop. Iterating `folioIds` (not `byFolio`) preserves page ordering.

**Wire contracts** — `/columns`, `/data`, `/template` byte-identical to `report-documents-backend-spec.md` §3.1/§3.2/§3.4. `/export` deviates in delivery only: `Content-Type: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet`, `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=Reporte_documentos_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.xlsx`, `await workbook.xlsx.write(res); res.end();`.

**Export sheet layout** — Row 1: cols 1-6 blank, then per document a merged 2-col cell holding `descripcion` (dark fill `0C498F`, bold white). Row 2: `Folio, CURP, Programa, Convocatoria, Estatus Solicitud, Estatus Revisión` + `Estatus, Observación` per document (medium-blue fill, bold white, thin borders). Data rows flattened, same "Documento correcto → blank observación" rule. Column widths and border/font style follow `downloadReportePagos`; pixel-parity with the legacy file is explicitly not a goal. `/template` uses `res.download(path.resolve(__dirname, '../assets/plantilla_folios.xlsx'), 'plantilla_folios.xlsx')` with an `fs.existsSync` guard returning `404 {ok:false, message}`.

**Pagination guard**: `length` clamped to `[1, 500]` (aligning with the `in`-chunk size, so Q3's `IN` list never needs chunking). `length === -1` is rejected with 400 — unbounded pages are what `/export` is for.

## Testing Strategy

| Layer | What | Approach |
|---|---|---|
| Pre-flight | Task 0 steps 1-4 | Scratch Node script using `src/config/database.js`; record resolved identifier + real column list before any other task starts. |
| Unit | `buildDocumentWhere` (4 operators, 501-item chunking, empty `in`, bad `between`, rejected field), `groupFoliosToRows` (mixed folios → correct attribution), `DOC_ORDER` sort stability | No test runner exists in this project. Keep all three helpers pure and **exported** so tests can be added when one is introduced; verify manually via a scratch Node script this iteration. |
| Integration | 4 endpoints via Swagger UI / Postman | No token → 401; `gpo_id` 10 → 403; `gpo_id` 40/70/80 → 200. Compare `/columns` + `/data` JSON against spec §3.1/§3.2 key-for-key. |
| Regression | §3.2 bug | Query a filter set spanning ≥2 folios with *different* `convocatoria`/`estatus_docs` and assert each row carries its own values. |
| Manual | `/export` | Open the `.xlsx`; verify merged doc headers, `Documento correcto` rows have blank observación. |

## Migration / Rollout

No DB migration. Purely additive: revert the commit, or remove the one `app.use` line in `src/index.js` and the `endpointsFiles` entry. `npm run swagger` must be re-run after the route file lands. `/template` can ship disabled/404 while the other 3 endpoints go live.

## Open Questions

- [ ] **BLOCKING for all query endpoints** — Task 0 (Source View Resolution) must run first. Its step-3 branch (`educafin` is a separate database) is the only outcome that changes scope, since this project has a single `Sequelize` instance bound to `DB_NAME`.
- [ ] **BLOCKING for `/template` only** — `plantilla_folios.xlsx` does not exist in this repo. It must be sourced from the legacy system and placed at `src/assets/plantilla_folios.xlsx`. Track as a task-level asset dependency; the endpoint's code is fully specified and the other 3 endpoints ship independently.
- [ ] Should `ALLOWED_GROUPS = [40, 70, 80]` be env-configurable? Designed as a hardcoded module constant (matching `PROGRAM_IDS_DEFAULT`); unanswered from the proposal question round.
- [ ] Expected max export size? Unanswered. If tens of thousands of folios are realistic, add an `EXPORT_MAX_FOLIOS` guard or switch to `WorkbookWriter`.
