observations.title: Design: Reporte de Documentos (report-documents)
observations.content:
# Design: Reporte de Documentos (report-documents) ## Technical Approach Clone the `src/app/private/general-report/` module shape for the COMPONENT layer only (NgModule-declared component, static-mat-table swapped for a runtime-rebuilt two-row grouped header). Native `` element is used (as in `general-report.component.html:354`), so real `colspan`/`rowspan` semantics are available — this is what makes the grouped header possible without a custom renderer. Headers endpoint resolves FIRST, updates the three column arrays, then the data request fires (`switchMap`, never `forkJoin`). Page turns hit only the data endpoint. **Service/model layer does NOT clone general-report — see D3 (REVERSED 2026-08-31, read below) — it extends the shared `PrivateService`/`main.model.ts` per CLAUDE.md's documented convention instead.** ## Architecture Decisions | # | Decision | Alternatives rejected | Rationale | |---|---|---|---| | D3 | **REVERSED 2026-08-31** — ~~Feature-local `ReportDocumentsService` + `models/report-documents.model.ts`~~ → **Append 4 methods to `PrivateService` + interfaces to `main.model.ts`** (this is now correct; matches the ORIGINAL proposal's Affected Areas table) | Feature-local service+models (`general-report/`'s pattern) — this was tried first in PR1, `gga`'s code-review hook flagged the conflict with CLAUDE.md's explicit documented convention ("All backend calls go through PrivateService... add the method to PrivateService"; "All shared interfaces live in main.model.ts"), user was asked to choose and **explicitly chose the CLAUDE.md-literal convention** over the newer `general-report` precedent | CLAUDE.md is the authoritative, explicit, checked-in project convention. `general-report/` being a newer sibling that deviated from it does not override documented project-wide convention without an explicit maintainer decision — which was sought and given. Applies ONLY to the service/model layer; the component/template layer (grouped header rendering) is unaffected and still lives in `src/app/private/report-documents/`. | | D4 | Column ids derived from the doc type's numeric id: `grp_{id}`, `doc_{id}_status`, `doc_{id}_note` | Ids derived from the display label | `CdkColumnDef._setNameInput` sanitizes the name into a CSS class (`value.replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]/gi,'-')`, `cdk/table.mjs:149`). Labels with accents/spaces/duplicates ("Acta de nacimiento") collide → `getTableDuplicateColumnNameError`. Numeric ids are stable, unique, ASCII. | | D5 | Sequential `getColumns()` → `tap(applyColumns)` → `switchMap(searchData)` | `forkJoin` of headers+data | Column defs must exist before the data row def resolves them, else `Could not find column with id "…"` (`cdk/table.mjs:1070`). Sequencing also guarantees page turns never refetch headers. | | D6 | Fixed 6 columns reuse ONE column def each, rendered in the group row with `[attr.rowspan]="2"`; dynamic docs get 3 defs each (group/status/note) | Duplicate "spacer" defs for the fixed columns in row 2 | Fewer defs, no blank cells, native `rowspan` handles alignment. | | D7 | Template download = SweetAlert2 confirm + authenticated `responseType:'blob'` → `createObjectURL` → anchor → `revokeObjectURL` | Plain `window.location.href` navigation | Auth mode of `GET /report-documents/template` is UNCONFIRMED. The blob path works whether or not the endpoint requires Bearer; plain navigation fails silently if it does. Safe default, unblocks apply. Downgrade to a plain anchor later if confirmed public. | | D8 | **CORRECTED 2026-09-01 (commit `964a43b`)** — ~~Render `Observación` exactly as received~~ → **Client-side `resolveNote(status, note)`: renders empty when `status === 'Documento correcto'`, regardless of any note value received** | Trusting backend enforcement only (the original D8, now known wrong) | `sdd-verify` caught this as a CRITICAL finding: the persisted spec (id 175, requirement "Observación Business Rule") is an unconditional client-side rendering rule — "MUST render empty regardless of any note value received" — not a note about backend-only enforcement. The original D8 rationale ("Spec §6 already enforces this server-side, don't apply twice") was the orchestrator's misreading during the design-phase prompt, not something actually written in the persisted spec. Fixed as a pure `resolveObservacionNote` helper, unit-tested, matching the `deriveColumns`/`extractFolios`/`buildCustomData` pure-function pattern from PR2. | | D9 | **ADDED 2026-09-01 (commit `964a43b`)** — 403 responses from any of the 4 `PrivateService` report-documents calls redirect to `/forbidden` via a shared `handleHttpError(err)` helper (checks `err.status === 403`, calls `Router.navigate(['/forbidden'])`; non-403 errors keep the existing Swal message) | A project-wide `HttpInterceptor` fix (the existing `auth.interceptor.ts` is a no-op stub) | Spec's "Route Access Control" requirement has an explicit scenario: "a 403 from any endpoint routes the frontend to `/forbidden`" (D1). This was missing from PR3's initial implementation — `sdd-verify` caught it as CRITICAL. Scoped locally to this component's 4 HTTP call sites rather than fixing the project-wide stub interceptor, which is a separate, larger, out-of-scope concern. | ## Service Layer (PR1, corrected per D3) Methods live on `src/app/services/private.service.ts`, reusing the file's single existing private `getHeaders()` — no duplicate added. Renamed from generic names to feature-scoped names to avoid collisions in the shared service (matches this file's own convention, e.g. `getReportePagos`, `downloadPagosExcel`, `downloadPagosIssegTemplate`): ```ts getReportDocumentsColumns(customData: FilterItem[]): Observable // POST report-documents/columns getReportDocumentsData(payload: SearchPayload): Observable // POST report-documents/data exportReportDocumentsExcel(customData: FilterItem[]): Observable // POST report-documents/export downloadReportDocumentsTemplate(): Observable // GET report-documents/template, responseType: 'blob' ``` Interfaces live in `src/app/models/main.model.ts` under a `// ====== REPORT DOCUMENTS ======` section (added at end of file, after `Despacho`) — shapes unchanged from the original contract below. **IMPORTANT for PR2/PR3 component work**: the component (`report-documents.component.ts`) must inject `PrivateService` and call these 4 renamed methods — NOT a `ReportDocumentsService` (that class no longer exists, was deleted in the D3 correction). Import interfaces from `../../models/main.model` (or correct relative path), not a feature-local `models/report-documents.model.ts`. ## The novel piece — dynamic grouped header Three arrays, all reassigned as NEW references in one synchronous call before the data request: ```ts const FIXED_COLUMNS = ['folio','curp','programa','convocatoria', 'estatus_solicitud','estatus_revision'] as const; private applyColumns(docs: DocHeader[]): void { this.docColumns = docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, label: d.name, groupId: `grp_${d.id}`, statusId: `doc_${d.id}_status`, noteId: `doc_${d.id}_note`, })); this.groupRowColumns = [...FIXED_COLUMNS, ...this.docColumns.map(c => c.groupId)]; this.subHeaderColumns = this.docColumns.flatMap(c => [c.statusId, c.noteId]); this.displayedColumns = [...FIXED_COLUMNS, ...this.subHeaderColumns]; } private runSearch(filters: FilterItem[]): void { this.isSearching = true; this.privateService.getReportDocumentsColumns(filters).pipe( tap(res => this.applyColumns(res.data)), // columns FIRST switchMap(() => this.privateService.getReportDocumentsData(this.buildPayload(filters))), takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef), ).subscribe({ next: res => { … this.hasSearched = true; }, error: (err) => this.handleHttpError(err) }); // D9: 403 → /forbidden, else Swal } // Page turn: fetchData() only — never getReportDocumentsColumns(). ``` Template (inside `
`): ```html ``` API facts verified against installed `@angular/cdk@18.2` / `@angular/material@18.2.14` source (Context7 MCP tools were not exposed to this agent, so node_modules was used as the authority): - `MatColumnDef` declares `inputs: { name: ['matColumnDef','name'] }` (`material/fesm2022/table.mjs:192`) → `[matColumnDef]` is bindable. - `_contentColumnDefs` is `@ContentChildren(CdkColumnDef, { descendants: true })` (`cdk/table.mjs:2208-2210`) → defs created by a nested `*ngFor`/`ng-container` are still collected. - `_headerRowDefs` is an array with per-def sticky state (`cdk/table.mjs:1643-1647`) → multiple `*matHeaderRowDef` rows are first-class. - `BaseRowDef.getColumnsDiff()` re-diffs the live array each check (`cdk/table.mjs:355`); `_cacheColumnDefs()` runs before `_renderUpdatedColumns()` in `_render()` — so new defs and new row columns applied in the SAME tick resolve cleanly. Rules that prevent the two classic failures: 1. **Never** split the `*ngFor` source update and the row-column array update across ticks (no `setTimeout` on one) → avoids `Could not find column with id`. 2. Assign new array references (not `push`) so `docColumns` and the three row arrays stay atomically consistent. 3. `applyColumns()` runs inside an HTTP callback, never during render → no `ExpressionChangedAfterItHasBeenChecked`. 4. No `sticky: true` on the grouped header rows in v1 — sticky styling plus `rowspan`/`colspan` is unverified here; revisit only if requested. 5. `trackBy: (_, c) => c.id` keeps defs alive across identical header responses. ## Data Flow Filtrar ─┬─ folio text (comma → 'in', single → ' like') └─ XLSX col B (5000 cap) │ manual text WINS over file ▼ buildCustomData(): FilterItem[] │ ▼ POST report-documents/columns ──→ applyColumns() (3 new arrays) │ switchMap ▼ POST report-documents/data (draw/start/length) ──→ dataSource.data │ page event ────┘ (data endpoint ONLY, headers untouched) Any of the 4 calls above → error → handleHttpError(err): err.status === 403 → Router.navigate(['/forbidden']) else → Swal.fire('Error', …, 'error') (D9) ## File Changes | File | Action | Description | |---|---|---| | `src/app/private/report-documents/report-documents.component.ts` | **Done (PR2 `736183b` + PR3 `ff5c1fe` + fix `964a43b`)** | State, form, dropzone, sequencing, export, template download, `resolveNote`/`resolveObservacionNote` (D8), `handleHttpError` (D9) — injects `PrivateService` + `Router` directly | | `src/app/private/report-documents/report-documents.component.html` | **Done (PR3 `ff5c1fe`, note cell fixed in `964a43b`)** | Filters card + results card + dynamic 2-row table | | `src/app/private/report-documents/report-documents.component.css` | **Done (PR3 `ff5c1fe`)** | Copy `general-report.component.css` chrome; `.doc-group` + horizontal scroll | | `src/app/services/private.service.ts` | **Done (PR1 `8e2bbd2`)** | 4 methods added (see Service Layer section above), reusing existing `getHeaders()` | | `src/app/models/main.model.ts` | **Done (PR1 `8e2bbd2`)** | 9 interfaces added under `// ====== REPORT DOCUMENTS ======`: `FilterItem`, `DocHeader`, `DocColumn`, `DocCell`, `ReportDocumentsRow`, `SearchPayload`, `SearchResponse`, `ColumnsResponse`, `ExportResponse` | | `src/app/private/private-routing.module.ts` | **Done (PR3 `ff5c1fe`)** | Import + `{ path:'reportDocuments', component: ReportDocumentsComponent, canDeactivate:[pendingGuard] }` — inserted after the last existing route entry (this worktree's `main`-based history doesn't include `general-report`'s routes; reconcile ordering when branches merge), before the `**` wildcard | | `src/app/private/private.module.ts` | **Done (PR3 `ff5c1fe`)** | Import + `ReportDocumentsComponent` added to `declarations` | | `src/app/guards/auth-match.guard.ts` | **Done (PR3 `ff5c1fe`)** | Added `'reportDocuments',` to the flat `allowed` array. **No `groupId` logic — D1 locked: backend is sole enforcer; frontend adds D9's 403→/forbidden redirect instead.** | | `src/app/shared/full-layout/full-layout.component.html` | **Done (PR3 `ff5c1fe`)** | Nav link, icon `fact_check`, label "Reporte de Documentos" | No feature-local `models/`/`services/` directories under `report-documents/` — corrected D3, PR1 done. ## Interfaces / Contracts ```ts export interface FilterItem { field: string; value: [any, string]; } export interface DocHeader { id: number; name: string; } export interface ColumnsResponse { data: DocHeader[]; } export interface DocColumn { id: number; label: string; groupId: string; statusId: string; noteId: string; } export interface DocCell { status: string | null; note: string | null; } export interface ReportDocumentsRow { folio: string; curp: string; programa: string; convocatoria: string; estatus_solicitud: string; estatus_revision: string; documents: Record; // keyed by document type id } export interface SearchPayload { // identical shape to general-report draw: number; start: number; length: number; search: { value: string; regex: boolean }; order: any[]; columns: any[]; customData: FilterItem[]; } export interface SearchResponse { draw: number; recordsTotal: number; recordsFiltered: number; data: ReportDocumentsRow[]; } export interface ExportResponse { ok: boolean; url: string; } ``` All live in `src/app/models/main.model.ts` (see D3). Service methods: see "Service Layer" section above for final names/signatures — all `POST` with `getHeaders()` unless noted, base `environment.apiUrl`. ## Reused behaviour **Bulk upload** — lifted `onDragOver/onDragLeave/onDrop/onFileInputChange/processFile` from `general-report.component.ts:202-247` near-verbatim: same `.xls/.xlsx` guard, `XLSX.read(type:'array')`, `sheet_to_json({header:1, defval:''})`, `rows.slice(6).map(r => String(r[1] ?? '').trim()).filter(Boolean)` (column B from row 7), same 5000 cap, plus the zero-folio warning general-report lacks. Extracted folios are NEVER uploaded — they become `{ field:'folio', value:[folios,'in'] }` in `customData`. Manual folio text takes precedence over the file (inverted vs general-report). **Export (D2 locked)** — `Swal` loading "EXPORTANDO…" → `exportReportDocumentsExcel(activeFilters)` → on `res.ok` `window.location.href = res.url`; else error via `handleHttpError` (D9). Button hidden until `hasSearched`. **Template download (D7)** — the `carga-de-pagos.component.ts:212-226` confirm dialog, then the `escuelas.component.ts:474-481` blob-download mechanics via `downloadReportDocumentsTemplate()`. **Observación (D8 corrected)** — `resolveNote(status, note)`: returns `''` when `status === 'Documento correcto'`, else `note || '—'`. Pure, unit-tested. **403 handling (D9, new)** — `handleHttpError(err)`: `err.status === 403` → `Router.navigate(['/forbidden'])`; else the existing Swal error message. Wired into all 4 HTTP call sites (`runSearch`, `fetchData`, `exportExcel`, `downloadTemplate`). ## Testing Strategy | Layer | What | How | Status | |---|---|---|---| | Unit (pure) | `deriveColumns()`/`applyColumns()` builds the 3 arrays with correct ids/order/length | Plain Jasmine | Done (PR2) | | Unit (pure) | `extractFolios()`: col B from row 7, blanks dropped, 0-folio reject, >5000 reject | Plain Jasmine | Done (PR2) | | Unit (pure) | `buildCustomData()` precedence (text > file), comma → `'in'`, single → `' like'` | Plain Jasmine | Done (PR2) | | Unit (pure) | `resolveObservacionNote()`: blank when status is "Documento correcto", passthrough otherwise | Plain Jasmine | **Done (fix `964a43b`)** | | Unit (HttpTestingController) | 4 `PrivateService` methods | `private.service.spec.ts`, 8 tests | Done (PR1) | | Component | headers resolve BEFORE data; page turn calls data only | `TestBed` + spy, assert call order | Done (PR2) | | Component | 403 on any of the 4 calls → `Router.navigate(['/forbidden'])`; non-403 → Swal | `TestBed` + `Router` spy, mocked `HttpErrorResponse` | **Done (fix `964a43b`)**, 5 tests | | Component | wrong-extension file rejected, no `extractFolios` call | `TestBed` | **Done (fix `964a43b`)** | | Render | 2 header rows with correct `colspan`/`rowspan`, no CDK column error | `TestBed` + `fixture.detectChanges()` | Done (PR3) | | Manual | Guard: `/home/private/reportDocuments` reachable; unlisted route → `/forbidden`; 403 from API → `/forbidden` | Browser | Pending (needs `ng serve`, out of agent reach) | ## Migration / Rollout No migration. All shared-file edits are single additive lines/blocks; revert the feature commits to restore current behavior. ## Open Questions - [ ] `GET /report-documents/template` auth mode — designed with the safe authenticated-blob default (D7); simplify to a plain anchor if confirmed public. - [ ] Zero-result UX (proposal Q4): design renders the fixed-6 table with the second header row suppressed via `*ngIf="subHeaderColumns.length"`; confirm vs. a "no results" message. - [ ] Exact `ColumnsResponse` / `ReportDocumentsRow` shapes unverified against the real backend — especially whether documents arrive keyed by id (assumed) or as a positional array. - [ ] Sticky fixed columns deferred; not attempted with `rowspan`/`colspan` in v1. - [x] Removing the uploaded file (proposal Q1) — resolved: clears folio text + empties results, no auto re-search (PR3, `ff5c1fe`).
Folio {{ r.folio || '—' }} {{ c.label }} Estatus {{ r.documents?.[c.id]?.status || '—' }} Observación {{ resolveNote(r.documents?.[c.id]?.status, r.documents?.[c.id]?.note) }}

observations.title: sdd/report-documents/spec
observations.content:
# Report Documents Specification

## Purpose
Admins filter folios (typed or XLSX) and view a server-paginated document-status table per folio, with dynamic grouped columns and full-result Excel export. Route-gated by name; backend enforces the group allow-list.

## Requirements

### Requirement: Route Access Control
Gate the route by name in `auth-match.guard.ts`, like the existing 9 routes. No client-side `gpo_id` check — absent from JWT, session, and all decode sites. Backend is sole enforcer of `[40,70,80]`; a 403 from any endpoint routes the frontend to `/forbidden`.

#### Scenario: Allowed route activates
- GIVEN the route is allow-listed for the user
- WHEN they navigate to it
- THEN the screen renders

#### Scenario: Backend denies access
- GIVEN an unauthorized authenticated user
- WHEN a report-documents endpoint returns 403
- THEN frontend redirects to `/forbidden`

### Requirement: Filters Panel
Collapsible, expanded by default; shows a "select at least one filter" banner, a folio input (single or comma-list), and an `.xls`/`.xlsx` dropzone.

#### Scenario: Initial state
- GIVEN the screen loads
- THEN panel is expanded, results empty, export button hidden

#### Scenario: Comma-list folio filter
- GIVEN input "123,456,789"
- WHEN Filtrar is clicked
- THEN filter uses folio IN [123,456,789]

### Requirement: Bulk Folio Upload
Parse dropped `.xls`/`.xlsx` client-side only (no server upload): column B, skip row 6 header, collect non-empty values, cap at 5000 folios.

#### Scenario: Valid file parsed
- GIVEN a template file with folios in column B
- WHEN parsed
- THEN the list is used as the IN filter

#### Scenario: Wrong extension
- WHEN a non-`.xls`/`.xlsx` file is dropped
- THEN it is rejected with an error toast, unparsed

#### Scenario: Zero folios extracted
- WHEN parsing yields zero folios
- THEN user is warned the file doesn't match the template; search aborts

#### Scenario: Over the 5000 cap
- WHEN parsing yields more than 5000 folios
- THEN user is warned "max 5000 folios per file"; search aborts

### Requirement: Filter Precedence
Manual folio text MUST override an uploaded file's extracted list when both are present.

#### Scenario: Manual overrides file
- GIVEN a parsed file and a filled folio field
- WHEN Filtrar is clicked
- THEN only the manual folio filter is sent

### Requirement: Search Execution
On Filtrar or a valid upload: request the columns endpoint, rebuild the header (6 fixed + 2×N dynamic), then load page 1 in server-side pagination. Loading overlay during the columns request; Exportar Excel appears only after first successful load.

#### Scenario: Successful search
- GIVEN a valid active filter
- WHEN search executes
- THEN header rebuilds, table populates, Exportar Excel appears

### Requirement: Dynamic Results Columns
6 fixed columns (Folio, CURP, Programa, Convocatoria, Estatus solicitud, Estatus Revisión) plus an Estatus/Observación pair per backend-returned document type, grouped under its name. Column set/order MUST come from the backend, never hardcoded.

#### Scenario: N document types returned
- GIVEN the backend returns N document types
- THEN the table shows 6 + 2N columns under N grouped headers

### Requirement: Pagination
A page change re-requests only the data endpoint with existing filters + new offset. MUST NOT re-request columns unless the filter set changed.

#### Scenario: Page turn
- GIVEN a rendered results table
- WHEN the user changes page
- THEN only data is refetched; header stays the same

### Requirement: Observación Business Rule
WHEN a row's Estatus equals "Documento correcto", its Observación cell MUST render empty regardless of any note value received.

#### Scenario: Correct document hides note
- GIVEN Estatus = "Documento correcto" with a returned note
- THEN Observación renders empty

### Requirement: Export to Excel (D2)
Exportar Excel calls `POST /report-documents/export`, authenticated via `getHeaders()`, with active filters + export-all flag (not the paginated endpoint — must return all matching rows). Shows a loading overlay. On `{ok,url}` response, navigates via `window.location.href = url` — the returned `url` is public/signed and needs no further auth. On error, shows a message and stops loading.

#### Scenario: Successful export
- GIVEN an active filter set
- WHEN Exportar Excel is clicked
- THEN overlay shows, then browser navigates to the returned `url`

#### Scenario: Export failure
- WHEN the export request fails
- THEN an error message shows and the overlay dismisses

### Requirement: Download Template (D2 — pending confirmation)
Descargar plantilla shows a confirm dialog ("¿Desea descargar la plantilla?"); on confirm, downloads via `GET /report-documents/template` using the app's established authenticated-blob pattern (`getHeaders()`+`responseType:'blob'`→`createObjectURL`→anchor→`revokeObjectURL`, per `carga-de-pagos.component.ts`) as the safe default, since the endpoint's auth mode (public/signed vs Bearer) is unconfirmed. MAY simplify to direct navigation later if confirmed public/signed.

#### Scenario: Confirmed download
- GIVEN user clicks Descargar plantilla
- WHEN they confirm the dialog
- THEN the blob request runs and the file downloads

#### Scenario: Cancelled dialog
- WHEN the confirm dialog is dismissed
- THEN no request is made

### Requirement: Clearing an Uploaded File
Removing the uploaded file clears the folio text field and empties the results table. MUST NOT re-run an unfiltered search.

#### Scenario: File removed
- GIVEN results from a file-based search
- WHEN the file is removed from the dropzone
- THEN the folio field clears and results empty

## Out of Scope
Column sorting; a generic reusable dynamic-table abstraction; backend implementation; adding `gpo_id` to the JWT; program/request-status/date-range filter controls; a remove-filters button (legacy commented-out); client-side Excel-file generation for export (legacy dead code); a server upload endpoint for the folios file (parsing stays client-side only).

# Apply Progress: recrear-endpoints-report-documents — ALL WORK DONE, INCLUDING LIVE PHASE 5 QA

## Final delivery (unchanged from previous revision)

Consolidated to a single branch per user request: `feature/report-documents-endpoints`, pushed to `origin` (GitLab), commits `76157cf` → `f343612` → `7608fc7` → `d6aee4f`. No MR opened yet. Full detail in prior revision — unchanged.

## Phase 5 — LIVE QA COMPLETED THIS BATCH (against real DB, SUBE_20260804)

DB connectivity was intermittently down (VPN-dependent, private IP `172.31.27.44:1433`) — first attempt timed out after 15s, retried successfully once connectivity returned. Started `src/index.js` in background, tested with 2 throwaway JWTs signed locally using the app's own `JWT_SECRET` (never printed/exposed) — one with `gpo_id: 40` (allowed), one with `gpo_id: 999` (denied). Tokens deleted after use, server killed after testing (`TaskStop`), no lingering process.

**Task 5.1 — group-authorization 403/200 — DONE, PASSED**:
- Denied group (`gpo_id: 999`) → 403 on all 4 endpoints (`columns`, `data`, `export`, `template`).
- Allowed group (`gpo_id: 40`) → 200 on `columns`, `data`, `template`. `export` also 200 but ONLY when a real filter is passed (see risk below).

**Task 5.2 — live JSON shape check — DONE, PASSED**: `/columns` with empty filters returned the full real doc-type list from production data, correctly ordered per `DOC_ORDER_MAP` (164→1, 165→2, 166→3, 4→4, 5→5, 10→6, 2→7, 222→8, ...), unmapped ids sorted last. `/data` with `{filters:[],draw:1,start:0,length:2}` returned 2 real folio rows with `doc_<id>` objects, `NA`/`null` defaulting exactly as designed.

**Task 5.3/5.4 — export/template live check — DONE, with a NEW finding (not a bug, a real operational risk)**:
- `GET /template` → 200, fast, serves the real `plantilla_folios.xlsx` now that it's committed.
- `POST /export` with `{"filters":[{"field":"cuestionario_id","value":["1","="]}]}` → 200 in 0.12s. Fast and correct.
- `POST /export` with `{"filters":[]}` (no filters at all) → did NOT return within 2 minutes (client-side curl timeout hit; server itself stayed alive and responsive to other requests afterward, confirmed via a follow-up 401 check — so this is a genuinely slow/large query, not a hang or crash). Root cause: with zero filters, `resolveDocumentColumns` pulls every distinct `documento_id` that has EVER appeared in the entire view (not scoped to any folio subset), producing a very wide result, combined with pulling every matching folio's full row set for the export — this is the exact "Export memory ceiling" / "no known upper bound on dataset size" risk the design doc already flagged as unanswered, now empirically confirmed as a real, reproducible slow path rather than a theoretical one.

## Updated cumulative task status: 20/20 tasks addressed

- [x] 0.1 through 4.1 — all done (unchanged, see prior revision).
- [x] 5.1, 5.2, 5.3, 5.4 — DONE THIS BATCH, all passed except the export-with-no-filters performance finding noted above (not a functional bug — spec never required a "must have at least one filter" guard on `/export`, unlike the legacy `searchRequestsForExcel` sibling endpoint which does enforce that; nobody has asked for that guard here, so it was NOT added unilaterally — just documented as an operational risk for whoever owns capacity planning).

## Swagger investigation (separate topic, see `bug/swagger-autogen-doc-generation` for full root-cause writeup)

User asked to fix swagger doc visibility for the new endpoints; investigation found the underlying `swagger-autogen@2.23.7` toolchain bug is deeper and pre-existing (project-wide, not scoped to this feature) — user decided to just document it (saved separately) rather than attempt a scoped or full fix. `swagger.js`/`swagger-output.json` are back to their exact pre-existing committed state (verified clean via `git status`) — no swagger changes were committed as part of this change.

## Next Steps

- Everything implementation- and QA-wise is done. Only remaining decision is whether/when to open the MR `feature/report-documents-endpoints` → `master` on GitLab (link was already printed by the push, not yet followed) — waiting on user's go-ahead.
- If/when someone owns the export performance risk: consider requiring at least one filter on `/export` (matching the legacy sibling's pattern) or moving it to an async job, per the design doc's own suggestion — not done here since it wasn't asked for and would be scope creep on an already-complete change.
- `sdd-archive` can run once the MR is opened/merged, or whenever the user considers this closed.

observations.content:
## Implementation Progress — report-documents (FULL CHAIN COMPLETE: PR1 → PR2 → PR3 → CORRECTIVE FIX)

**Change**: report-documents
**Mode**: Strict TDD (RED → GREEN)
**Chain strategy**: stacked-to-main. Worktree: `c:/proyectos/frontend_juventudes-wt-report-documents`.

### PR1 — Foundation (commit `8e2bbd2` on `feature/report-documents-foundation`)
4 methods added to `PrivateService`, 9 interfaces added to `main.model.ts`. 3 files, 250 insertions.

### PR2 — Core Component Logic (commit `736183b` on `feature/report-documents-core-logic`)
Created `report-documents.component.{ts,html,css,spec.ts}` with pure `deriveColumns`/`extractFolios`/`buildCustomData`, search sequencing. 4 files, 649 insertions.

### PR3 — Grouped Table, Export/Template, Wiring (commit `ff5c1fe` on `feature/report-documents-wiring`)
Dynamic grouped-header table, export/template flows, removeFile wiring, 4 shared-file route/guard/module/nav edits. 8 files, 523 insertions / 60 deletions.

### CORRECTIVE FIX (commit `964a43b` on `feature/report-documents-wiring`, on top of `ff5c1fe`) — fixes sdd-verify findings (obs #181)

Root cause: during design, the orchestrator mis-instructed apply to render Observación "as-received, no client-side re-filtering" — a misreading of the persisted spec (obs #175), which unambiguously requires client-side blanking regardless of backend behavior. This corrective commit realigns code with the actual spec.

**Fix 1 — Observación business rule (CRITICAL)**: Added pure exported `resolveObservacionNote(status, note)` in `report-documents.component.ts` — returns `''` when `status === 'Documento correcto'`, else `note || '—'`. Added a thin `resolveNote()` public wrapper method (templates can't call bare imported functions) used in `report-documents.component.html`'s note `<td>` binding, replacing the previous unconditional `r.documents?.[c.id]?.note || '—'`. Added 3-case unit-test triangulation for the pure function. Fixed the previously-passing-but-spec-contradicting integration test ("renders every cell exactly as received... including a note alongside 'Documento correcto'") — renamed to reflect correct behavior and changed its expected cell value for the "Documento correcto"-with-note fixture row from the note text to `''`.

**Fix 2 — 403 → /forbidden redirect (CRITICAL, scoped to this component only)**: Injected `Router` into `ReportDocumentsComponent`'s constructor. Added private `handleHttpError(err: HttpErrorResponse, message: string)`: if `err?.status === 403` → `this.router.navigate(['/forbidden'])` (matches the app's top-level absolute `{ path: 'forbidden' }` route in `app-routing.module.ts`); otherwise falls back to the existing `Swal.fire('Error', message, 'error')`. Wired into all 4 HTTP error callbacks: `runSearch`, `fetchData`, `exportExcel`, `downloadTemplate`. Did NOT touch `auth.interceptor.ts` (pre-existing no-op stub, explicitly out of scope). Added a dedicated `describe('ReportDocumentsComponent 403 handling')` with 5 tests: 4 positive (one per HTTP call site) + 1 negative (non-403 still shows the generic Swal error, does not redirect) using a `forbiddenError()` HttpErrorResponse(status:403) helper and a shared `createRouterSpy()` helper. Added `Router` spy providers to all 5 pre-existing TestBed configs in the spec file (constructor now requires it).

**Fix 3 — missing "wrong extension rejected" test (CRITICAL, protocol-level)**: Added `describe('ReportDocumentsComponent bulk upload wiring')` with one test: dropping a `.pdf` file via `onFileInputChange` triggers `Swal.fire('Error', ..., 'error')` and leaves `uploadedFile`/`foliosFromFile` untouched. `processFile()`'s extension guard itself was already correct — this only adds the missing coverage.

#### TDD Cycle Evidence (this corrective commit)
| Fix | Test(s) | RED | GREEN | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Observación rule | 3 new `resolveObservacionNote` unit tests + 1 fixed integration test | ✅ Genuine compile-time RED confirmed (`TS2305: Module has no exported member 'resolveObservacionNote'`) before implementing | ✅ 42/42 scoped pass after implementation | Fixture data unchanged (still sends a note alongside "Documento correcto") — only the assertion/expectation was wrong before |
| 403 redirect | 5 new tests in dedicated describe | ✅ Same RED batch (compile failure) | ✅ 42/42 scoped pass | Router spy required in all 5 existing TestBed configs since constructor DI now needs it |
| Wrong extension | 1 new test | ✅ Same RED batch | ✅ 42/42 scoped pass | Code was already correct; this is pure coverage addition |

### Verification Results (this corrective commit)
- Baseline before fix: scoped run (`report-documents.component.spec.ts` + `private.service.spec.ts`) = 33/33 SUCCESS.
- RED confirmed: genuine TS2305 compile error referencing not-yet-existing `resolveObservacionNote` export (independently re-run, not just trusted).
- GREEN: scoped run = 42/42 SUCCESS (33 + 9 new: 3 resolveObservacionNote + 5 x 403-handling + 1 wrong-extension).
- Full-suite regression check (isolated `tsconfig.spec.verify.json` + `--exclude=auth.interceptor.spec.ts` workaround, temp file deleted after, confirmed untracked via `git status --short`): **62 total / 45 SUCCESS / 17 FAILED** — reconciles exactly against PR3's baseline (53 total/36 pass/17 fail): 62-53=9 new, 45-36=9 new passes, the 17 pre-existing unrelated failures (HttpClient/MatDialogRef/app-header NullInjectorErrors) are byte-for-byte unchanged. **Zero regressions.**
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json`: clean, zero errors.

observations.title: Diagnosed swagger-autogen mount-prefix + Windows path bugs
observations.content:
**What**: Root-caused why `npm run swagger` can't safely regenerate `src/config/swagger-output.json` on this project. Two distinct bugs in `swagger-autogen@2.23.7` itself (installed, pinned `^2.23.7`), not something introduced by any recent feature work. NOT fixed — investigated and reverted, documented here so it isn't rediscovered from scratch or blamed on the wrong commit.

**Why**: Came up while wiring the report-documents endpoints (`recrear-endpoints-report-documents` SDD change) — the new routes are functional but don't show in `/api-docs` because regen is unsafe. User asked to document the root cause instead of attempting a full fix (which would require touching every route file) or filing a GitLab issue (GitLab MCP was down at the time anyway).

**Where**: `src/config/swagger.js` (the generator config), `node_modules/swagger-autogen/swagger-autogen.js` (lines 65-68), `node_modules/swagger-autogen/src/handle-files.js` (`resolvePathFile`, `routePrefix`/`propRoutes` logic), `src/config/swagger-output.json` (the stale generated output).

**Learned**:
1. **Bug 1 — Windows path resolution.** In `swagger-autogen.js`'s `init()`, the `win32` branch unconditionally rewrites both `outputFile` and every `endpointsFiles` entry by prefixing them with `dirname(process.argv[1])`, with no check for whether the path is already valid/absolute (the non-win32 branch DOES have that check). Since `swagger.js` lives in `src/config/`, this doubles the path (`./src/routes/*.js` → `src/config/src/routes/*.js`, which doesn't exist) → the glob matches nothing → it silently writes `paths: {}`. `outputFile`'s write side has a try/catch fallback to the original unresolved string, which is why the command still exits 0 and prints "Success" even though it just wiped the file. Fix: use absolute paths via `path.join(__dirname, ...)` for both `outputFile` and `endpointsFiles` — confirmed this makes the tool actually read the files.
2. **Bug 2 — mount-prefix loss (deeper, NOT fixed).** Even with absolute paths, regenerating strips the mount prefix from EVERY route (e.g. `/getUsersWithFilters` instead of `/users/getUsersWithFilters`), not just new ones — confirmed by actually running it and diffing. Root cause: swagger-autogen only auto-detects a path prefix from `express.Router()` + `.use()` patterns found in THE SAME FILE it's scanning (`routePrefix`/`propRoutes` in `handle-files.js`) — it does NOT trace `app.use('/api/users', require('./routes/userRoutes'))` across files from `index.js` into the required route file. Since `endpointsFiles` here globs individual route files directly (`./src/routes/*.js`), each file is scanned with zero knowledge of where it's mounted. Pointing `endpointsFiles` at `src/index.js` instead (hoping it would trace the requires) produced ZERO paths, not more — that recursive cross-file trace isn't what this pattern is for. There IS a manual per-route override tag, `#swagger.path = '/real/full/path'` (found in `handle-files.js:468` / `swagger-tags.js:195`), which could fix this file-by-file, but doing it correctly for the whole app means adding that tag to every existing route across every route file — out of scope for a single feature.
3. **The committed `swagger-output.json` was already stale before any of this** — it only documents `/auth`, `/getAllUsers`, and `/users/*`. Routes for pagos-isseg, pagos, reportePagos, program, and reportValidation are wired in `index.js` but nowhere in the generated doc, even though they predate report-documents by a lot. Nobody has successfully regenerated this file correctly in a long time; the "/users" prefixes in it were most likely produced under a different `endpointsFiles` config or Node/library version than what's installed now, not by the current glob-based setup.
4. **Practical takeaway for next time**: don't trust `npm run swagger`'s "Success" log — always diff `swagger-output.json` line count after running it before committing. A real fix needs either (a) adding `#swagger.path` overrides to every route across every route file, or (b) restructuring route files so each one calls `express.Router()` + mounts sub-routers with `.use(prefix, ...)` inside a single traceable file tree that swagger-autogen can actually follow. Both are project-wide refactors, not something to slip into an unrelated feature PR.

Source inspection of `report-documents.component.ts:113-127`: new pure exported `resolveObservacionNote(status, note)` returns `''` when `status === 'Documento correcto'` (constant `ESTATUS_DOCUMENTO_CORRECTO`), else `note || '—'` — matches spec id 175's "Observación Business Rule" requirement verbatim ("WHEN a row's Estatus equals 'Documento correcto', its Observación cell MUST render empty regardless of any note value received").
Template wiring confirmed: `report-documents.component.html:112` binds `{{ resolveNote(r.documents?.[c.id]?.status, r.documents?.[c.id]?.note) }}` — a thin public wrapper (`resolveNote()`, ts:253-255) around the pure function, replacing the previous unconditional `r.documents?.[c.id]?.note || '—'`.
Test coverage confirmed GENUINELY FIXED, not just supplemented: the `describe('resolveObservacionNote', ...)` block (spec.ts:199-212) has 3 triangulated cases (blank on "Documento correcto" regardless of note content, note preserved otherwise, `—` fallback for null/undefined). The previously-passing-but-WRONG integration test was replaced in place — only ONE test exists now for the grouped-header row rendering (spec.ts:362-382, renamed to `'renders each cell's note verbatim EXCEPT when its status is "Documento correcto"...'`), and it asserts the fixture row with `status:'Documento correcto', note:'nota que el backend no debería mandar aquí...'` renders `''` for that cell (verified in the `cellsText` array: index 9 = `''`, immediately after `'Documento correcto'` at index 8). Source inspection confirms `Router` is now injected via constructor (`ts:169`) and a private `handleHttpError(err: HttpErrorResponse, message: string)` (ts:261-267) checks `err?.status === 403` → `this.router.navigate(['/forbidden'])`, else falls back to the existing generic `Swal.fire('Error', message, 'error')`.

Route target confirmed real: `app-routing.module.ts:19` has `{ path: 'forbidden', component: ForbiddenComponent }` as an absolute top-level path — `router.navigate(['/forbidden'])` resolves correctly.
Test coverage confirmed: `describe('ReportDocumentsComponent 403 handling', ...)` (spec.ts:564-654) has 5 tests using a `forbiddenError()` HttpErrorResponse(status:403) helper and a `createRouterSpy()` jasmine.SpyObj<Router> helper — one positive test per call site (runSearch/columns, fetchData/page-turn, exportExcel, downloadTemplate) each asserting `expect(routerSpy.navigate).toHaveBeenCalledWith(['/forbidden'])` AND that the generic `Swal.fire` error was NOT called, plus 1 negative test (500 error) asserting the opposite (no navigate, generic Swal.fire called). New `describe('ReportDocumentsComponent bulk upload wiring', ...)` (spec.ts:656-693) with one test: drops a `.pdf` File via `onFileInputChange`, asserts `Swal.fire` was called with `('Error', jasmine.any(String), 'error')`, AND that `component.uploadedFile` stays `null` and `component.foliosFromFile` stays `[]`. ### Fresh Full Regression Check (independently executed this session, not trusted from apply-progress)
**Full suite** (isolated `tsconfig.spec.verify.json` + `--exclude=**/auth.interceptor.spec.ts` workaround — temp tsconfig file created, used, then deleted; confirmed untracked via `git status --short` both before and after):
